AI.result: 以S&P 500五只成分股2013-2016训练、2017测试的金融预测为案例（Qwen3-VL-235B基础智能体，Claude Sonnet 4.6策展）：(1)无治理方法（Reflective Accumulation）性能全面退化：方向准确率从零样本51.2%降至46.3%，夏普比率由0.53转为-0.12，经验反而有害；(2)部分需求方法（Reflective Refinement）恢复准确率至51.1%但风险调整收益仍下降（夏普0.36），因就地修改会静默失效历史证据；(3)完整闭环方法在所有指标上显著超越零样本基线：方向准确率+5.3pp至56.5%，场景准确率从23.8%升至29.0%，夏普比率近翻倍至1.00，最大回撤削减60%至13.0%。规则库演化显示策展使活跃规则数远低于累积规则数，体现治理贡献。
AI.conclusion: 在非平稳世界反馈环境下，智能体性能提升的主要瓶颈不是经验提取而是洞察治理。相同的累积经验在缺乏治理时造成负迁移，在完整策展闭环存在时则带来显著提升。四项需求（R1-R4）可作为面向世界反馈学习的智能体设计检查清单。三层架构证明了治理机制——而非经验数量——决定智能体是否真正学习。局限在于：实证仅覆盖单一领域（2013-2017牛市S&P 500），证据日志为自然语言线性增长，未做时序折扣；未来工作可探索异质反馈类型下的迁移、元策展（学习如何治理）以及AGM信念修正等形式保证的工程实现。

title: Brick-DICL: Dynamic In-Context Learning for Automated Brick Schema Classification
summary: Building Management Systems (BMS) are essential for optimizing energy efficiency and operational performance in modern buildings. However, the lack of standardization across BMS points from different manufacturers creates significant barriers to integration and data utilization. While the Brick schema offers a standardized ontology for building systems, mapping BMS points to appropriate Brick classes presents three critical challenges: (i) the extensive number of Brick classes (936 in the latest version), (ii) limited domain-specific knowledge in large language models (LLMs), and (iii) substantial manual effort required for verification. To address these challenges, we propose Brick-DICL, a two-stage dynamic in-context learning framework for automated Brick schema classification. Brick-DICL consists of two primary components: metadata-RAG, which retrieves relevant examples to enhance LLMs' domain knowledge, and class-RAG, which narrows down potential Brick classes to address the large classification space. Additionally, we implement a multi-LLM filtering mechanism that compares predictions across multiple models, flagging low-confidence classifications for human review. As a result: (i) General: Brick-DICL is applicable to any building management system regardless of manufacturer or metadata format; (ii) Novel and Powerful: as the first dynamic in-context learning approach for Brick schema classification, Brick-DICL achieves significant classification accuracy improvements on building datasets, outperforming existing methods; (iii) Efficient: our multi-LLM filtering strategy reduces manual verification effort, enabling rapid digital building onboarding. Extensive experiments demonstrate Brick-DICL's effectiveness across diverse building datasets, accelerating the path toward standardized, interoperable building management systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Brick-DICL，一种基于动态上下文学习（DICL）的两阶段框架，用于自动化将建筑管理系统（BMS）数据点映射到Brick本体类。该框架通过元数据RAG和类RAG分别增强LLM的领域知识并缩小分类空间（936个类），并结合多LLM过滤机制标记低置信度预测以减少人工验证。实验在两个建筑数据集上验证了其相对于静态ICL、随机ICL及BERT系列微调基线的优越性。
AI.motivation: BMS数据点因厂商不同而缺乏标准化，Brick本体虽有936个类可提供统一语义表示，但LLM对建筑领域知识有限且分类空间巨大，加之人工验证成本高，因此需要一种通用、高效、自动化的映射方法。
AI.method: （1）两阶段动态ICL：Stage One通过元数据RAG从训练集中检索top-k相似示例（k=15）构建动态prompt进行初始预测；Stage Two基于初始预测用类RAG检索top-m相关类（m=20），再经两步式LLM生成从20→5→3的候选类并输出概率。（2）多LLM过滤机制：四个模型独立预测，采用All Agreement/Top-3 Consensus/Top-1 Agreement/Any-2 Consensus四种策略标记不一致的低置信度结果供人工复核。
AI.result: 在B1和B2两个建筑数据集上，Brick-DICL的Stage2 Hits@1和Hits@3均显著优于Static ICL、Random ICL、Dynamic ICL及BERT/DistilBERT/RoBERTa/SciBERT等基线；消融实验表明元数据DICL、类DICL及两阶段设计各自均有贡献，缺一者性能下降；15-shot和top-20类为最优超参；Any-2策略在精度与人工复核量之间达到最佳平衡。
AI.conclusion: Brick-DICL是首个针对Brick模式分类的动态上下文学习方法，具备通用性（适用于任何BMS）、高精度和高效率（最小化人工验证），能有效推动建筑数据标准化与互操作性。

title: FinAcumen: Financial Multimodal Reasoning via Self-Evolving Experience Memory Harness
summary: Financial multimodal reasoning requires agents to coordinate numerical computation, retrieval, visual interpretation, and temporal grounding across heterogeneous evidence sources. Existing tool-augmented agents improve execution fidelity, yet remain largely stateless across episodes, repeatedly rediscovering reasoning strategies and failure patterns. In high-stakes financial settings, this leads to unreliable tool routing, noisy retrieval, and hallucination-prone reasoning. We present FinAcumen, a financial reasoning agent framework centered on selective experience memory for tool-augmented multimodal reasoning. FinAcumen accumulates financially grounded reasoning experience from prior trajectories, distilling successful strategies and failure-derived cautionary rules into a persistent memory bank. During inference, retrieved experiences condition reasoning only when semantic relevance exceeds a calibrated threshold, while irrelevant memory is explicitly suppressed through a fallback mechanism. A deterministic financial tool environment further grounds numerical computation, retrieval, visual decoding, and answer this http URL four financial multimodal reasoning benchmarks, FinAcumen consistently improves a frozen 8B vision-language model over finance-specialized models and approaches leading proprietary general-purpose models. Further analysis shows that selective experience activation improves reasoning reliability under retrieval uncertainty. Our code is anonymously available at this https URL

AI.tldr: FinAcumen是一个面向金融多模态推理的智能体框架，通过选择性经验记忆（FM）和确定性金融工具（FT）的结合，使冻结的8B视觉语言模型在四个金融多模态推理基准上超越金融专用模型，接近主流通用大模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有工具增强型智能体在跨任务时大多无状态（stateless），需要反复重新发现推理策略和失败模式，在金融等高风险场景中容易导致工具路由不可靠、检索噪声大以及幻觉推理等问题。现有基于记忆的方法将成功与失败经验混合检索、缺乏相关性过滤，会直接降低金融推理质量。
AI.method: FinAcumen包含两大核心模块：（1）金融记忆（FM）模块——从训练轨迹中通过多轨迹采样积累成功策略和失败警示规则，以持久化记忆库形式存储；推理时通过余弦相似度阈值（τ=0.65）选择性激活相关经验，不相关时回退至基础推理。（2）金融工具（FT）环境——提供四个确定性工具：数值推理引擎（持久命名空间代码执行）、数据检索（OHLC/新闻/季度指标）、视觉结构解码器（OCR+图像重解析）和答案整合门控（源可追溯、单位一致、格式校验）。整体冻结Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct骨干，仅在推理时通过提示前缀和工具调用进行适配。
AI.result: 在BizBench SEC-NUM、FinMMR（Easy/Medium/Hard）、FinTMMBench和FinMME四个基准上：FinAcumen将冻结8B VLM从27.67提升至68.65（BizBench），在FinMMR Easy/Medium上超越GPT-4o，显著优于Llama-Open-Finance-8B、FinLLaVA、Fin-R1等金融专用模型。消融实验显示FT带来+14.91、FM再额外贡献+7.59（FinMMR Easy共+22.50）。记忆库在1800条目后趋于饱和，τ=0.65时命中率最优，检索深度k_max=5时准确率最高（呈倒U型）。
AI.conclusion: FinAcumen验证了"冻结骨干+外部经验记忆+确定性工具"的解耦架构在专业领域AI中的有效性：外部化记忆捕获可复用策略模式而不破坏核心模型，领域特定工具提供计算保证。选择性激活机制确保检索不确定性下不会因噪声记忆导致性能退化。未来工作方向包括样本高效整合、跨任务组合记忆结构、多语言对齐和更强视觉编码器的融合。

title: Beyond Domains: Reusing Web Skills via Transferable Interaction Patterns
summary: Large language model (LLM) web agents are usually deployed as tool callers: each turn, the model reads a fresh page observation and emits one structured tool action. When every action is a low-level primitive, horizons grow quickly and so do policy-facing LLM completions, dominating latency and cost on benchmarks such as Mind2Web and WebArena. Recent systems therefore wrap repeated interaction fragments as web skills: callable tools built from successful trajectories or induced programs, so one call can replace several primitives. However, prior skill libraries are still triggered mainly by instruction similarity or coarse site metadata, which yields low skill reuse on held-out sites and leaves much of the potential step and token reduction on the table. We present SkillMigrator, an agent that learns reusable web skills and transfers them across sites by matching layout structure rather than specific element references. Each induced skill is stored as a transferable interaction pattern (TIP): the skill paired with a structural sketch of the snapshot at induction time. At test time, SkillMigrator retrieves TIPs by layout similarity and grounds their references on the live page. The rest of the stack is standard: accessibility-snapshot observations with stable references, and fixed tool calling over primitives plus skill invocations. Compared with the state-of-the-art approaches, SkillMigrator reduces the average LLM-action count on successful trajectories by 8-10% across both WebArena and Mind2Web at matched success rate.

AI.tldr: SkillMigrator 是一种 LLM Web 智能体，通过将每个学习到的技能存储为"可迁移交互模式"（TIP，即技能 + 归纳时页面快照的结构骨架），并以布局相似度而非指令文本作为检索信号，实现跨网站、跨域的技能复用。在 WebArena 与 Mind2Web 上，成功轨迹的平均 LLM 调用次数较当前最优方法降低 8–10%，且任务成功率基本持平。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM Web 智能体每步都需调用 LLM 产生低层原语动作，在 Mind2Web、WebArena 等长视野任务上造成巨大延迟与成本。已有工作将重复动作序列封装为"可复用技能"，但其技能库主要依赖指令相似度或站点元数据进行检索，导致在未见过的网站上技能复用率低（仅 17–31%），无法真正跨域迁移。核心瓶颈是检索信号过于语义化，忽略了页面结构层面的可复用性。
AI.method: （1）将每条诱导出的技能存储为 TIP 元组 k=(ι, σ, Φ, τ)，其中 ι 为一句话意图，σ 为从训练轨迹聚类得到的操作模板（如 fill-and-submit），Φ 为带同义词池的槽位模式，τ 为归纳时无障碍树的清洁结构骨架；不存储任何 ref 标识。（2）检索时计算 score(k)=α·文本余弦相似度+(1−α)·布局相似度，后者由 APTED 树编辑距离的归一化得分构成；top-1 得分低于阈值 β 时退回 ReAct 模式。（3）技能执行分两阶段匈牙利匹配：Stage A 从用户指令/实例字典中解析各槽位取值；Stage B 将槽位绑定到当前页面的具体控件。（4）操作模板的固定 plan 在槽位绑定后展开为确定的 fill/click 等原语序列，未绑定的必填槽位则回退到 LLM。
AI.result: WebArena 平均 SR 45.7%（接近 PolySkill 的 49.3%），平均 LLM 动作数 N̄ 从 5.9 降至 5.4（较 SOTA 降 8.5%，较 ReAct 降 16.9%）。Mind2Web 跨域分片上 SR 63.0% vs PolySkill 63.4%，N̄ 6.2 vs 6.9；跨域技能复用率 35.4% vs 31%，且库规模更小。SkillMigrator+PolySkill 混合架构可达 N̄=5.3，验证其可作为现有技能库的检索层。消融实验表明布局信号贡献最大（去掉后 SR 跌 6.5 点至 39.2%），同义词池次之，门控阈值 β 是部署可调的精度-召回旋钮；超参 α∈[0,0.6] 区间内结果稳健，Claude-4 骨干上 SR 提升至 54.7%。
AI.conclusion: SkillMigrator 通过"以布局相似度索引技能、以 TIP 抽象跨越标签差异"的思路，把现有同站/同域技能复用的边界推进到真正的跨域场景；在不牺牲成功率的前提下显著降低 LLM 调用成本，且与 ASI、PolySkill 等既有技能库正交互补，可作为其上层的检索层部署。局限在于布局条件检索对结构相似但交互流不同的页面会失灵，且模板库尚不覆盖拖拽、模态对话框等交互模态。

title: From Brewing to Resolution: Tracing the Internal Lifecycle of Code Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Standard accuracy metrics cannot explain why LLMs handle variable tracking but fail on semantically equivalent loops. We study an internal lifecycle of code reasoning in which models first brew the answer, making it linearly recoverable many layers before it becomes self-decodable, and then diverge into one of four resolution outcomes: Resolved, Overprocessed, Misresolved, or Unresolved. Understanding this lifecycle matters because similar task accuracies can mask fundamentally different failure modes that surface-level evaluation cannot detect. We introduce a dual diagnostic framework pairing layer-wise linear probing with Context-Stripped Decoding (CSD) and apply it to six code-reasoning task families across 16 models spanning Qwen, Llama, and DeepSeek architectures. All four outcomes carry substantial mass in every task family: overall Resolved is only 41.5%, with multiple tasks below 30%. Controlled sweeps over structure, depth, and operators expose task-specific failure bottlenecks: Function Call Resolved plunges from 61.1% to 2.5% as call depth increases from one to three. Across architectures and scales, the brewing scaffold remains stable, with normalized brewing duration 24-42% across all 16 models, while resolution success varies with capability. This indicates that the scaffold is a stable empirical regularity across the tested decoder-only Transformer families, whereas resolution success covaries with capability, scale, and training. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出"酿造-解析"（Brewing-to-Resolution）框架，通过层间线性探针（Linear Probing）与上下文剥离解码（CSD）的双诊断方法，追踪LLM代码推理的内部生命周期。研究发现模型先"酿造"答案（信息可线性恢复但尚不可自解码），随后分化为四种结果（Resolved/Overprocessed/Misresolved/Unresolved）。在16个模型、6类代码任务上验证：整体Resolved率仅41.5%；归一化酿造时长稳定在24-42%；Function Call深度从1增到3时Resolved率从61.1%骤降至2.5%。该框架揭示了代码推理中"信息可用性"与"信息就绪性"的本质分离。
AI.motivation: 标准准确率指标无法解释LLM在代码推理中的异质性失败模式：模型可轻松处理变量追踪却在语义等价的循环展开上失败，两个准确率相近的模型可能内部失败机制截然不同。核心问题是：模型在各层是否已"解决"问题（而非仅"编码"了信息），以及"信息可被外部线性读出"与"信息可被模型自身解码"之间的差异。
AI.method: （1）构建CUE-Bench基准：6类合成代码任务族（Value Tracking、Computing、Conditional、Function Call、Loop、Loop-unrolled），每模型24,300样本，单数字答案保证统一11类诊断空间。（2）双诊断框架：层间线性探针（Φ_P^ℓ）检测信息可用性（information availability）；上下文剥离解码CSD（Φ_C^ℓ）通过将源提示ℓ层隐状态注入仅含问题的目标提示并做基线logit减除，检测信息就绪性（information readiness）。（3）定义FPCL（首次探针正确层）与FJC（首次联合正确层），二者之差为"酿造区间"Δ_brew。（4）四类结果分类：Resolved（存在FJC且最终输出正确）、Overprocessed（存在FJC但最终错误）、Misresolved（无FJC且CSD尾部置信≥0.5）、Unresolved（无FJC且CSD尾部置信<0.5）。（5）三类因果干预：FJC处激活补丁、Overprocessed的层跳跃（alpha-blend α=0.3）、Unresolved的FPCL重注入。（6）GT-free分辨率泛函ρ = (1-ĥ)(1-δ̂)·â。（7）跨16模型验证（Qwen2.5/2.5-Coder/Qwen3/DeepSeek-Coder/CodeLlama/Llama-2，0.5B-14B）。
AI.result: （1）酿造间隔稳定：FPCL平均在14%深度，FJC在50%深度，Δ_brew约占38%网络深度；归一化酿造时长在全部16模型上稳定在24-42%区间。（2）任务特定失败瓶颈：Function Call深度1→3时Resolved从61.1%降至2.5%；Computing步数2→4时OP升至47.5%；Conditional的boolean_flag条件产生18.5% Misresolved。（3）环路语法支架：Loop与Loop-unrolled计算等价但双变量追踪UR分别为23.5%与53.6%；移植Loop的MLP写入关闭82.6%的就绪性差距。（4）后期层（22-27）为决策区：Overprocessed的"错-对翻转"主要由Qwen系列注意力（layers 22-23）执行，Llama/DeepSeek系由MLP执行。（5）因果干预有效性：alpha-blend注入挽救47.8% Overprocessed样本；FPCL重注入挽救22-38% Unresolved样本；FJC处激活补丁的翻转率比pre-FJC层高20-44pp。（6）GT-free检测：分辨率泛函ρ在372,600样本上二元AUC=0.850；四分类F1=0.75（Resolved）/0.64（Unresolved）/0.38（OP）/0.35（MR）。（7）机制与能力解耦：16模型间FJC位置高度相关（r=0.901），但Resolved率随规模/训练/能力变化（0.5B→14B从18.0%升至50.3%）。（8）CRUXEval-O外部验证：能力排序在合成基准与真实基准上一致重现。
AI.conclusion: Transformer深度在代码推理中承担两个可分离功能：计算答案与将其重格式化为可自解码状态。酿造支架（占网络深度约38%）在架构与规模上保持稳定（24-42%），是测试的decoder-only Transformer族的稳定经验规律；解析成功率则随能力、规模、训练协变。四种结果模式（Resolved/Overprocessed/Misresolved/Unresolved）需采用相反的推理策略：Overprocessed适合早退，Unresolved需要更多深度。信息可用性先于就绪性是残差流几何或训练机制的产物，该顺序为outcome-aware自适应深度系统（MoD、Inner Thinking、looped Transformer）提供了诊断信号。局限性：诊断为层级粒度而非注意力头/MLP子层粒度；基准为短单基元程序，组合代码的动态性待验证；尚不明确该顺序是否残差流几何的必然结果。

title: Using Cognitive Models to Improve Language Model Simulation of Human Persuasion Games
summary: People make decisions differently in strategic interactions. Some update beliefs like a Bayesian; others exhibit biases like motivated reasoning. Although creators of large language models use simulated humans for safety evaluations and training, they often fail to cover this breadth of human behavior. We argue that cognitive science and economics provide a convenient tool for doing so, making use of mathematical models of human decision-making. We propose an approach that we call Equation-to-Behavior Prompting for guiding large language models to match cognitive models, and evaluate this approach on persuasion games based on legal decision-making. We find that large models can approximate equation-based specifications -- Bayesian updating, affine distortion, motivated updating, and Grether's $\alpha$-$\beta$ model -- using prompting, but small models fail to do so. However, training small models with reinforcement learning to adhere to mathematical rules, Equation-to-Behavior RL, reduces belief error by 26.5% in out-of-distribution parameterizations. We show that these simulations can help create diverse training environments; training small models to consider different kinds of decision-makers improves average belief change by 2.5%--12% over Bayesian-only training, even when persuading GPT-5-mini. Our work could improve human simulations for training and evaluation in increasingly realistic settings, and could also enable novel research into more complicated mathematical models of human decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"方程到行为"(Equation-to-Behavior)范式，将认知科学和行为经济学中的数学决策模型（如贝叶斯更新、仿射失真、动机性更新、Grether α-β模型）转化为大语言模型（LLM）的行为规范。基于《伦敦中央刑事法庭旧 Bailey审判记录》构建法律决策数据集，评估了"方程到行为提示法"在模拟多样化人类决策者方面的效果，并通过强化学习训练小模型遵循数学规则，在分布外参数化上将信念误差降低26.5%。此外，训练小模型针对多样化决策者进行训练，比仅针对贝叶斯训练在信念变化上提升2.5%–12%，甚至在说服GPT-5-mini时也表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM模拟人类行为的方法（如角色提示、偏好学习）难以覆盖人类决策的多样性，尤其是非贝叶斯偏差。LLM在战略交互场景中作为安全评估和训练工具时存在局限性，无法准确建模信念更新过程。需要一种方法将认知科学中的计算模型转化为LLM可执行的行为规范。
AI.method: 1. 方程到行为提示法(Equation-to-Behavior Prompting)：将数学决策模型的方程直接写入系统提示，引导大模型模拟特定认知模型；2. 方程到行为强化学习(Equation-to-Behavior RL)：使用GRPO算法训练小模型，以与数学模型的L1距离为奖励；3. 基于Old Bailey数据集构建法律决策测试平台，使用Gemini-2.5-Pro进行证据标注；4. 评估模型：GPT-5、Claude-Sonnet-4、DeepSeek-V3.1、GPT-OSS-120B、Llama-3.3-70B、Llama-3.1-8B等；5. 训练模型：Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Mistral-7B。
AI.result: 1. 大型LLM能通过提示较好地模拟多种非贝叶斯更新规则，小模型则不能；2. Equation-to-Behavior RL将分布外参数化下的信念误差降低26.5%（如Llama-3.1-8B从0.237降至0.175）；3. 训练小模型针对多样化决策者分布进行训练，比贝叶斯训练提升信念变化2.5%–12%，甚至超过GPT-5-mini；4. 在现实人类决策模拟上，方程到行为提示法比角色提示法判决匹配率提升4.7%–9.1%；5. 在MakeMePay和MakeMeSay安全评估任务中，大模型在异质决策者面前表现出强说服能力。
AI.conclusion: Equation-to-Behavior方法为LLM模拟多样化人类决策提供了系统化、可量化控制的途径，是对现有角色提示法的有效补充。该工作可改善LLM在战略交互中的安全评估和训练环境设计，并为研究更复杂的人类决策数学模型提供新工具。未来工作可扩展至更广泛的战略交互场景和人类-AI交互研究。

title: FllumaOne: A Code-Native Multimodal CAD Dataset with Executable Programs and Kernel-Validated Feature Histories
summary: Parametric computer-aided design records both final geometry and the ordered construction history that determines how a part can be edited. Datasets for editable CAD research should therefore expose modeling operations, parameters, and feature dependencies together with validated geometry. We introduce FllumaOne, a code-native multimodal CAD dataset whose models are generated by executable Python programs in Flluma, a Qt/C++ OpenCASCADE-based CAD system. Each sample aligns its program with a structured feature tree, a training-oriented intermediate representation, STEP geometry, a surface point cloud, natural-language descriptions, metadata, and eight canonical visible-edge renderings. The primary release, FllumaOne-100K, contains 100,000 accepted samples across four template-level complexity regimes. Programs are executed and retained only after kernel geometry, solid validity, and export checks; release reports also record modality completeness and split-level duplicate tests. A Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B LoRA baseline trained on 80,000 samples achieves 99.98% Python syntax validity, 99.97% Flluma build success, and 99.14% STEP-export validity on the held-out 10,000-sample test split. For the 9,909 predictions converted to surface point clouds, the mean normalized Chamfer Distance is 0.002124. The dataset supports conditioned CAD reconstruction, executable program synthesis, feature-tree prediction, B-Rep analysis, retrieval, design completion, and editable reverse engineering.

AI.tldr: FllumaOne 是一个面向可编辑 CAD 研究的代码原生多模态数据集，包含 10 万个样本，每个样本将可在 Flluma（基于 OpenCASCADE 的 Qt/C++ CAD 系统）上执行的 Python 程序与结构化特征树、训练 IR、STEP 几何、表面点云、八视图渲染、文本描述及元数据对齐，并通过 OpenCASCADE 内核进行几何与导出验证。
AI.motivation: 现有 CAD 数据集存在两类局限：一是仅记录最终形状（网格或 B-Rep），缺失对编辑能力至关重要的构造历史（操作、参数、依赖关系）；二是依赖商业 CAD 软件许可证，缺乏可审计、可回放、可大规模对齐的构造记录与学习输入。该工作旨在不依赖商业许可证的前提下，将可检查的构造历史、可执行代码、内核验证的几何与多模态学习输入统一到同一接受记录中。
AI.method: 核心方法包括：（1）使用 Flluma CAD 运行时（Qt/C++ + OpenCASCADE 后端 + Python API）作为可执行与验证环境；（2）由 53 个参数化模板家族按 L1–L4 四级复杂度调度生成候选；（3）通过规范化构造签名去重后，在 Flluma 中执行并经 B-Rep 检查器、BRepGProp 体积/面积计算与 STEP 写入/回读进行内核级验证；（4）接受样本导出为特征树（feature_tree.json）、紧凑训练 IR、Python 程序、STEP、2,048 点带法线表面点云、八视角特征感知线框渲染、确定性文本与 Qwen2.5-7B 增强的 LLM 文本；（5）发布 Parquet 训练/验证/测试表与完整性/质量报告；（6）以 Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B + LoRA（rank 16）训练文本到程序基线，按 Python 语法、Flluma 加载/构建、内核实体有效、STEP 导出与归一化 Chamfer 距离多层评估。
AI.result: 数据集层面：100,000 个完整接受样本，按 80K/10K/10K 划分；复杂度分配 L1/L2/L3/L4 = 3,056/16,966/55,219/24,759；53 个模板族、44 个操作词、60 个特征树标签；平均特征数 5.458、历史深度 4.348、B-Rep 面数 28.789、边数 72.144；模板归一化熵 0.915；程序、特征树、训练 IR、实体签名四种哈希均为 0 重复；所有模态完整率 100%。基线层面：10,000 测试样本上 Python 语法有效率 99.98%、Flluma 构建成功率 99.97%、内核实体有效率与 STEP 导出有效率均为 99.14%；9,909 个可采样预测的归一化 Chamfer 距离均值 0.002124、中位数 0.001491、P95=0.004854；操作 F1=99.96%，平均源码相似度 87.34%；按复杂度分层后 L4 实体有效率与 Chamfer 中位数均最高。
AI.conclusion: FllumaOne 通过在单一接受记录中联合特征树、可执行 Python、内核验证几何与多模态观测，在 10 万规模上弥合了最终形状数据集与专有原生 CAD 历史之间的鸿沟；基线验证了从自然语言到可执行、可几何比对 CAD 输出的可复现路径。代价是分布继承自受控模板与 Flluma API 规约；下一步工作应重点评估参数编辑保持性与模板互斥划分下的构造意图保持能力。

title: EComAgentBench: Benchmarking Shopping Agents on Long-Horizon Tasks with Distributed Hidden Intent
summary: As LLM-based shopping agents enter production, existing benchmarks fail to capture how a shopper's requirements arrive: stated implicitly in the query, recorded in a profile, or revealed only when the right question is asked. Benchmarks that expose full intent upfront and grade only the final choice can neither pose this long-horizon challenge nor explain which requirement an agent missed. To address this gap, we introduce EComAgentBench, a benchmark of 662 tasks grounded in real Amazon products and reviews. Each task scatters these requirements across a visible query, a tool-gated profile, and scripted clarification; an agent must uncover hidden intent, verify candidates against attributes and review evidence, and commit to a single product within 100 tool calls. Moreover, typed, source-tagged rubrics grade every task, attributing each failure to a requirement and its source. Construction is automated yet reliable, with every answer fixed in code before any text is generated and every sample validated. Our evaluation of seven models reveals that even the strongest attains only 57.1% overall accuracy, and rubric satisfaction degrades from visible to hidden sources. Overall, we believe EComAgentBench will serve as a reproducible foundation for moving shopping agents from single-query search toward dependable assistance over long horizons.

AI.tldr: EComAgentBench 是一个面向 LLM 购物智能体的长程基准测试，包含 662 个基于真实 Amazon 产品的任务。其核心创新在于将用户需求分散到三个来源（可见查询、工具门控的用户画像、脚本化的澄清对话），并通过类型化、带来源标签的评分规则来精确定位失败原因。
AI.motivation: 现有购物智能体基准存在三大缺陷：(1) 评分粒度粗——仅按产品精确匹配或特征重合度打分，无法指出哪个需求被遗漏、来自哪里；(2) 缺乏隐藏意图——多数基准将所有需求直接放在查询中，少数引入个性化但未真正隐藏；(3) 构建不可靠——长程任务难以编写、评分噪声大，已有基准在验证、自动化、真实产品之间顾此失彼。论文将购物重新定位为长程、隐藏意图恢复任务。
AI.method: 基于 Amazon Reviews 2023 真实目录（370万产品、2100万评论）构建。任务三源拆分：(1) 可见查询（部分需求以隐式线索表达）；(2) 隐藏画像（仅通过 get_user_profile 工具获取）；(3) 隐藏澄清（仅当 ask_user 工具触发特定关键词槽位时获得）。采用 10 个工具的 API 沙盒（而非浏览器），上限 100 步、10 次澄清，每个任务推荐唯一产品。评分采用 6 种类型化、来源标签化的 rubric（attribute_match、numeric_range、entity_match、negative_attribute、budget_match、review_opinion），分别在 query/persona/clarification 三个维度归因。构建流程七阶段：先在代码中固定正确答案（id、type、field、expected_value、source），再让 LLM 润色文本；多阶段验证防止源间泄露（隐藏值不直接出现在查询中）、保证产品与rubric一致；澄清脚本确定性化（关键词触发+固定回答），保证失败归因于智能体而非用户侧随机性。评估统一使用 gemini-3.1-pro-preview 作为裁判，双路径正确性（精确产品匹配或全部rubric满足）允许双向审计裁判。
AI.result: 7 个模型在 662 个有效样本上评测：整体准确率跨度 19.5%–57.1%（claude-opus-4-6 最高 57.1%，gpt-5.4 47.0%，kimi-k2.6 46.4%，qwen3-30b-A3B 19.5% 最低）。按来源拆分 rubric 满足率显示：query 维度（68.8%–88.1%）明显高于 persona（43.1%–72.8%）和 clarification（45.4%–70.9%）维度，验证隐藏意图确实更难。隐式需求数量是更强的难度预测因子（0–1 个时 7 模型平均 51.8%，3+ 个时降至 27.2%）。失败集中在 review_opinion 类型（满足率仅 33.7%–67.4%）。轨迹分析揭示两种交互风格：深度搜索/晚提问（Opus、Kimi、MiniMax 调用 15–17 次搜索，首问位置 0.50，Opus 完成率仅 84.6%）与浅层搜索/早提问（GPT 家族首问位置 0.06–0.27，完成率 ≥97.7%），二者各有失败模式。裁判稳定性方面：每个模型被误拒的精确正确案例 ≤1 个；gpt-5.4 全部 17 个非精确但正确的案例（161 个 rubric）人工复核无假阳性。
AI.conclusion: EComAgentBench 将购物从单查询检索重新定位为长程智能体任务，验证了"隐藏的分布式意图构成长程难度"这一构造假设。带类型与来源标签的 rubric 提供了可归因的失败诊断；自动化且经审计的构建与评判流水线保证了可复现性。7 模型在 19.5%–57.1% 的准确率跨度表明基准能有效区分模型；rubric 满足率从可见到隐藏需求单调下降，揭示智能体的核心短板在于"在长程中整合分散意图"而非"检索信息"或"单步执行"。未来工作可扩展品类（非仅电子类）、多语言、多商品购物车等场景。

title: LongWebBench: Evaluating Structural and Functional Webpage Generation in Long-Horizon Settings
summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promising progress in generating webpages from visual inputs, yet existing evaluations mainly focus on short, single-screen, and largely static webpages. We introduce LongWebBench, a benchmark for evaluating long-horizon webpage generation from both structural and functional perspectives. LongWebBench contains 490 real-world long webpages for structural fidelity evaluation and 507 goal-oriented interaction tasks over 129 webpages for functional evaluation. It employs two complementary protocols: a multi-dimensional VLM-based metric for assessing long-range structural coherence, and a DOM-augmented agent-based pipeline for end-to-end functional verification. We further examine the automatic evaluation protocols through human agreement analysis. Experiments with state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary VLMs under single-image and multi-image settings reveal that structural fidelity degrades as webpage length increases, while visually plausible generations often fail to support executable multi-step interactions. These results highlight the need to evaluate long webpage generation beyond visual similarity, with executable interaction as a core criterion. Our code and data are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: LongWebBench 是一个用于评估长网页（长视野）生成的基准测试，从结构保真度和功能可执行性两个维度对视觉-语言模型（VLM）进行评测，包含 490 个真实长网页（W-VFR）和 129 个网页上的 507 个目标导向交互任务（W-FFR）。
AI.motivation: 现有网页生成评估主要集中在短小、单一屏幕、静态的网页上，仅以视觉相似度作为成功标准，无法反映模型在长网页上保持全局结构一致性以及支持可执行多步交互的能力，存在显著的评估缺口。
AI.method: 提出两个互补任务：W-VFR（视觉保真度复制）使用 490 个跨 7 类结构的真实长网页，W-VFR 通过 VLM（GPT-4o）作为评判者在 5 个维度（页面规模、全局布局、章节层次、视觉样式、信息密度）上进行 0–10 评分；W-FFR（功能保真度实现）使用 129 个网页上的 507 个交互任务，通过 DOM 增强的智能体管线（Gemini-3-Pro 作为 Actor 和 Critic）在浏览器中执行并验证；支持单图和多图两种输入设置。
AI.result: 在 W-VFR 上，Gemini-3-Pro 表现最佳（单图 6.77/10、多图 7.22/10），长网页的结构保真度随长度增加而下降，多图输入带来有限提升；在 W-VFR 上，Claude 模型在多图设置下提升显著（从 3.81 提升到 6.74）。在 W-VFR 上 Claude-Sonnet-4.5-Thinking 与 Gemini-3-Pro 表现最佳（TSR 约 58–59%，PSR 不到 22%），多图输入对功能实现的提升有限。自动评估与人类判断具有高相关性（Pearson r=0.83，PSR 0.89），跨评判者稳健性极高（r=0.992）。
AI.conclusion: 当前 SOTA VLM 在长网页生成上仍存在显著不足：结构保真度随页面长度增加而下降，视觉上合理的生成往往无法支持可执行的多步交互；长网页生成评估必须超越静态视觉相似度，将可执行交互作为核心标准；LongWebBench 为长上下文多模态代码生成提供了一个可诊断的测试平台。

title: Shattering the Autoregressive Curse: Dynamic Epistemic Entropy Orchestrated Erasable Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
summary: Although reinforcement learning (RL) has expanded the cognitive boundaries of large language models (LLMs), it often remains vulnerable to the autoregressive curse in long-horizon logical reasoning: small epistemic perturbations introduced early in generation can propagate irreversibly along the Markov decision process flow, triggering cascading failures that drive the reasoning trajectory toward collapse. To overcome this autoregressive cascade, in which a single early mistake can compromise all subsequent reasoning steps, we propose dynamic epistemic entropy orchestrated erasable reinforcement learning ($\text{E}^3\text{RL}$). $\text{E}^3\text{RL}$ eliminates reliance on external signals by grounding the model's endogenous local autoregressive cross-entropy as an intrinsic coordinate of epistemic uncertainty. By introducing segment-level adaptive dynamic thresholds and advantage allocation, $\text{E}^3\text{RL}$ enables the model to precisely excise localized logical defects while reusing historical key-value (KV) cache streams, thereby endowing the reasoning process with a self-healing capability. We train $\text{E}^3\text{RL}$ on the DeepMath-103k dataset. Experimental results show that $\text{E}^3\text{RL}$ reshapes the exploration efficiency of long-sequence reasoning and improves sample efficiency while maintaining linear memory overhead. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks such as AIME, $\text{E}^3\text{RL}$ achieves substantial performance gains, with the 4B and 8B parameter models surpassing previous state-of-the-art (SOTA) results by 5.349\% and 6.514\%, respectively. These findings suggest that $\text{E}^3\text{RL}$ shatters the autoregressive curse in long-sequence reasoning and establishes a theoretical and systems-level foundation for the next generation of self-healing artificial general intelligence (AGI).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 E³RL（动态认知熵编排的可擦除强化学习），通过将自回归生成分段处理并利用内生局部交叉熵作为认知不确定性的内在坐标，实现对长程推理中局部逻辑缺陷的精确切除与自愈重生成，取代对外部过程奖励模型或全局重采样的依赖。
AI.motivation: 自回归生成存在"自回归诅咒"：早期微小的认知扰动会沿马尔可夫决策流不可逆地指数级传播，导致长程逻辑推理的级联崩溃。现有方案（外部 PRM、全局重采样）面临标注成本高、分布偏移奖励作弊、计算/内存开销爆炸等问题，亟需一种不依赖外部信号、能在局部精准纠错的机制。
AI.method: （1）分段生成：将输出序列切分为 N 个等长非重叠段，在段间设置检查点；（2）认知熵监控：综合基础熵（滑动窗指数衰减平滑）、梯度异常（段内熵变率）、极值偏差（段内最大熵的 z-score）构造综合不确定性指标 U_n；（3）动态阈值：宏观层基于组内熵均值/方差自适应偏移，微观层引入频率惩罚（指数增长）防止无限重采，历史依赖调制函数利用过往段熵的相对偏差调节；（4）非马尔可夫擦除算子 E：U_n > 阈值时擦除并重新采样，否则接受，重用 KV 缓存；（5）段级优势分配：通过末端注意力回溯的因果分配将序列级奖励归因到各段，重建梯度流。
AI.result: 在 DeepMath-103k 的 51k 样本上训练，基于 Qwen3-4B/8B 架构，在 AMC 2023、AIME 2024/2025/2026、MATH 500、Minerva、OlympiadBench 七个数学推理基准上，E³RL 在 Avg@32 和 Pass@32 上均取得最优：4B 和 8B 模型在 AIME 上分别超越此前 SOTA 5.349% 和 6.514%；消融实验验证基础熵、极值偏差、因果分配、组动态均为关键组件；Erase@5 优于 Erase@1/3，16×512 段粒度为最佳配置；复杂度分析与 GRPO 同阶，内存保持线性。
AI.conclusion: E³RL 通过内生认知熵驱动的段级擦除机制，为长程自回归推理提供了一种无需外部信号、内存线性、轻量级的局部纠错路径，在数学推理任务上验证了其有效性和泛化性，为构建具备自愈能力的下一代 AGI 系统奠定了理论与系统基础。

title: DecoSearch: Complexity-Aware Routing and Plan-Level Repair for Text-to-SQL
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in translating natural language to SQL, yet existing methods still falter on complex queries requiring multi-step, data-aware reasoning. We introduce DecoSearch, a training-free framework that addresses this by routing each query to the appropriate level of reasoning effort. A lightweight Schema Selector first prunes the full database schema to the relevant tables and columns. An LLM Judger then decides whether the question requires decomposition: straightforward questions follow a direct generation path and complex ones are escalated to a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of atomic sub-questions, each solved by a targeted SQL generation step. A RAG component grounds the decomposer with semantically similar training examples, and a Topology Refiner restructures the reasoning plan when execution failures signal a flawed decomposition rather than a fixable SQL error. DecoSearch achieves 70.53% execution accuracy on BIRD and 88.31% on Spider with a DeepSeek backbone, surpassing all training-free baselines while consuming an order of magnitude fewer tokens than competing methods. It also functions as a model-agnostic wrapper, consistently improving fine-tuned SQL generation backbones without any modification to the pipeline.

AI.tldr: DecoSearch是一个无需训练的Text-to-SQL框架，通过复杂度感知的路由机制和计划级修复来提升复杂查询的处理能力。它使用Schema Selector剪枝模式、LLM Judger判断是否需要分解、DAG原子子问题分解、RAG增强分解器以及Topology Refiner进行计划级修复。使用DeepSeek骨干在BIRD上达到70.53%、Spider上达到88.31%的执行准确率，超越所有无需训练的基线方法且token消耗少一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL方法在需要多步、数据感知推理的复杂查询上表现不佳。现有方法（自调试、分解、多候选）各自只针对单一失败层级（实现级、策略级、计划级）进行修复，缺乏统一的失败诊断与路由机制。需要一个能够系统识别失败层级并将计算资源按问题复杂度自适应分配的框架。
AI.method: DecoSearch包含五个核心组件：(1) Schema Selector - 三阶段LLM调用（关键词提取、表格选择、列选择）实现轻量级模式剪枝；(2) LLM Judger - 零样本分类器，输出JSON判断是否需要分解，默认偏好直接路径；(3) Direct Path - 简单查询直接生成并执行单个SQL；(4) DAG分解器 - 将复杂查询分解为有向无环图，子问题间用@[n]占位符传递依赖，RAG检索k=3相似训练样本作为少样本示例，小结果集(≤100行)内联为IN列表，大结果集物化为SQLite临时表；(5) Topology Refiner - 节点执行失败时调用LLM重构DAG（预算B=3次），重写后从首个修改节点恢复执行，保持未受影响上游节点的结果不变。
AI.result: 在BIRD dev上达到70.53% EX（超越CHESS 69.60%等所有训练免费基线），Spider dev上达到88.31% EX。Token效率显著优于对比方法：BIRD上达到2×10^6 tokens时CHESS需2×10^7 tokens（10×开销）；Spider上大多数基线在2×10^6 tokens预算下准确率低于60%。作为模型无关包装器可与微调模型组合：XiYanSQL-7B提升+10.67pp、GPT-5-mini提升+5.61pp、OmniSQL-7B提升+3.52pp。消融实验显示Judger贡献最大（移除-10.65pp），Schema Selector次之（-1.82pp且token增加6.3×）。
AI.conclusion: DecoSearch通过原则性的路由、分解和计划级修复编排，实现了计算开销与查询复杂度的自适应匹配。Judger-led路由是最关键组件，验证了"按需分解"策略优于统一分解。框架可作为模型无关的即插即用增强层，与现有微调系统正交互补。主要局限是依赖执行反馈作为计划级缺陷的信号，在无法执行SQL或执行结果语义错误的应用场景中不适用。

title: WallZero: Mastering the Game of WallGo with Strategic Analysis
comment: Accepted by the Computers and Games conference (CG 2026)
summary: WallGo is a recently introduced strategic board game popularized by the 2025 Netflix series The Devil's Plan. Although played on a small 7 x 7 board, its combination of stone movement and wall placement yields high game-tree complexity and intricate strategic interactions. Despite its growing popularity, WallGo remains underexplored. This paper presents WallZero, an AlphaZero-based agent for the two-player WallGo setting. We introduce tailored action and feature designs to improve playing performance significantly. In the evaluation, WallZero defeats two professional Go players who participated in this study, securing on average 1.98x more territory per game. Beyond its strength, we use WallZero to assess game fairness and identify key strategies for mastering WallGo. Interestingly, our results show that the opening used in the Netflix series yields a more balanced game. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了 WallZero，一种基于 AlphaZero 框架的 WallGo（7×7 棋盘上结合棋子移动与墙壁构建的策略棋盘游戏）AI 智能体。通过定制化动作设计与特征设计（包含可达性、领土、历史信息等），WallZero 击败了两位参与实验的职业围棋棋手，平均获得 1.98 倍的领土优势，并被用于分析 WallGo 的游戏平衡性与核心策略。
AI.motivation: WallGo 是 2025 年 Netflix 剧集《The Devil's Plan》引入的策略棋盘游戏，因传奇围棋棋手李世石的参与而引起围棋与 AI 社区的广泛关注。尽管该游戏棋盘较小（7×7），但棋子移动与墙壁构建的结合使其博弈树复杂度高达约 10^87，具有复杂的战略互动。然而，WallGo 尚未得到充分的 AI 研究——现有在线智能体水平不高，AI 是否能在此游戏中达到超人水平尚不清楚，且游戏的策略与平衡性也未被系统分析。因此，作者基于 AlphaZero 框架开发 WallZero，以填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: WallZero 基于 AlphaZero 算法，使用 MiniZero 框架训练，结合深度残差神经网络与蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS），通过自我对弈从零开始学习。关键方法贡献包括：(1) **动作设计**：将两个阶段统一为 2597 维动作空间（布置阶段 49 个 + 移动阶段 49×13×4 个），并使用动作掩码过滤非法动作；(2) **特征设计**：在基础特征（棋子、墙壁、玩家回合，共 8 个平面）之上，添加三种扩展特征——领土特征（T，3 平面）、可达性特征（R，2 平面）和四步历史特征（H，36 平面），最终构成 49 个特征平面。训练采用 1 块残差网络（256 隐藏通道），自博弈阶段每次走子 200 次模拟，训练 500 轮次（每轮 2000 局自博弈 + 500 步优化），使用 4 块 GTX 1080Ti GPU。评估阶段扩展为 10 块残差网络，采用两阶段课程学习。
AI.result: **特征设计消融实验**：在空棋模式与 4 棋子模式中，添加可达性特征带来最大性能提升（胜率从 27.05% 跃升至 79.43%），完整特征版本（WallZero-BTRH）表现最佳（空棋模式 82.87%，4 棋子模式 82.02%）。**游戏平衡性**：空棋模式中先手（红方）胜率 53.57%，存在轻微先手优势；4 棋子模式中红方胜率 50.37%，游戏更平衡。**人机对战**：WallZero 在 8 局正式比赛中全胜两位台湾职业围棋棋手（黄伟 3 段、周俊勋 9 段），平均获得 1.98 倍领土（最高达 3.08 倍），且在第 20 步前胜率即超 90%。**开局分析**：空棋模式下开局多样、聚焦中心；4 棋子模式收敛于有限模式集，红方先巩固区域优势，蓝方连续两步反击。**策略发现**：识别出两大核心策略——**可达性控制**（包括隐式墙壁利用、牺牲领土保护可达性等高级技巧）与**隐式传递策略**（通过牺牲少量领土操纵回合顺序，模拟"过牌"行为以操控终局结果）。
AI.conclusion: WallZero 证明了 AlphaZero 类方法不仅能用于实现强大的游戏智能体，还能用于量化新引入棋盘游戏的平衡性并提取战略原则。研究表明 4 棋子模式（Netflix 剧集所用规则）比空棋模式更公平，揭示了可达性控制与隐式传递等深层 WallGo 策略。论文展示了 AlphaZero 方法在系统理解与分析新兴棋盘游戏方面的巨大潜力。未来工作方向包括：扩展至四人 WallGo 设置、研究不同棋盘尺寸（6×6、8×8）的泛化性，以及扩大人类棋手评估范围。

title: A homotopy-type-theoretic generalization of neurosymbolic inference
summary: A wide range of neurosymbolic (NeSy) systems compute one functional: a belief-weighted sum of a logical quantity over a space of $\sigma$-structures, of which weighted model counting, fuzzy logic, and probabilistic logic are special cases. This account is built on sets, and a set deliberately forgets two things that are important for NeSy: when two $\sigma$-structures are the same up to a symmetry of the theory, and how many distinct proofs witness a query. Replacing the underlying sets by types, in the sense of homotopy type theory, preserves this information, and turns this functional into a belief-weighted homotopy cardinality, a notion of size that counts each object in inverse proportion to its symmetries. We develop the framework from scratch for NeSy systems, prove a conservativity theorem that recovers the classical functional when symmetries are trivial, and show that the symmetry our framework exposes is exactly the one behind reasoning shortcuts. The payoff is concrete: the shortcut-aware concept posterior that recent methods reach by ensembling or expressive density estimation is the only symmetry-invariant point of the confusion-set simplex, computable in closed form by averaging a single model over the symmetry group. On MNIST reasoning-shortcut benchmarks this single-model wrapper is better calibrated than a diversity-trained ensemble, while leaving label accuracy and identifiable concepts untouched. Code is freely available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文将神经符号推理的经典函数（基于集合的信念加权求和）推广到同伦类型论（HoTT）框架，提出信念加权同伦基数（belief-weighted homotopy cardinality）作为新的推理量。该推广保留了对称性与证明身份信息，当对称群平凡时严格恢复经典函数。更重要的是，所暴露的对称性正与神经符号系统中的"推理捷径"（reasoning shortcuts）相对应，由此给出闭式单模型方法——轨道平均（orbit-averaging），在 MNIST 捷径基准上校准性能优于五模型 Bears 集成，且代码已在 Lean 4 中形式化验证。
AI.motivation: 经典神经符号推理函数 F_θ(φ)=∫_Ω ℓ(φ,ω)b_θ(ω)dm(ω) 建立在集合之上，集合有意遗忘了两个关键信息：(1) 哪些 σ-结构在理论对称下本质相同；(2) 查询有多少不同证明。其中第一类对称性恰好是 NeSy 中"推理捷径"失败模式的根源——模型在概念上做出无证据支持的承诺。因此需要一个能保留这些信息的数学基础，以同时提供基础理论的形式化与实用的捷径感知方法。
AI.method: 将推理函数的四个成分（结构空间 Ω、逻辑值 ℓ、信念 b_θ、积分/求和）逐层提升到类型论层面：结构空间成为带标识类型的 Ω，标识类型记录 σ-结构的自同构；逻辑值替换为证明族 P:Ω→𝒰，截断水平作为参数（命题/集合/群胚）；推理变为依赖对 ∑_ω P(ω) 的信念加权同伦基数 N(P,b)=‖∑_ω P(ω)‖_{V,b}。证明保守性定理：在对称平凡时退化为加权模型计数；在幂等半环下与集合版本一致。识别输出保持的重标记群 G 为推理捷径的来源，捷径感知后验为唯一 G-不变点——轨道上的均匀分布，由此得到闭式的"轨道平均"操作：对单一模型在群 G 上对称化 p̄(c|x)=(1/|G|)∑_g p_θ(g⁻¹·c|x)。全部分析在有限 1-截断（群胚）情形下用轨道-稳定子算术完成，并在 Lean 4 + Mathlib 中机器验证。
AI.result: 在 MNIST 混合可辨识性任务（数字 0 可识别，{1,2} 与 {3,4,5} 存在对称混乱）上，基模型在可混淆数字上过度自信（conf-ECE=0.614）；单模型轨道平均将其降至 0.010，同时保持标签精度（0.996）和可识别数字校准（id-ECE=0.004）。Bears 五模型集成的最佳保精度设置仅达 conf-ECE=0.158，激进多样性设置以牺牲标签精度（0.59）为代价才能压低 conf-ECE 至 0.063。在 XOR 奇偶任务（对称群 Z/2）上，基模型 60% 的种子选错约定（bit-ECE=0.592），轨道平均稳定在 0.012。形式化层面在 Lean 中验证了保守性、平庸对称恢复、表示不变性、不变后验均匀性以及交换模型的闭式 (1+β)ⁿ/n! 表达。
AI.conclusion: 以类型代替集合后，神经符号推理成为保留结构对称与证明身份的信念加权同伦基数，机器验证表明它在平凡对称下严格恢复经典函数。该对称参数正与推理捷径同构，由此推出的轨道平均是闭式、单模型、推理时的捷径感知方法，实验上校准性能优于五模型集成且不牺牲精度或可识别概念。生成函数视角（指数生成函数即同伦基数）说明该框架在部件化组合时表现自然。开放问题在于将同伦基数从 π-有限类型推广到连续 Ω 的相容合成测度。

title: FlowRAG: Synergizing Explicit Reasoning via Frequency-Aware Multi-Granularity Graph Flow
summary: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) is effective for knowledge-intensive and multi-hop query tasks; however, many existing methods primarily seed entity-based graphs and rely on implicit semantic relevance propagation. This often (i) under-retrieves when user queries are abstract and semantically sparse at the entity level, and (ii) suffers from brittle multi-hop reasoning, where noisy activations can derail entity-to-entity transitions and corrupt the inferred relation chain, yielding unreliable conclusions. To this end, we propose \texttt{FlowRAG}, a semantic-aware retrieval framework that improves both semantic recall and explicit reasoning. Specifically, \texttt{FlowRAG} constructs a quad-level heterogeneous graph over passages, summaries, sentences, and entities, where summary nodes serve as a coarse semantic hub. At retrieval time, a dual-granularity activation module combines summary--query alignment with sentence-level matching to activate relevant entities under paraphrase and abstraction robustly. We then introduce a frequency-aware weighted flow module that routes relevance through entity--passage links weighted by within-passage term frequency, pruning noisy connections and extracting high-confidence reasoning paths as an explicit logic skeleton for generation. Extensive experiments show that \texttt{FlowRAG} obtains state-of-the-art performance on complex reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: FlowRAG提出了一种基于四级异构图（段落-摘要-句子-实体）的语义感知检索框架，通过双粒度激活机制（微级句子匹配+宏级摘要对齐）解决抽象查询的语义稀疏问题，并引入频率感知加权流算法（基于词频TF的实体-段落边权）显式提取高置信度推理路径，在多跳推理基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有GraphRAG方法面临两大核心挑战：(1) 实体稀疏导致的欠检索——当用户查询抽象或缺乏显式实体提及时，模型无法激活正确入口，产生高层查询主题与细粒度图证据之间的"粒度不匹配"；(2) 噪声引发的错误传播——多跳推理中，查询中的噪声激活和图中的无关连接会偏离实体间转换路径，破坏推断的关系链，导致结论不可靠。现有方法（如HippoRAG依赖隐式PageRank、LinearRAG采用静态排序）缺乏鲁棒的过滤机制和显式推理路径提取能力。
AI.method: FlowRAG包含三个核心组件：(1) 四级异构图构建 G=(V,E)，节点涵盖段落V_P、LLM生成的摘要V_Sum、句子V_S、NER提取的实体V_E，边通过绑定矩阵B（段落-摘要）、抽象矩阵A（摘要-实体）、提及矩阵M（句子-实体）和基于TF归一化词频的加权Contain矩阵C（实体-段落）连接；(2) 双粒度实体激活，通过并行微分支S_micro（Top-K句子余弦相似度经M传播）和宏分支S_macro（Top-K摘要余弦相似度经A传播）取最大值初始化实体激活向量a^(0)；(3) 频率感知加权流算法，将检索建模为显式能量传播，实体到段落的转移权重W_{e_j→p_k}基于归一化TF过滤边缘噪声，结合衰减因子α和动态剪枝阈值τ迭代传播残差能量R_t，最后按路径平均能量评分提取Top推理路径作为显式逻辑骨架。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue和Medical四个基准上，FlowRAG取得平均GPT-Acc 58.89%，超越最强基线LinearRAG（57.17%）1.72%，并在2WikiMultiHopQA上以65.20% GPT-Acc超越HippoRAG 5.3%。消融实验证实双粒度激活和频率感知加权流均为关键组件，前者在MuSiQue上贡献2.7% GPT-Acc提升，后者在HotpotQA贡献1.0%提升。检索质量分析显示FlowRAG在四类问题（事实检索、复杂推理、上下文理解、创造性生成）上Recall均最优（平均92.90%）。效率方面，FlowRAG索引速度比HippoRAG快2.7倍、比LightRAG快14倍，检索延迟仅0.25s，提示词消耗仅为LightRAG的2%。案例分析表明在密集家族关系消歧任务中，LinearRAG因"语义分心"误答，FlowRAG通过显式结构锚定（经中间节点Sophie）成功识别正确分支。
AI.conclusion: FlowRAG作为一种结构感知框架，通过四级异构图与频率感知加权流算法的结合，桥接了静态排序与动态推理之间的鸿沟，有效解决了粒度不匹配问题并提取显式推理链，在多跳推理基准上全面超越现有SOTA方法，同时通过提供可解释的逻辑骨架显著减少幻觉。未来工作将把基于流的机制扩展到动态知识更新，并在更广泛的开放域场景中进行测试。

title: StepGuard: Guarding Web Navigation via Single-Step Calibration
summary: Web navigation requires agents to follow natural language goals, interact with web pages, and produce accurate answers. While recent advances leverage vision-language models and reinforcement learning, existing methods still suffer from single-step fragility due to reward misalignment and error propagation. To tackle the reward entanglement, we design Dynamic Dual-Policy Optimization (DDPO), which dynamically switches between a navigation-first mode for exploration and an answer-first mode for question-answering to mitigate reward conflict. To calibrate the single-step error, we propose Confidence-Guided Adaptive Navigation Reflection (CANR), a mechanism that estimates per-step confidence, triggers reflection only when necessary, and uses contrastive rewards to encourage self-correction to calibrate the single-step inaccuracy. With the above as the main components, we finally develop our StepGuard, a new framework of Guarding Web Navigation via Single-Step Calibration. Experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves navigation and answer accuracy, setting new state-of-the-art performance on standard web navigation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StepGuard框架，通过单步校准解决网页导航中的单步脆弱性问题。包含两个核心组件：DDPO（动态双策略优化）解耦导航与问答奖励，CANR（置信度引导的自适应导航反思）在低置信度步骤触发反思以修正错误。在WebVLN和WebWalkerQA基准上取得了新的SOTA性能，且3B轻量模型性能可媲美72B大模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基于VLM和RL的网页导航方法存在两个关键问题：（1）奖励纠缠——导航奖励鼓励持续探索以收集信息，而问答奖励倾向于尽早终止以生成答案，二者优化目标冲突，导致单步梯度干扰；（2）单步错误传播——网页导航任务中，任意一步的决策失误会沿轨迹传播，最终导致任务失败。这两个问题使现有方法在单步层面十分脆弱，限制了在长视野任务中的鲁棒性。
AI.method: StepGuard框架基于GRPO强化学习算法，包含两大核心组件：（1）**DDPO（动态双策略优化）**：将训练数据划分为导航子集𝒟_nav和问答子集𝒟_qa，训练时交替使用"导航优先"模式（奖励R_n基于到目标页面的最短路径距离+格式奖励R_f）和"问答优先"模式（奖励R_a基于F1分数+格式奖励R_f），从源头上解耦异质奖励信号，避免梯度冲突。（2）**CANR（置信度引导的自适应导航反思）**：以策略分布与均匀分布的KL散度作为单步置信度，通过P_reflect(s_t)=exp(-κ·Conf(s_t))概率性触发反思；触发后进行两阶段生成（初始响应y_init→反思提示→修订响应y_ref），并通过"成功反思奖励"R_rs（仅奖励反思后奖励提升的情形）强化"低置信度→触发反思→正确决策"的行为链。整体使用Qwen2.5-VL-3B作为主干网络，通过DeepSpeed ZeRO-3在10块RTX 3090上训练。
AI.result: 在WebVLN上，StepGuard取得Test SR 39.83%，超越WebVLN-Net基线5.07%；在WebWalkerQA上，3B模型在Hard子集取得25.38% SR，显著优于Qwen-2.5-14B/32B（均为23.33%），接近72B模型水平（25.83%）。单步动作准确率在WebVLN提升+3.61%，WebWalkerQA提升+4.82%。消融实验表明：DDPO主要贡献来自缓解奖励冲突，CANR通过选择性反思进一步提升性能（39.83% vs 随机触发39.02%、始终反思39.37%）；置信度校准分析显示CANR将正确/错误预测的置信度差距从0.06扩大到0.17；格式奖励R_f和反思成功奖励R_rs均为关键组件。敏感性分析表明κ=4为最优平衡点。
AI.conclusion: StepGuard通过奖励解耦（DDPO）和自适应校准（CANR）为网页导航的可靠性提供了系统性解决方案，在标准基准上建立新SOTA。其核心价值在于证明：3B轻量模型经过单步校准后可达到与72B大模型相当的复杂导航性能，弥合了模型规模与能力之间的差距。局限性在于方法依赖精细的奖励工程（尤其是格式奖励R_f），且在缺少有效监督信号的任务中可能面临收敛挑战。

title: Structural Preservation and the Logical Expressiveness of Graph Neural Networks
summary: Bridges between graph neural networks (GNNs) and logical formalisms have been established by fixing architectural choices, such as the types of aggregation, combination, and activation functions. These choices define restricted classes of GNNs for which tight correspondences with logical formalisms can be obtained, by showing that logical formulae can be translated into equivalent GNNs and, conversely, that GNNs can be translated into equivalent formulae. In this paper we take a semantic perspective by establishing the logical expressiveness of classes of GNN classifiers that are preserved under structural properties: embeddings (extensions), injective homomorphisms, and homomorphisms. We show that, for each such property, there exists a fragment of graded modal logic characterising the class of GNNs. In particular, preservation under embeddings, injective homomorphisms, and homomorphisms corresponds to existential graded modal logic, its existential-positive fragment, and existential-positive modal logic, respectively. These results characterise the expressiveness of broad classes of GNNs independently of specific architectural choices, but we also show that each of these classes admits a GNN architecture of the same expressiveness. Technically, our approach uses a new well-quasi-order result for trees of bounded height, yielding finite representations of unravelling-invariant classes.

AI.tldr: 本文从语义角度研究图神经网络（GNN）的逻辑表达能力，通过分析GNN分类器在结构保持性质（嵌入、单射同态、同态）下的保持性，建立了与分级模态逻辑片段的精确对应关系：嵌入保持↔存在分级模态逻辑（∃GML），单射同态保持↔存在正分级模态逻辑（∃+GML），同态保持↔存在正模态逻辑（∃+ML）。核心技术贡献是证明了有界高度树类在嵌入关系下构成良拟序（wqo），从而为展开不变类提供了有限表示。
AI.motivation: 现有的GNN与逻辑形式化之间的桥梁主要通过固定架构选择（如聚合、组合、激活函数类型）来建立，这导致表达能力的刻画严格依赖于具体的架构选择。本文旨在采用语义视角，基于比图同构不变性更强的结构保持性质（嵌入、单射同态、同态），在不考虑具体架构约束的情况下刻画GNN的逻辑表达能力，从而对GNN的判别能力提供更本质、更通用的理解。
AI.method: 方法核心结合了三个工具：(1) 利用GNN的局部性，通过L-展开（unravelling）将图结构转化为有界高度的树；(2) 证明了新的良拟序结果——有界高度的有根树类在嵌入关系下构成wqo（通过Higman引理和树高的归纳证明）；(3) 利用wqo的有限极小元素性质，对每个结构关系定义相应的特征公式（如对∃GML的修改版特征公式，移除非字面量），将逻辑保持定理与模态逻辑片段精确对应。同时给出了GNN架构层面的对应：单调GNN（MGNN）、MAX-MGNN、增强型MGNN。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：① 三个核心保持定理——展开不变且分别在嵌入/单射同态/同态下保持的类，分别等价于被∃GML/∃+GML/∃+ML中深度至多L的公式所定义；② 精确的架构-逻辑对应——增强MGNN↔∃GML，增强MAX-MGNN↔∃ML，MGNN↔∃+GML，MAX-MGNN↔∃+ML；③ 揭示了正权重GNN与注入同态保持GNN在表达能力上的等价性，说明非负权重的句法限制在该类中并不限制表达能力；④ 表达能力的层次谱：增强MGNN可表达点态非单调性质但不能表达精确计数/奇偶性等非局部性质；MGNN限制为单调性质；MAX-MGNN仅限于纯存在性性质。
AI.conclusion: 本文开发了一个基于结构保持性质的GNN表达能力分析语义框架，通过结合保持定理和新的有界高度树良拟序结果，建立了结构关系、模态逻辑片段和GNN架构类之间的精确三元对应。框架揭示了结构不变性与表达能力之间的基本权衡：更强的保持性质导致更简单的逻辑刻画但以降低表达能力为代价。框架可自然扩展到有向图。局限性包括：仅关注节点分类（不适用于图级预测）、仅处理基于阈值分类的GNN、不含边特征、假设离散节点标签、不涉及非局部推理机制。

title: MathVis-Fine: Aligning Visual Supervision with Necessity via Progressive Dependency-Guided Training for Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has extended from purely linguistic domains to multimodal scenarios; however, existing approaches often treat visual inputs as homogeneous or auxiliary signals, failing to capture the intricate and sample-specific dependencies between text and images in mathematical problem-solving. This gives rise to two core issues: first, the supervisory signals for visual content are generalized and coarse-grained, lacking adaptation to the actual necessity of visual information in each sample; second, training feedback becomes inaccurate when visual rewards are uniformly applied without distinguishing the complementary relationships among inputs. These limitations hinder models from achieving precise multimodal reasoning. In this work, we propose a framework for modeling fine-grained visual dependencies in mathematical reasoning. We first construct the MathVis-Fine dataset, augmenting fine-grained visual annotations with visual dependency ratings. Building upon this dataset, we introduce a two-stage progressive visual enhancement training paradigm that balances answer correctness rewards and visual grounding rewards according to the intrinsic visual dependency level of each sample, thereby mitigating reward bias and improving supervision accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the MathVis-Fine framework effectively enhances visual perception progressively based on visual dependency, offering a more precise training framework for multimodal mathematical reasoning. We will release the dataset upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: MathVis-Fine提出了一个针对多模态数学推理的框架，通过构建带有视觉依赖等级标注的数据集（5.4K样本）和两阶段训练范式（SFT阶段的检索-感知协同损失 + GRPO阶段的多维视觉依赖自适应奖励机制），将视觉监督强度与样本的内在视觉必要性对齐，解决了现有方法对视觉信息统一处理导致的监督信号粗粒度和奖励偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态CoT方法将视觉输入视为同质化或辅助信号，未能捕捉数学问题中文本与图像之间样本特定的细粒度依赖关系，导致两个核心问题：(1) 视觉内容的监督信号粗粒度、缺乏对每个样本实际视觉信息必要性的适应；(2) 统一应用视觉奖励时训练反馈不准确，无法区分输入间的互补关系。
AI.method: 1) 构建MathVis-Fine数据集（约5,425个数学问题），每个样本标注细粒度的视觉依赖评分λv ∈ {0.0, 0.5, 1.0}（低/中/高）以及文本推理步骤与视觉区域的索引对齐；2) Stage 1（VDRS-SFT）：在视觉依赖高的样本上使用检索-感知协同损失（Retrieval-Perception Synergy Loss），结合BCE检索损失和KL散度正则化（掩码关键视觉区域后迫使模型依赖检索内容）；3) Stage 2（MDVD-RL）：在GRPO框架中引入多维视觉依赖奖励机制，包括视觉索引奖励（Precision×Recall）、视觉内容奖励（VLM判别器验证关键视觉属性）和依赖自适应奖励融合（以λv作为门控因子）。基础模型为Qwen2-VL-7B。
AI.result: 在多个多模态数学基准上达到开源7B模型的SOTA：MathVista数学子集77.26%（超过MINT-CoT 3.56%）、GeoQA 66.45%（+1.73%）、MMStar-Math 71.0%（+1.4%）、HC-M3D基准上ALL达50.6%且视觉幻觉率（AG）降至34.8。消融实验验证了各组件必要性：移除依赖门控导致MathVista下降2.46%，Pearson相关性分析显示高依赖样本中视觉检索质量与答案正确性呈强正相关（r>0.65），而低依赖样本相关性接近零（r≈0.05），从经验上证明了按λv加权视觉奖励的合理性。
AI.conclusion: MathVis-Fine通过将视觉监督强度与每个问题的内在视觉必要性对齐，有效解决了多模态CoT中视觉信息处理粗粒度的问题。其核心贡献在于：(1) 揭示了视觉依赖的异质性及其对训练监督设计的影响；(2) 通过协同损失实现显式视觉定位与隐式视觉依赖的内生统一；(3) 依赖自适应奖励机制避免了文本主导任务中的视觉噪声干扰。局限性在于当前奖励机制未显式区分不同视觉属性（如拓扑vs判别精度）的敏感性，未来需结合更强的视觉专业先验模型进行属性级的偏好蒸馏。

title: Learn to Quantify Social Interaction with Constraints for Pedestrian Walking
summary: Long-term human path forecasting in crowds is critical for autonomous moving platforms (like autonomous driving cars and social robots) to avoid collision and make high-quality planning. Although the current research take into account social interactions for prediction, they don't reveal the exact kinds of social interactions happened among people and how the social interactions affect the decision-making process of pedestrians, which further limits its robustness. Social interactions in pedestrian walking are intuitively massive and hard to label and quantify. In this paper, we explore creatively to quantify and interpret how pedestrians interact with others by proposing Learn to Cluster. Our clustering social interactions is probabilistic latent variable generative, learning directly from sequential trajectory observations, scalable to arbitrary number of pedestrians. Learn to cluster is label-free and can be naturally integrated into the training process of the prediction model. The latent variables will then serve as 'labels' to categorize social interactions. Extensive experiments over several trajectory prediction benchmarks demonstrate that our method is able to learn the patterns of social interactions and effectively integrate the patterns to pedestrian trajectory prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"Learn to Cluster"的概率潜在变量生成方法，用于量化和解释行人行走中的社交交互模式。该方法通过时空图建模行人交互，使用Gumbel-Softmax采样离散潜在变量作为交互模式的"标签"，并基于最大编码率减少（MCR2）准则设计社会损失函数来约束聚类过程，可无缝集成到轨迹预测训练中，在ETH和UCY基准上取得与SOTA相当的预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有行人轨迹预测方法虽然建模了社交交互，但将所有交互类型不加区分地池化处理，缺乏可解释性，无法揭示具体发生了哪些类型的社交交互以及它们如何影响行人的决策过程。这限制了模型在复杂场景中的鲁棒性和可信度。社交交互本身又因种类繁多、难以标注而难以直接量化。
AI.method: 1）使用时空图（ST-graph）建模行人间的相对运动（位置和速度偏移量）；2）通过全连接层嵌入相对运动特征，并将其reshape为(M, G, R)形式，经Softmax得到G种社交交互模式的离散概率分布；3）利用Gumbel-Softmax重参数化技巧进行可微采样，得到one-hot的交互模式标签；4）基于最大编码率减少（MCR2）准则设计社会损失函数，最大化跨簇差异、最小化簇内差异；5）通过模式聚合模块将社交特征与模式标签融合后输入LSTM编码器；6）使用混合密度网络（MDN）输出多模态未来轨迹。
AI.result: 在ETH和UCY五个数据集上的实验显示：1）通过四种典型交互场景的统计分析，Mode 3对应激进交互，Mode 2对应温和交互，Mode 1对应无/极弱交互；2）模式转变主要由相对位置关系驱动（前进/后退/侧方），伴随相对速度增加和距离减小；3）定量预测精度上，Model-V1在ETH数据集上大幅超越基线（ETH-eth ADE 0.33 vs Social STGCNN 0.64），平均ADE达到0.33/0.67，超越所有SOTA基线；4）消融实验验证了模式提取、社会损失约束和MDN损失各自的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次提出了一种无标签、数据驱动的概率潜在变量生成方法来揭示行人社交交互的可解释模式，验证了通过最大编码率减少约束聚类的有效性。未来工作将扩展到更多数据集、探索最佳聚类数量，并研究将交互模式融入更广泛任务的方式；同时承认可解释性的引入可能以一定预测精度为代价。

title: DiagFlowBench: Evaluating How Language Models Handle Off-Procedure Inputs in Grounded Diagnostic Dialogue
summary: Language models increasingly serve as advisory systems in maintenance operations. To prevent hallucination, recent systems ground these models in procedural documentation to constrain them to approved steps. In practice, however, operator queries frequently stray from this path, requiring models to recognise out-of-scope inputs mid-conversation, a dynamic that current benchmarks rarely prioritise. We introduce DiagFlowBench, a dataset of 50 industrial diagnostic flowcharts from a consumer manufacturer converted into 1,676 multi-turn conversations that contrast compliant with out-of-scope utterances. Evaluating a panel of ten commercial and open-weight models reveals high variability in abstention rates, with models commonly selecting a real but contextually inadequate step rather than fabricating facts. The inherent plausibility and authority of this mapped but wrong advice exposes a challenging vulnerability for grounding systems.

AI.tldr: DiagFlowBench 是一个工业诊断对话基准，由 50 个工业流程图生成的 1,676 轮多轮对话构成，用于评估基于流程图接地（grounded）的大语言模型在面对偏离程序的操作员输入时的表现。研究发现了一种被命名为"强制映射（forced mapping）"的新型失效模式——模型倾向于选择流程图中存在但在当前语境下不适用的步骤，而非直接拒绝回答或虚构事实，这一发现揭示了基于相似度的接地机制存在难以察觉的盲区。
AI.motivation: 在工业维护场景中，LLM 被部署为基于程序文档接地的咨询系统，以防止幻觉（hallucination）。然而实际操作中，操作员的查询常常偏离程序（off-procedure），且包含缩写、行话和领域术语，现有基准未能充分评估模型在多轮对话中同时处理合规与不合规输入的能力。当前研究将"流程图接地"（评估合规性）与"拒答识别"（评估离题输入）作为独立任务评估，缺乏对两者交叉场景的考量。
AI.method: 1. 数据集构建：将某消费品制造商的 50 个工业诊断流程图（7–60 节点）匿名化处理后，通过贪心集合覆盖枚举所有根到终点的路径，再由 LLM（claude-sonnet-4-5）生成操作员话术脚本，经过零温度验证器修复与人审后注入扰动以模拟真实工作单文本；为每个对话构建配对的"混合"版本，在非终止位置注入不合规轮次，并按"覆盖缺口""未记录的故障""无关问题"三类分层。2. 评估对象：10 个商业及开源模型（Gemini 2.5 Flash、GPT-4o Mini、Llama 4 Scout/Maverick、Llama 3.3 70B、Qwen3 235B/30B、Mistral Small 24B、GPT-OSS 120B、Nemotron 3 Super 120B），通过 OpenRouter 调用，temperature=0。3. 评分机制：合规轮用词级 Jaccard 相似度（阈值 τ*=0.05，校准 F1=0.927）匹配节点；不合规轮用 claude-haiku-4-5 作为评判模型分类为正确拒答（CA）、强制映射（FM）或虚构（FA），与人类标注一致性 κ=0.79。
AI.result: 1. 合规表现：步骤准确率（SA）70.1%–85.0%，表现较稳定；终止识别（TR）波动剧烈（38.8%–98.5%），为较弱项。2. 离题表现：虚构率（FA）低（2.2%–8.6%），表明接地有效防止编造步骤；强制映射率（FM）高且波动大（15.7%–67.4%），成为压倒性的主要失效模式；Qwen3 30B 正确拒答率最低（27.4%），Llama 3.3 70B 最高（81.3%）。3. 模型规模、架构、参数数量均不能可靠预测离题可靠性：较旧的 Llama 3.3 70B 反而优于新一代 Llama 4；推理导向模型反而最不愿拒答。4. FM 与查询和手册文本的词汇重叠度高度相关（覆盖缺口类 FM 最高，无关问题类最容易拒答），一次 FM 错误使后续恢复率骤降至 1.0%–9.1%，远低于 70%+ 的基线 SA。
AI.conclusion: 将 LLM 限制于程序文档节点集合内虽可防止虚构，却引入了"强制映射"这一新型失效模式——模型选择真实但语境不适用的步骤，使幻觉被替换为一种更隐蔽的错误。标准接地检查因节点结构合法而无法识别此类错误，因此工业部署不能仅依赖低 FA 率推断稳健性，而需引入外部验证层，持续评估当前话语与对话历史对当前节点及相邻边的语境蕴含关系。该研究将基准、代码与提示以 CC-BY-4.0/MIT 协议开源。

title: PreAct: Computer-Using Agents that Get Faster on Repeated Tasks
summary: Computer-using agents drive real software through the screen -- clicking and typing -- but they solve every task from scratch: asked to repeat a task, an agent re-reads the screen, re-reasons every tap, and pays the full cost again. We present PreAct, which lets such an agent get faster on tasks it has done before. The first time it succeeds, PreAct compiles the run into a small state-machine program-states that check the screen, transitions that act-and on later runs replays it directly instead of invoking the agent 8.5-13x faster, with no per-step language-model calls. Replay is not blind: at each step PreAct checks that the screen matches what the program expects before acting, and hands control back to the agent the moment something is off. PreAct applies the same discipline when deciding what to keep: a freshly compiled program enters the store only if, re-run from a clean state, an independent evaluator confirms it solved the task-catching programs that replay to their last step yet leave the task undone. Across a mobile, a desktop, and a web benchmark, this store-time check separates repeated runs that improve from ones that degrade as faulty programs accumulate, worth 1.75-2.6 tasks per benchmark, the same direction on all three; a fallback that explores afresh when no program fits brings PreAct level with a strong record-and-replay baseline. We also report what did not matter: prompt wording, runtime guardrails, and whether a language model or a plain embedding retriever selects which program to reuse.

AI.tldr: PreAct 是一个让计算机使用代理（computer-using agents）在重复任务上变快的框架：首次成功执行后，将其编译为一个可验证的状态机程序（含屏幕检查谓词和动作转换），后续运行直接回放该程序（速度提升 8.5–13 倍，无需每步调用语言模型），但在每次执行前先验证屏幕状态、并在存储新程序前通过独立的"验证入库门"（verify-before-store gate）确认程序在干净环境下能真正完成任务，从而避免错误程序污染语料库。
AI.motivation: 现有的计算机使用代理在每次执行任务时都从零开始：重复任务时仍要重新读取屏幕、重新推理每一步操作并承担完整成本。现有方法（技能库、代码编译系统、记录-回放系统）要么在执行时仍依赖 LLM，要么存储的动作序列无法验证屏幕状态，也无法在存储前确认其有效性。这导致"重复任务成本"这一效率维度在基准测试中长期被忽视，代理无法像人类一样通过重复形成"流畅但非盲目的"自动化执行能力。
AI.method: PreAct 的核心是"预测-检查"原则在两个时间尺度上的应用：(1) **存储的工件**：将成功轨迹编译为状态机 P=(S,T,M,V)，每个状态带有可验证的屏幕谓词（XPath/可访问性树模式），每个转换带有一个动作；轨迹中的具体值被提升为参数。(2) **运行时循环**（Algorithm 1）：选择器选取程序 → 状态机回放器在每一步先检查屏幕谓词再执行动作，失败则回退到 CUA 全量代理 → CUA 成功后编译新程序 P'。(3) **入库前验证门**：在干净环境下重放 P' 并由独立评估器确认任务完成，只有两者皆通过才入库（去重签名匹配时替换旧程序）。(4) **缓存未命中回退**：当验证门清空语料库时，触发一次新的 CUA 探索。两个辅助组件：基于 LLM 的程序选择器（默认），以及作为回退的全量 CUA 代理。
AI.result: 在 AndroidWorld（移动端）、OSWorld（桌面端）、WebArena（网页端）三个基准上验证：**(1) 重复任务加速**：warm 回放比重新求解快 8.5–13 倍，且无每步 LLM 调用；冷→暖的 SR 单调提升（Android 5 个种子全部单调，n=3 Gemini 种子平均 +1.33 任务）。**(2) 验证门的价值**：在三个平台上的差分差值落在 1.75–2.6 任务区间内（Android +2.6，OSWorld +2.6，WebArena +1.75），门关闭时所有平台均退化（合并 p≈10⁻⁴）；可复现"回放 100% 但得分为 0"的失效案例（5 个典型程序在 WebArena 上 48/48 全部失败）。**(3) 缓存未命中回退**：在 WebArena 上加入回退后，warm SR 从 2.0/12 提升至 6.25/12，与 Muscle-Mem 基线（6.25/12）统计上不可区分（Welch p≈0.84）。**(4) 负面发现**：提示词措辞、运行时护栏、选择器类型（LLM vs 嵌入检索）对结果影响甚微；选择器调优后嵌入检索可达 100% 正确族系召回，胜过 LLM 选择器的 75.6%。**(5) 局限**：验证门依赖可重置/幂等环境；OOD 泛化能力差（test_tiny 语料用于 test_small 时反而下降 ~11pp）；编译 LLM 失败率约 28%（Android 漏 navigate_back），验证成本 +162%/+217% 墙钟时间。
AI.conclusion: PreAct 证明计算机使用代理可以通过"将首次成功的执行编译为可验证的状态机程序"来获得类人的"流畅"重复执行能力。系统的两个核心承诺缺一不可：(1) **可执行的记忆**——存储的工件就是直接运行的代码，而非需 LLM 重新解读的脚本或转录；(2) **未经验证不入库**——运行时检查在每步动作前执行，入库前门在整个程序层面再执行一次，这是在语料库随使用增长时保持其正确性的关键。验证门在三个结构不同的平台上表现出稳定的边际价值（1.75–2.6 任务），表明其作用是机制层面而非平台特异的；缓存未命中回退机制使其在 WebArena 上与最强记录-回放基线（Muscle-Mem）持平。论文的核心启示是：随着代理建立越来越大的技能库，真正困难的问题不再是"能否记住做过什么"，而是"能否判断哪些记忆仍然为真"。

title: How Inference Compute Shapes Frontier LLM Evaluation
summary: AI evaluations are shifting toward harder tasks that benefit from longer trajectories involving tool use and iterative problem solving. As a result, performance is increasingly sensitive to the amount and allocation of compute available at test time ("inference compute"). Yet many evaluations still report performance at a single restrictive budget, meaning that low scores may reflect the evaluation setup rather than the model's underlying capability. To test this, we evaluate up to 12 frontier language models on seven challenging benchmarks spanning software engineering, mathematics, medicine, and cybersecurity. We use a controlled setup combining three simple inference-scaling interventions: larger token budgets, context compaction, and repeated submission attempts, guided either by the model itself or by minimal correctness feedback. We find three main results. First, larger token budgets substantially improve performance on benchmarks across multiple domains, including cybersecurity, FrontierMath, Humanity's Last Exam, and TerminalBench. Second, fixed-budget evaluations can increasingly understate frontier capability as models advance. Newer models reach higher performance at large budgets, where they unlock harder tasks and solve them more reliably. Third, benchmarks differ in which inference-scaling methods help most: repeated submission broadly improves performance, but the value of larger token budgets, external feedback, and parallel attempts varies by benchmark. Overall, our results show that benchmark scores are protocol-dependent. We therefore argue that evaluations should report capability as a function of inference-time compute, specify protocol choices explicitly, and compare model generations over a large shared compute range at matched budgets, especially in safety- or policy-relevant settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了推理时计算（inference compute）如何影响前沿大语言模型在7个挑战性基准上的性能表现，发现基准分数严重依赖于评估协议（protocol），主张应将能力作为推理计算的函数来报告。
AI.motivation: 当前AI评估越来越多地转向需要长轨迹、工具使用和迭代解决问题的困难任务，性能对推理时计算越来越敏感。然而许多评估仍使用单一受限预算报告分数，可能低估模型真实能力。本文旨在系统研究推理扩展（inference scaling）对前沿模型性能的影响。
AI.method: 采用统一实验框架，评估最多12个前沿模型在7个基准（TerminalBench、SWE-Bench Pro、FrontierMath、HealthBench、HLE、Cyber CTFs、The Last Ones）上的表现。使用三种简单推理扩展干预：扩大token预算（5M-100M）、上下文压缩、重复提交尝试，比较无反馈与oracle分数反馈两种条件。进行任务级分解分析（reach、efficiency、reliability）和并行扩展（pass@k）分析。
AI.result: 三大主要发现：（1）推理扩展显著但高度依赖基准——FrontierMath、HLE和网络空间安全基准在超出典型预算后仍有大幅提升，但HealthBench和软件工程基准提升有限；（2）固定预算评估会低估前沿能力，新一代模型在大预算下表现更优，跨代改进主要来自reach（解锁新任务）和reliability（可靠性提升）而非token效率改善；（3）不同基准对推理扩展方法响应不同——重复提交普遍有帮助，oracle反馈在HLE和SWE-Bench Pro上效果最显著，并行采样对无状态基准（HLE、HealthBench）最有效。
AI.conclusion: 基准分数具有协议依赖性，推理时计算量、反馈条件和串行/并行分配都应被视为评估设计的一部分而非实现细节。建议：（i）将能力作为推理计算的函数报告而非单一固定预算数字；（ii）将协议选择视为评估设计的一部分并明确记录；（iii）在趋势追踪时在共享的宽计算范围内匹配预算比较模型。在安全或政策相关场景中尤其重要，因为固定预算比较可能随着模型进步变得越来越具有误导性。

title: Small Initialization Matters for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models provide a tractable system for asking how intelligence itself emerges, rather than only how LLMs can be engineered. Although progress is usually attributed to scale, data and architecture, we show that parameter initialization is a gene-like determinant of training and, in particular, of model capacity. Reducing the initialization scale consistently improves pretraining, with the largest gains on reasoning-demanding tasks. We identify two widely used empirical settings that restrain the advantage of small initialization, and show how relaxing them restores favorable scaling. We further uncover a critical initialization that balances the reasoning and training. Mechanistically, small initialization drives a distinct developmental trajectory: parameters first condense into low-complexity structures and later expand into richer representations, giving concrete form to the idea that compression is intelligence. Token-level analyses show that the gains concentrate on non-trivial, context-constrained predictions rather than all tokens uniformly. These results motivate a simple $\gamma$-initialization rule: expose initialization rage as an explicit knob and use small initialization by default, an almost cost-free intervention that improves pretraining and strengthens reasoning across model scales.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了参数初始化尺度（由γ控制）对大语言模型预训练的影响。发现减小初始化尺度（γ从0.5增大到1）能持续降低预训练损失，且对推理任务提升最大；标准架构中存在两个抑制因素（RMSNorm的ε常数和注意力汇聚），去除后小初始化的优势在大模型上仍然成立，可使等效模型规模提升约44%。γ=1是残差流与恒等路径的平衡点；机理上小初始化驱动参数呈现"先压缩后展开"的凝聚轨迹，收益集中在中-高难度、需要上下文推理的token上。论文提出将γ作为显式超参数，并以γ=1为默认值的γ-初始化规则。
AI.motivation: 初始化在大模型时代常被视为已解决的工程细节（Xavier/LeCun/Kaiming等启发式），实际工程中多依赖昂贵的试错。本文的核心动机是将初始化尺度视为类似"基因"的训练决定因素，挑战"初始化影响在大规模训练中会消失"的通行观点，探究：(1) 减小初始化尺度是否系统性地提升LLM预训练；(2) 为何该收益随模型增大而减弱；(3) 收益的来源是机制性问题。这既具工程价值，也为"压缩即智能"这一观点提供具体佐证。
AI.method: 1) 参数化方案：对每个权重矩阵W以W_ij ~ N(0, d_in^(-2γ))初始化，γ=0.5恢复Xavier-like标准尺度，γ>0.5对应更小初始化。2) 模型与训练：训练0.1B/0.3B/0.7B/1.5B稠密Decoder-only Transformer（pre-norm + RMSNorm + SwiGLU + RoPE）以及1.5B-A250M/3.2B-A0.5B MoE模型，使用Megatron-LM + AdamW，在约36B–100B token的中英双语语料上预训练1 epoch。3) 架构调整：把RMSNorm的ε从10^-5降到10^-12；引入门控注意力（对每个head的输出施加sigmoid门）以缓解注意力汇聚。4) 评测：lm-evaluation-harness上的ARC-C/TriviaQA/MMLU/HellaSwag/BBH/SocialIQA/GSM8K/MATH500。5) 机理分析：token级对称概率差Δ^sym p、注意力汇聚分数S_sink、权重矩阵行余弦相似度与稳定秩（StableRank = ‖W‖_F²/‖W‖_2²）。6) 理论推导：证明残差流‖h_L−e‖_2/‖e‖_2 ~ d^(1−γ)，给出γ=1为残差-恒等路径平衡点的解析依据。
AI.result: 1) 收益稳定但随规模衰减：在标准架构下，γ=1相对γ=0.5在0.1B模型上降低验证损失约0.05，在1.5B上仅约0.003；推理任务（GSM8K/MATH500/HellaSwag/TriviaQA）提升最大，绝对增益≥4%。2) 两大约束被识别并解除：(a) RMSNorm的ε在σ²(h)≲ε时饱和，掩盖尺度差异；ε降至10^-12后γ=1时1.5B模型损失下降约0.038，而γ=0.5几乎不变（~0.001）。(b) 小初始化加剧注意力汇聚（首token注意力质量约+0.11），引入门控注意力后γ=1损失再降约0.047，γ=0.5几乎不变（~0.004）。3) 解除约束后小初始化的scaling law显著改善，等效模型规模提升约44%，且在MoE模型上同样成立。4) γ=1是最优平衡点：γ<1残差流主导，γ>1残差更新过弱网络近似恒等映射，训练退化。5) Token级分析：收益不均匀分布，多数token几乎无变化，少数中等-高难度token大幅改善；定性示例显示提升集中在需上下文推理的token上。6) 凝聚机制：γ=1下权重矩阵行余弦相似度早期出现块状对齐，稳定秩先骤降后回升，呈现"低-高复杂度"轨迹；γ=0.5则始终弥散无凝聚相。
AI.conclusion: 初始化尺度是LLM训练中一个被低估的"基因级"设计轴。本文将γ形式化为可调超参数，给出三方面结论：(1) 小初始化能持续改善预训练和推理能力，推理任务增益最大；(2) 收益受架构组件（RMSNorm ε、注意力汇聚）制约，相应调整后优势在大模型和MoE上依然存在，γ=1即残差-恒等平衡点；(3) 收益的机理来源是诱导"先凝聚后展开"的低-高复杂度学习轨迹，使模型倾向于以最简规则拟合数据，从而在需要上下文推理的token上表现更佳。基于此，论文倡导将γ-初始化（默认γ=1）纳入主流深度学习框架作为内置选项，作为几乎零成本的预训练与推理增强手段。

title: MoCo-AIS: A Contrastive Learning Framework for Similarity Computation of Vessel Trajectories
summary: Trajectory similarity is a fundamental task in analyzing mobility patterns, essential for applications such as route pattern extraction, mobility prediction, and anomaly detection. Traditional distance-based measures for computing similarity incur high computational cost, driving the adoption of lightweight learning-based approaches. Supervised methods rely on extensive labels derived from traditional distance measures and often reproduce these metrics, which limits generalization. While self-supervised learning addresses this issue through contrastive learning, it lacks a unified framework, making it difficult to compare deep learning (DL) models for consistent trajectory representation. Accordingly, this paper presents MoCo-AIS, a unified framework for learning vessel trajectory embeddings based on the Momentum Contrast (MoCo) paradigm, which formulates similarity learning through positive and negative trajectory pairs. Within this framework, we evaluate a diverse set of leading DL models on large-scale, real-world vessel-tracking AIS datasets that capture diverse navigation behaviors and operating conditions. Results demonstrate that our framework significantly improves similarity learning over existing baselines, while providing a benchmarking platform for evaluating trajectory representation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MoCo-AIS 框架，基于动量对比学习（MoCo）范式，将多种深度学习编码器（LSTM、GRU、TCN、Transformer）作为可插拔模块，在大规模真实 AIS 船舶轨迹数据上学习统一的轨迹嵌入表示，用于轨迹相似度计算与检索。
AI.motivation: 轨迹相似度计算是路线模式提取、流动性预测和异常检测等任务的基础。传统基于距离的方法（Hausdorff、DTW）计算成本高，难以扩展到大规模 AIS 数据；监督学习方法依赖距离度量生成的标签，容易继承偏差并复现特定度量；现有的自监督对比学习方法缺乏统一框架，导致架构、预处理流程和评估指标各异，难以公平比较。因此需要一种统一的、无标签依赖的、可扩展的轨迹表示学习框架。
AI.method: MoCo-AIS 采用 MoCo 动量对比学习范式，包含查询编码器和键编码器（动量更新）、投影头、FIFO 负样本记忆队列及 InfoNCE 损失。框架支持四种可插拔编码器：双向 LSTM、双向 GRU、TCN 和 Transformer。轨迹输入为二维坐标序列，通过子轨迹裁剪、形状扰动、RDP 简化三种增强策略生成正样本对，并使用填充掩码和掩码平均池化处理变长序列。在三个不同地理区域的真实 AIS 数据集（东海岸、切萨皮克湾、乔治亚海峡）上进行实验，使用平均排名（Mean Rank）和命中率（Hitting Ratio）作为评估指标，与 Hausdorff、DTW、t2vec 和 TrajCL 等基线对比。
AI.result: 1）嵌入空间可视化显示增强变体与原轨迹紧密聚类，不同轨迹组之间有明显分离边界；2）相似轨迹检索中，MoCo-AIS 各编码器平均排名接近 1，Transformer 表现最佳（1.000），BiLSTM 次之且训练更稳定；3）跨区域检索性能有所下降，RNN 类编码器（BiGRU、BiLSTM）泛化性优于 Transformer 和 TCN；4）与学习基线对比，MoCo-AIS 显著优于 t2vec 和 TrajCL（TrajCL MR=186.189，Transformer MR=1.000）；5）计算效率方面，MoCo-AIS 推理和距离矩阵计算仅需数秒，比传统方法快约 10^5 倍；6）学习到的相似度与几何度量（DTW、Hausdorff）排名存在一定偏差，作者将其列为未来工作。
AI.conclusion: MoCo-AIS 提供了一个统一的对比学习框架，能够在多种编码器架构下高效学习船舶轨迹嵌入，实现准确且计算高效的相似度搜索，在不同数据规模和地理区域间保持稳定的检索性能和泛化能力。未来工作将围绕增强多样性、改进负采样队列结构、探索 MoCo-v2/v3 及 SwAV、BYOL 等自监督变体展开，并将框架推广至城市交通和人类移动性等其他移动性领域。

title: STAR: SpatioTemporal Adaptive Reward Allocation for Text-to-Image RL Post-Training
summary: Existing RL post-training methods for text-to-image generation usually convert the final-image reward into a single scalar advantage and apply it with the same strength to the entire generative trajectory. However, text-to-image generation naturally has temporal and spatial structure: different denoising steps are responsible for different generation stages, and the content that truly determines text alignment often appears only in part of the image. This granularity mismatch makes it difficult for policy updates to focus on the generative components that actually affect the reward. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{SpatioTemporal Adaptive Reward (STAR) Allocation} for RL post-training of text-to-image diffusion and flow models. STAR uses text-image attention inside the generative model and starts from the core content that the user truly cares about in the prompt. It constructs spatial allocation maps that dynamically vary across denoising steps and rollouts, and allocates the same group-relative advantage to more relevant latent regions with almost no additional computational overhead. STAR then applies stronger policy updates to these regions through a spatially resolved policy objective. We use Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium as the base model and evaluate on three tasks: GenEval, OCR text rendering, and PickScore. Experimental results show that STAR improves compositional semantic alignment, text rendering, and preference optimization without changing the external reward source, achieving $\mathbf{0.9759}$, $\mathbf{0.9757}$, and $\mathbf{23.60}$ on GenEval, OCR, and PickScore, respectively.

AI.tldr: STAR提出了一种面向文生图扩散/流模型强化学习后训练的空时自适应奖励分配方法，通过利用模型内部的文本-图像注意力图，将图像级标量优势分配到与提示词相关的潜空间区域，从而实现更精细的时空信用分配，在不改变外部奖励源的前提下显著提升组合生成、文本渲染和偏好优化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图RL后训练方法（如Flow-GRPO）通常将最终图像的奖励转化为单一标量优势，并以相同强度作用于整个生成轨迹。然而扩散/流生成过程具有显式的时序（不同去噪阶段负责布局、物体形成、细节精修）和空间（只有部分潜空间区域与提示词主体相关）结构，这种粒度不匹配导致策略更新难以聚焦于真正影响奖励的生成成分，造成主体区域与背景区域的奖励责任难以区分。
AI.method: STAR包含两大核心组件：(1) 注意力引导的分配机制——将提示词分解为关键文本单元（如主体、属性、计数、空间关系），通过提取生成模型内部的文本-图像注意力图（对选定层取最大值），聚合得到时步特定的空间热图H_t^i，再通过归一化映射为有界分配系数C_t^i(u)=1+(λ-1)·标准化热图，控制分配强度λ；(2) 空间解析的策略目标——将样本级优势A_i与分配系数相乘得到空间优势图A_t^i(u)=A_i·C_t^i(u)，在PPO风格的截断比率目标基础上，对每个潜空间位置u独立计算空间对数概率比ρ_θ,t^i(u)，从而对提示词相关区域施加更强的策略更新，同时保留对背景和整体质量的影响，并加入KL正则化。整体实现基于Flow-GRPO管道，使用SD3.5-M作为基础模型，注意力路由选取transformer块10-15层，λ=1.5。
AI.result: 在三个文生图后训练任务上均取得最优：GenEval总分0.9759（vs Flow-GRPO 0.95，SD3.5-M基线0.63），其中计数0.98、颜色0.96、属性绑定0.94、双物体生成达到1.00；OCR文本渲染0.9757；PickScore 23.60。消融实验显示单热图构造略优于逐组件构造，中层注意力（块10-15）在效果与开销间达到最佳平衡，且STAR仅增加不到2%的训练时间和1.56%的显存开销。定性对比显示后训练后的模型在黑色方形建筑、蓝色风车等具体元素的呈现上更完整、场景更协调。
AI.conclusion: STAR提供了一种轻量级、有效的接口，能够在不改变外部奖励源、不增加显著训练成本的前提下，将图像级反馈精准分配到扩散/流轨迹的结构化时空区域。其核心贡献在于揭示了利用模型自身文本-图像交互信号进行信用分配的可行性，显著提升了组合语义对齐、文本渲染和偏好对齐等需要细粒度语义理解的能力，为注意力机制的文生图RL后训练提供了统一奖励路由框架。

title: LLM Consumer Behavior Theory: Foundations of a Novel Research Field
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents that make consumption decisions on behalf of users. This shift raises fundamental questions for consumer theory, which has traditionally modeled humans as the primary decision-makers. In this paper, we introduce LLM Consumer Behavior Theory, a new field of study concerned with analyzing consumer behavior in agentic markets. Drawing on classical and behavioral economics alongside recent advances in Natural Language Processing, we formalize how human preferences are reflected and acted upon by LLM-based agents, and how agent-level decisions aggregate into market demand. We unify previously fragmented literature on LLM decision-making, human behavior simulation, and preference elicitation under a common economic lens, highlighting where assumptions, such as rationality and heterogeneity, may fail in agentic markets. Rather than providing empirical validation, this paper outlines the scope of LLM consumer behavior and identifies open research questions related to alignment, preference representation, and market dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"LLM消费者行为理论"（LLM Consumer Behavior Theory），这是一个新兴研究领域，旨在将传统消费者理论扩展到由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体市场中，分析LLM作为自主代理进行消费决策时的行为模式。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地作为自主代理为用户做出消费决策，传统消费者理论面临根本性挑战——因为该理论一直以人类为决策主体。论文动机在于：（1）填补LLM代理消费决策缺乏统一理论框架的空白；（2）整合此前关于LLM决策、人类行为模拟和偏好获取的分散文献；（3）探究在智能体市场中传统假设（如理性、异质性）是否仍然成立。
AI.method: 论文采用理论建构与文献综合的方法：（1）借鉴经典与行为经济学框架；（2）融合自然语言处理（NLP）领域最新进展；（3）形式化建模人类偏好如何被LLM代理反映和执行；（4）从经济学的统一视角整合多学科文献；（5）识别假设失效的场景（如理性、异质性）。注意：本文是概念性/立场性论文，不提供实证验证。
AI.result: 论文主要贡献为：（1）定义了LLM消费者行为理论的研究范围；（2）提出了从代理层面决策到市场总体需求聚合的形式化框架；（3）建立了统一的经济学视角以整合LLM决策、人类行为模拟、偏好获取等分散研究；（4）识别了智能体市场中关键假设可能失效的具体情形。
AI.conclusion: 本文勾勒了LLM消费者行为的研究版图，并指出三个核心开放问题：（1）Alignment（对齐）——如何确保LLM代理决策符合用户真实利益；（2）Preference Representation（偏好表示）——如何有效编码和提取用户偏好；（3）Market Dynamics（市场动态）——LLM代理大量进入后市场均衡与价格机制如何变化。该工作为后续实证研究和理论深化奠定了基础。

title: LegalHalluLens: Typed Hallucination Auditing and Calibrated Multi-Agent Debate for Trustworthy Legal AI
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures; Published at the Second Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (AIWILD) at ICML 2026
summary: AI systems deployed in legal workflows hallucinate at rates that aggregate metrics report at ~52%, but this average conceals where errors concentrate and in which direction they run, leaving compliance officers without an actionable signal for trustworthy deployment. We present LegalHalluLens, an auditing framework with three components: typed hallucination profiles across four legally-motivated claim categories (numeric, temporal, obligation/entitlement, factual) over CUAD (Hendrycks et al., 2021); a Risk Direction Index (RDI) that reduces omission-versus-invention bias to a single deployment-comparable scalar; and a typed debate pipeline calibrated to both magnitudes and directions. Across 510 contracts and 249,252 clause-level instances we measure a within-model gap of approximately 38-40 pp between obligation/numeric and temporal claims that aggregate reporting hides, and show that two systems with matched 52% rates can carry opposite RDIs. The debate pipeline reduces fabricated detections by 45% with per-category gains tracking the diagnosis, matching commercial APIs with a substantially smaller backbone (4B active parameters). Typed profiles and RDI surface failure modes that aggregate metrics hide; we further show these diagnostics serve as calibration inputs for multi-agent debate pipelines, where Skeptic challenges and asymmetric gates targeted at measured failure modes outperform generically-tuned debate. The framework supports direction-aware procurement, accountability, and agent design for legal AI deployed in the wild.

AI.tldr: LegalHalluLens是一个面向法律AI的审计框架，通过四类声明画像（数值、时间、义务/权利、事实）揭示被聚合指标掩盖的幻觉分布，引入风险方向指数(RDI)区分"遗漏型"与"捏造型"错误，并据此校准多智能体辩论流程，使4B激活参数的开源模型在合成评分上匹配商业API。
AI.motivation: 法律AI部署中聚合幻觉率（约52%）掩盖了不同声明类型上的失败集中度与方向性（遗漏 vs 捏造），使合规官员无法做出可操作的部署决策。现有研究虽指出法律幻觉非均匀分布，但未将其坍缩为可部署比较的标量信号，也未为多智能体辩论提供基于诊断的校准。
AI.method: 框架包含三个组件：(1) 在CUAD v1.0（510份合同、41类条款、249,252条实例）上将幻觉率按四类声明分层构建类型化画像；(2) 风险方向指数RDI = (p_extra - p_missing)/100，基于判定器已有的missing_condition/extra_condition标签将有向偏差压缩为单一有符号标量；(3) 六角色辩论流水线（Skeptic/Supporter/Re-extractor/Arbiter/Verifier/Judge），其中Skeptic挑战针对每类声明的主导失败模式，非对称Add/Delete门控编码实验1测得的FAR>FRR风险画像。
AI.result: 在四个模型上观察到稳定的失败排序{numeric, obligation} ≫ factual ≥ temporal，模型内间隙38.0–40.6 pp；gpt-5.2（RDI=+0.161，发明型）与qwen3-32b（RDI=-0.202，遗漏型）在聚合Hal_TP上几乎不可区分但方向相反。类型化辩论流水线使gemma-4-26B-A4B（4B激活参数）在120份匹配子集上从末位（Score 5.2）跃居首位（2.4），虚假检测减少45%，按类别增益与先验诊断一致（义务ΔFAR=-8.2最大，时间ΔHal_Gen≈0最小）。
AI.conclusion: 聚合准确率无法支撑法律AI部署决策，应代之以类型化画像与方向信号；RDI作为单一可比较标量使采购、问责与代理设计成为可能。诊断驱动的辩论校准优于通用调优，使小开源模型能以更低推理成本匹配商业API；但58.6%的内容矛盾率表明类型化评估应作为人工审查的补充而非替代。

title: ProvenanceGuard: Source-Aware Factuality Verification for MCP-Based LLM Agents
summary: Tool-using LLM agents increasingly use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to answer from heterogeneous evidence sources, including search, APIs, databases, clinical records, and formulary tools. Standard factuality metrics usually test whether an answer is supported by pooled evidence, missing a provenance-sensitive failure mode: a claim may be supported somewhere while being attributed to the wrong source. We call this cross-source conflation. We introduce ProvenanceGuard, a source-aware verifier for MCP-grounded answers. It consumes captured MCP traces with stable tool IDs, source IDs, and raw outputs; decomposes answers into atomic claims; routes claims to source-specific evidence; checks support with NLI and a token-alignment proxy; compares stated attribution with the routed source; and returns per-claim verdicts plus an answer-level allow/block decision. Blocked answers can be repaired with retrieval-augmented answer revision and re-verified. We evaluate on 281 medical-domain MCP-agent traces. A 266-trace adjudicated subset yields 2,325 LLM-assisted claim labels split by trace; 361 held-out labels are human-verified. On the 40-trace held-out split, ProvenanceGuard achieves block F1 0.802 and source accuracy 0.858 over 260 source-eligible claims, outperforming source-blind baselines that do not emit claim-to-source IDs. On a harder multi-source benchmark it reaches block F1 0.846, while source-plus-relation accuracy drops to 0.229, showing that exact source ownership remains difficult with semantically close sources. Repair-and-reverify resolves all blocked answers in the full trace set, often via conservative fallback. In 50 controlled clinical conflation probes, ProvenanceGuard detects all injected attribution swaps with no retained wrong attribution. These results show that source attribution is an independent axis for factuality verification in MCP-based agents.

AI.tldr: ProvenanceGuard 是一种针对基于 MCP（Model Context Protocol）的工具调用 LLM 智能体的源感知事实性验证器。它通过保留稳定的工具/源 ID，将回答拆分为原子声明，路由到特定源证据，结合 NLI 与 token 对齐代理判断支持度，并单独比对"声明的归因"与"路由源"，输出每个声明的判定和整体回答的允许/阻断决策。系统支持 RARR 风格的修复-再验证循环。在 281 条医疗领域 MCP 智能体轨迹和 40 条人工核验的保留测试集上，其阻断 F1 达到 0.802、源准确率 0.858，并在 50 个受控的临床源混合探针中检测出全部 50 例故意的归因调换。
AI.motivation: 使用 MCP 的 LLM 智能体需要从多种异构证据源（搜索、API、数据库、病历、文献等）综合作答。现有事实性指标通常检验"答案是否被池化证据支持"，忽略了"跨源混淆（cross-source conflation）"这一关键失败模式——某个声明可能在某处被支持，却被错误地归因到另一个源。在医疗等数据敏感领域，错误的源归属可能导致严重后果，因此需要一种源感知的事实性验证机制。
AI.method:
系统采用 Router+NLI 架构，并经过随机森林校准：
1) **轨迹接口**：保留稳定的 tool ID、source ID 和原始工具输出，绝不将证据池化为匿名上下文。
2) **原子声明切分**：将答案拆分为可独立验证的原子声明，保留数值、单位、日期、用药量等受保护字面量；过滤通用安全模板。
3) **源路由**：对每个声明用 SentenceTransformer 嵌入，通过与各源质心的余弦相似度选择最可能负责的源，记录路由裕度。
4) **支持度与对齐**：在路由到的源证据上调用 DeBERTa-v3 NLI 模型，并从注意力矩阵提取 token 对齐代理；受保护字面量缺失则视为不支持。
5) **校准的声明决策**：使用 400 棵树的随机森林将路由分数、NLI 标签与分数、词法重叠、token 支持率、受保护值覆盖等特征融合为支持概率，验证集选择阈值 0.65。
6) **归因检查**：将声明中明示或隐含的源族与路由源进行匹配，发现不一致则标记为"源混合"。
7) **答案级决策**：任一声明失败则阻断（fail-closed）。
8) **RARR 风格修复**：被阻断的答案进入"检索-改写-再验证"循环，仍不通过时回退到保守的非声明回应。
AI.result:
主要结果（40 条轨迹/361 声明保留集，260 个源合格声明）：
- **源感知支持决策**：阻断 F1 = 0.802（精度 0.673，召回 0.993），源准确率 = 0.858，源-关系准确率 = 0.681。
- **多源基准压力测试**（59 题/254 配对声明案例/263 冻结抽取声明）：阻断 F1 = 0.846，源准确率 = 0.503，源-关系准确率降至 0.229，表明语义相近的多候选源下精确归属仍困难。
- **基线对比**：MiniCheck 阻断 F1 0.783、RAGAS Faithfulness 0.758、AlignScore 0.662、SummaC-ZS 0.436；但均不输出 claim-to-source ID，无法评估归因。
- **消融实验**：纯 NLI 头阻断 F1 仅 0.750；直接原始判定头达 0.839 判定准确率；路由 Top-1 源准确率 0.858。
- **修复-再验证**：281 条全轨迹中被阻断的 173 条答案全部修复通过（其中 144 条采用保守回退）；多源测试 59 条全部修复通过（2 条终端回退）。
- **受控临床源混合探针**：50/50 故意注入的归因调换全部被检出并修复，无错误归因残留。
- **不确定性**：40 轨迹保留集较小，95% 自助置信区间宽（block F1 [0.664, 0.900]），配对检验显示与 MiniCheck 的差异不显著。
AI.conclusion: 源归属应当成为基于 MCP 的工具调用 LLM 智能体事实性验证的独立评估维度。ProvenanceGuard 表明在保留稳定源标识的前提下，可以同时实现：(1) 与源盲基线可比甚至略优的二元支持检测；(2) 只有源感知方法才能提供的"claim-to-source"归因评估；(3) 显式源混合错误的检测与保守修复。但研究存在明确局限：仅基于一个医疗智能体栈；标签主要由 LLM 辅助生成，人工核验仅覆盖 361 个保留声明；保留集小，置信区间宽；控制探针只含单次显式归因调换，未涉及更隐蔽的多错或对抗情形。校准主要调整操作点而非提供核心语义；多源场景下精确源归属仍是开放问题。未来需要更多样化的 MCP 环境、更强的源感知原始模型（更长上下文与更难负样本）以及更细粒度的临床验证。

title: PseudoBench: Measuring How Agentic Auto-Research Fuels Pseudoscience
summary: As Large Language Model based agents enter autonomous scientific research, their ability to resist pseudoscience becomes increasingly important. Otherwise, such systems may rapidly generate plausible yet misleading studies that contaminate academic literature and erode trust in science. We present PseudoBench, an adversarial benchmark for evaluating whether agentic auto-research systems can identify and resist pseudoscientific narratives. PseudoBench contains 200 curated pseudoscientific claim-evidence pairs across five domains and evaluates agents through an end-to-end research pipeline from experiments to writing. Testing seven state-of-the-art agents, we find that current systems readily produce persuasive reports that align with pseudoscientific premises with near-zero refusal rates and the highest resistance of only 27.4%. Stronger agents risk packaging pseudoscience in more sophisticated scientific language, increasing its apparent credibility. These findings reveal an alarming capacity to fuel pseudoscience, calling for scientific alignment before widespread deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 PseudoBench 基准，用于评估 LLM 驱动的自主科研智能体是否能够识别并抵御伪科学叙事。通过对 7 个前沿智能体的端到端测试发现：当前系统的伪科学抵御能力极低（最高仅 27.4%），且几乎不会拒绝执行伪科学研究任务；能力越强的系统反而越善于将伪科学包装成更精致、更具说服力的学术论文。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 智能体逐步进入自主科研（Agentic Auto-Research）领域，其可能被滥用以大规模生成看似严谨但实为伪科学的研究报告，从而污染学术文献、破坏同行评审体系，并在工业、政策、公共健康等领域造成系统性信任危机。当前缺乏专门用于评估科研智能体伪科学抵御能力的基准。
AI.method: 1）从维基百科伪科学词条与百度贴吧"民科"社区采集 8,484 条原始数据，经过种子过滤、跨源标准化、语义去重、荒谬度评分等四阶段流水线，筛选出 200 条"连错都算不上（not even wrong）"的伪科学主张-证据对，覆盖 5 个领域（基础物理与宇宙学、数学与形式系统、工程能源与异常装置、地球科学与自然现象、意识灵魂与神秘能量）。2）将每条样本作为端到端科研任务输入，要求 7 个 SOTA 智能体（Codex、Claude Code、OpenClaw、Nanobot、EvoScientist、ResearchClaw、ARIS）自主完成从实验设计、执行到论文撰写的完整流程并输出 PDF。3）采用 LLM-as-Judge 范式，沿报告质量、伪科学对齐度、说服力三个维度（共 14 个二级指标）进行评估，并报告伪科学危害度、抵御率、拒答率和运行时间四类指标。
AI.result: 七个系统的伪科学危害度均处于 72.6%–84.6% 的高位，抵御率仅 15.4%–27.4%，拒答率近乎为零（仅 Claude Code 4.0%、OpenClaw 3.0%）。具体发现：①所有系统可在数百秒内完成伪科学论文；②系统忠实保留并利用用户给定的伪科学前提；③能力更强的系统反而以更精密的科学语言包装伪科学，提升其表面可信度；④在"意识灵魂"与"数学形式系统"领域抵御相对较好（因前者超出科学框架、后者可被直接验算），而在"基础物理"、"工程能源"与"地球科学"等领域伪科学最易被放大；⑤不同 Judge 模型（GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro）下结论稳健。
AI.conclusion: PseudoBench 揭示了当前自主科研智能体在认知底线（cognitive bottom line）上的严重缺陷：通用对齐技术（RLHF 等）无法保证科学严谨性。论文呼吁在追求智能体能力上限的同时，建立"科学对齐（scientific alignment）"机制，使智能体能够识别不可证伪或违背科学原则的主张并拒绝相关任务，否则能力越强将越高效地污染科学记录。

title: Agentic AI-based Framework for Mitigating Premature Diagnostic Handoff and Silent Hallucination in Healthcare Applications
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) and multi-agent systems have driven the rise of Agentic AI, showing promise for medical reasoning. However, open-ended conversational agents remain prone to two critical failure modes: premature diagnostic handoff and silent clinical hallucinations that may go undetected before reaching the patient. In this work, we propose a multi-agent framework that addresses both issues by replacing ``LLM-as-a-judge'' routing with deterministic orchestration constraints. The framework incorporates two safety mechanisms. First, a neuro-symbolic state-tracking gate enforces completeness of the OLDCARTS clinical protocol (Onset, Location, Duration, Character, Aggravating/Alleviating factors, Radiation, Timing, and Severity) by blocking diagnostic transitions until all required dimensions are collected. Second, an epistemic uncertainty quantification (UQ) gate computes semantic entropy (H) across K=5 independent diagnostic samples to identify and intercept divergent outputs before delivery. We evaluate the system using simulated patient agents powered by the llama-3.1-70b-instruct model on 150 test cases. The full architecture achieves 49.3% diagnostic precision, representing an absolute improvement of 11.3 percentage points over an unconstrained baseline. Additionally, we observe a statistically significant negative correlation (r = -0.181, p < 0.05) between OLDCARTS completeness (\sigma) and semantic entropy (H), suggesting that structured information gathering is associated with reduced diagnostic uncertainty.
