AI.motivation: 在大型互联网络（服务器、控制器、内存模块等资源部署场景）中，资源节点故障后的快速本地修复比全局重计算更经济实用。前人对Gaussian网络的局部修复已有研究，但Eisenstein-Jacobi（EJ）六角形网络的修复结构不同（球体为离散六边形，三轴条带几何），且此前缺乏系统理论。本文旨在建立EJ网络中完美资源部署的局部故障修复框架，刻画替换数量、重叠质量及多故障子可加性。
AI.method: 采用代数与组合几何方法：(1) 利用三轴条带结构 |x|≤t, |y|≤t, |x+y|≤t 描述EJ球；(2) 通过六个极端顶点的对偶论证证明单替换不可行；(3) 构造显式两中心覆盖并通过切片论证证明t²的强制重叠下界；(4) 对双故障用三轴条带区间验证显式三球覆盖的存在性，并用两球不可能引理（极端顶点支撑线矛盾）证明最优性；(5) 用端点刚性定理和对角走廊定理封闭可加情形；(6) 用需求打包（demanding packing）方法证明多故障下界；导出多重覆盖的精确包含-排斥恒等式 O(R)=Σ(-1)^j P_j(R)。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 单故障：ρ_EJ(t)=2（对所有t≥1），最小重叠Ω_EJ(t)=t²（严格二次型，与Gaussian的线性重叠不同），存在3t个典范最优修复对；(2) 双故障：ρ^(2)_EJ(t,F)≤4，但存在两个无限非可加族D=±g₂和D=±(g₁+2g₂)使得ρ^(2)=3（节省1个）；可加性由端点刚性和对角走廊定理保证；(3) 多故障：独立修复给出2q上界，当故障中心距离>4t时精确可达；但存在四故障簇C_t的精确修复数为4（独立需8），六故障簇F_t的精确修复数为5（独立需12），分别节省4和7个替换；(4) 审计：19,400个多故障实例（2≤t≤12, 3≤q≤6）确认广泛子可加性。
AI.conclusion: Eisenstein-Jacobi网络的局部故障修复具有与Gaussian网络本质不同的结构特征：(1) 单故障重叠是二次的t²而非线性的；(2) 双故障修复对特定相邻族是非可加的（4→3），这是由六角形球体的三轴条带分割几何造成的；(3) 密集多故障簇可跨多个故障单元重用替换球，实现显著的子可加性（最高节省7个替换）；(4) 任意多故障修复的重叠由精确的包含-排斥恒等式控制。这些结果为基于六角形拓扑的互联网络中的资源容错部署提供了完整的理论工具，支持快速常数大小的本地重配置。

title: Space-Efficient Lock-Free Linear-Probing Hash Table
summary: Linear probing is one of the simplest and most space-efficient approaches to hash table design, and is widely used in sequential settings due to its compact memory layout. However, designing a concurrent linear-probing hash table with strong liveness guarantees has proved difficult, and only a handful of such algorithms have been proposed, all of which either restrict concurrency or rely on large per-entry metadata, thereby compromising space efficiency. We present a lock-free linear-probing hash table with wait-free lookups that retains the core advantages of sequential linear probing while handling contention gracefully. Our design uses only a small amount of metadata per table entry: a constant number of additional bits when using LL/SC, or a logarithmic number of bits when using CAS. The algorithm is linearizable and lock-free, supports insert, delete, and wait-free lookup operations, and is able to safely reclaim space used by deleted elements without rebuilding the table. We analyze the amortized step complexity of our hash table assuming no concurrent insertions of the same key, and show that each operation has expected amortized step complexity matching that of sequential linear probing, up to the point contention per key.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种支持无锁（lock-free）且查找操作无等待（wait-free）的并发线性探测哈希表，仅需每个表项附带常数级（LL/SC 版本）或对数级（CAS 版本）少量元数据，并能复用被删除元素的墓碑（tombstone）而无需重建哈希表，摊还步进复杂度与经典顺序线性探测算法（Knuth 分析）相匹配。
AI.motivation: 线性探测哈希表因紧凑的连续内存布局而在顺序场景中被广泛使用，但在并发场景下设计具有强活跃性保证的算法极为困难。现有并发方案要么限制并发性、依赖锁，要么需在每条目存储大量元数据（如 Purcell-Harris 使用无界时间戳），从而丧失空间效率优势。此外，支持墓碑复用的并发开放寻址哈希表在之前需要周期性的全表重建，缺乏既保证空间效率又避免重建的设计。
AI.method: 作者设计了两种版本的算法：(1) 基于正确配对的 LL/SC 原语，每条目仅需 2 位额外元数据（标签位 tentative/final/revalidate 及状态 EMPTY/TOMBSTONE/DELETED/COLLIDED）；(2) 基于 CAS 原语，使用临时"标记"状态 ⟨⟨v,j⟩, marked⟩ 作为类似 LL/SC 的预留机制，每条目额外需要 min(log m, log n) 位。核心机制包括：插入操作先放置"试探性副本"，竞争副本通过按探测顺序优先级（靠近 h(v) 的副本获胜）相互消除；引入"插入序列"（insert sequences）概念处理同一键的并发插入；采用"重新验证"（revalidate）机制防止已逻辑删除的副本被错误消除；通过"存活副本只能向 h(v) 方向迁移"的不变量保证无环；安全性方面使用向前扫描与向后扫描确保找到所有存活副本。
AI.result: 主要成果包括：定理 1 给出 LL/SC 版本每条目需 ⌈log U⌉+O(1) 位、CAS 版本需 ⌈log U⌉+min{⌈log m⌉, ⌈log n⌉}+O(1) 位的空间上界；算法是线性化（linearizable）且无锁的（lock-free），查找操作是无等待的（wait-free），且可安全复用墓碑而无需重建；定理 21 在无并发相同键插入的简化假设下，证明了在 c-有界固定工作负载调度器下，每个操作的摊还步进复杂度为 O(x²+c)，其中 x 满足已插入元素数为 (1-1/x)m，此上界与 Knuth 的经典顺序线性探测分析一致，仅相差一个关于点争用 c 的加性项；这是首个在并发线性探测哈希表中结合墓碑复用与有界每条目元数据的工作。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了并发哈希表设计中空间效率与强活跃性保证之间的空白，所提出的 LL/SC 版本仅需每条目 m(⌈log U⌉+2) 位总量，是目前最接近信息论下界的无锁并发字典结构。其摊还性能几乎与顺序线性探测相当。未来值得关注的方向包括：设计完全简洁（succinct）的无锁并发字典，达到信息论下界；将该设计推广到动态大小调整（resizing）场景；以及进一步减弱或去除"无并发相同键插入"的运行时分析假设。

title: RISE: Relay Inference and Online Scheduling for Efficient Edge-Device Collaborative Diffusion Model Services
comment: to be published in IEEE ICWS 2026
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models are increasingly deployed at the network edge to serve heterogeneous workloads with diverse quality and latency requirements. However, existing deployment strategies choose either large edge-side models with high fidelity but high latency or lightweight device-side models that offer speed at the cost of semantic coherence. Moreover, these approaches rarely split the denoising workload between models of different sizes across edge servers and user devices. To bridge this gap, we propose RISE, a method for edge-device diffusion model services that combines relay inference with online scheduling. Driven by the finding that the latent intensity exhibits minimal deviation after a model handoff, RISE uses a training-free relay mechanism that exploits the shared latent space within a model family: the large model on the edge handles the early denoising steps that shape semantic structure, then passes the intermediate latent to a small device-side model for detail refinement. To deploy this mechanism as a practical service, a contextual bandit scheduler selects the best relay configuration based on prompt complexity, user preferences, network quality and real-time node loads. Experiments on two benchmarks show that RISE's relay mechanism achieves up to 2.1$\times$ speedup while preserving full-model quality, and its context-aware scheduler effectively balances quality and latency under mixed workloads.

AI.tldr: RISE提出了一种边缘设备协作的扩散模型服务框架，通过"接力推理"机制将去噪过程拆分为边缘大模型（早期语义构建）和端侧小模型（后期细节细化），并结合基于上下文老虎机（LinUCB）的在线调度器，根据提示复杂度、用户偏好、网络质量和节点负载动态选择最优接力配置。在两个基准上实现最高2.1×加速且保持全模型质量。
AI.motivation: 现有部署策略存在两难困境：边缘端大模型质量高但延迟大，端侧小模型速度快但语义一致性差；且现有协作推理方法要么在同构设备上拆分，要么局限于单一模型/分辨率接力，无法在异构边-端算力间有效分割去噪工作负载并适配多样化请求。
AI.method: 1) 接力推理：利用同族扩散模型共享潜空间的特性，通过sigma matching实现大模型到小模型的无缝噪声连续性交接；交接点s∈{5,10,15,20,25}。2) 上下文老虎机调度：将提示复杂度、文本渲染需求、网络质量、低电量标志、用户偏好和三类节点占用率编码为8维上下文向量，采用带softmax采样、频率探索和动态奖励塑形的LinUCB算法，联合选择模型对、接力步和目标节点。
AI.result: 在DiffusionDB和DrawTextCreative两个基准上，RISE Fast配置达到2.10×加速（SDXL）和1.77×加速（SD3.5 Large），同时CLIP/ImageReward/PickScore等质量指标持平甚至优于全模型；调度器在多租户工作负载下总奖励比最强基线PPO高15.74%；消融实验显示上下文特征和动态奖励塑形贡献最大（移除后总奖励分别下降49.7%和51.7%）。
AI.conclusion: RISE通过无需训练的接力机制有效结合了大模型语义保真度与小模型推理速度，LinUCB调度器在多任务混合负载下优于PPO/SAC/RR/Greedy等基线；当前局限在于接力依赖同族共享潜空间，未来可通过轻量级适配器实现跨族潜空间对齐以扩展接力范围。

title: SpecGen: Accelerating Agentic Kernel Optimization with Speculative Generation
summary: Agentic kernel optimization automates manual GPU kernel tuning via iterative generation, validation, and profiling with reasoning LLMs, casting the optimization task as feedback-guided search. However, our workload characterization reveals three system-level inefficiencies that limit search efficiency: (1) long generation latency due to LLM reasoning, (2) insufficient profiling feedback, and (3) underutilized validation/profiling resources. Our key insight is that the ongoing reasoning generation exposes a window for producing additional candidate kernels before it completes, allowing the system to terminate reasoning early once a satisfactory kernel appears. We present SpecGen, an agentic kernel optimization system with \emph{speculative generation}. First, SpecGen forks non-reasoning generations at well-chosen trigger points in the reasoning trace to yield kernels, increasing the candidate kernel count per iteration. These kernels are validated and profiled in parallel with the ongoing reasoning, increasing profiling feedback, and keeping resources busy during generation. When a kernel meets the termination criterion, SpecGen terminates the reasoning generation early to reduce the generation latency. Second, SpecGen dynamically reallocates validation and profiling GPU pools based on the arrival rate and prioritizes requests to reduce profiling feedback latency under bursty speculative generation load. Furthermore, SpecGen utilizes spare memory of the validation/profiling GPUs as remote KV cache storage to eliminate prefix recomputation of speculative generations under limited memory budget. Experiments with two reasoning LLMs on H200 show that SpecGen reduces end-to-end time over three baseline systems, while producing more profiling feedback, increasing resource utilization, and improving kernel speedup under a fixed time and token budget.

AI.tldr: SpecGen 是一种面向智能体（Agentic）GPU 内核优化任务的系统，通过在迭代级别引入"投机生成"机制（speculative generation），利用推理 LLM 输出的前缀并行派生非推理生成，从而在推理完成前获得更多候选内核，缩短生成延迟并提升验证/剖析资源利用率。
AI.motivation: 基于推理 LLM 的智能体内核优化流程存在三项系统级低效问题：(C1) LLM 推理导致生成阶段耗时占比极高（70–99%），限制了固定时间预算下的迭代次数；(C2) 仅 36–41% 的迭代能产出有效反馈；(C3) 验证/剖析 GPU 利用率仅 4.2–17.6%，长期空闲。现有方法（多推理生成、Best-of-K、多智能体、进化搜索）要么成倍增加 token 开销，要么在非推理生成时无法产出有效内核。
AI.method: SpecGen 由两个组件构成：① **SpecController**：在推理输出的关键设计决策（如 tile 形状、fenced 代码块、完整 kernel 函数体、实现意图短语）处触发，分叉出 K 个非推理"投机生成"，与正在进行的推理生成并行执行；当任一投机内核超过历史平均加速比（mean(H)）时立即终止推理生成以缩短生成延迟。② **ElasticScheduler**：基于上一轮最大队列长度动态在验证与剖析之间再分配 GPU 池；验证队列采用 LAF（后到先服务，优先处理含更长前缀的更新鲜候选），剖析队列采用 FIFO；并将剖析/验证 GPU 的空闲显存作为远程 KV 缓存（基于 Mooncake RDMA 后端）以避免投机生成的前缀重计算。系统无需改动底层 LLM 与搜索算法。
AI.result: 在 H200 集群、使用 GLM-5.1 与 DeepSeek-V4-Pro、KernelBench Level 1/2/3 共 20 个任务、100 次迭代预算下：端到端时间相对 CudaForge / AlphaEvolve / KernelAgent 几何平均加速 1.68×–1.82×；剖析反馈提升 1.58×–1.98×；验证/剖析资源利用率由 4.2–17.6% 提升至 88.2–96.1%；在固定时间与 token 预算下最终内核加速比提升 1.24×–1.91×。消融显示投机生成贡献最大（1.00×→1.46×），资源再分配、优先队列、远程前缀缓存依次再贡献 0.15×、0.08×、0.09×。Token 总开销仅为 CudaForge 的 0.98×。在 Level 2/3 更难任务上同样有效，平均提速 1.57×，内核加速比从 0.49× 提升至 1.42×。终止阈值可调：first-valid 最短耗时、hist-best 最高性能，hist-avg 为默认折中。
AI.conclusion: SpecGen 通过迭代级别的投机生成解决了智能体内核优化中长期存在的生成延迟、剖析反馈不足与验证/剖析资源闲置三大系统级低效问题。该工作与 token 级投机解码正交，也与基于训练的内核优化方法互补，可同时叠加使用，在不修改 LLM 与搜索算法的前提下显著提升端到端效率与最终内核性能。

title: Local Fault Repair of Perfect Resource Placements in Dense Gaussian Networks
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Computers. Preprint also available on Zenodo: this https URL
summary: Perfect resource placement in dense Gaussian networks partitions the network into Lee balls centered at resource nodes. The fault-free placement problem is already classified; this paper studies the complementary post-deployment problem of repairing such placements after resource faults. The paper gives exact local repair theorems for the dense Gaussian placement generated by $t+(t+1)i$; by conjugation and rotation symmetry, the same results hold for the companion generator $(t+1)+ti$. For one failed resource, we prove failure-cell locality, derive the exact replacement number $\rho_G(1)=3$ and $\rho_G(t)=2$ for all $t\ge2$, and prove the sharp minimum-overlap formula $\Omega_G(t)=t+1$ among minimum-size repairs. The overlap lower bound is proved from the corner structure of equal-size Lee balls in the rotated coordinates $u=x+y$ and $v=x-y$, where Gaussian Lee balls become parity-constrained squares. For two failed resources, we prove exact additivity: every pair of failed resource cells requires exactly four local replacements for $t\ge2$, and four always suffice. The two-fault lower bound reduces all relevant resource displacements to two canonical neighboring cases and exhibits four mutually incompatible failed-cell corners in each case. For multi-failure repairs, we prove a general inclusion--exclusion identity for overlap inside the failed region; hence the formula remains exact for arbitrary higher-order dense cores. When a canonical repair instance is certified to have maximum multiplicity three, the identity reduces to the compact correction $\Omega_{\rm extra}=P_2-A-C_3$. A ground-truth audit over 7,494 Gaussian cases recomputes coverage from lattice geometry, verifies all exact formulas, and records reproducible multiplicity witnesses.

AI.tldr: 本文研究稠密高斯网络中完美资源布局在部署后出现资源节点故障时的局部修复问题。通过旋转坐标系将Lee球转化为奇偶约束正方形，给出了单故障、双故障修复数量的精确公式，并证明了多故障场景下基于容斥原理的重叠质量恒等式。
AI.motivation: 高斯互连网络的无故障完美资源布局问题已由Mary-Bose分类解决，但部署后资源节点发生故障时的局部修复问题尚未研究。与预设计全局容错资源集不同，本文关注后部署场景下如何用最少的就近替换资源恢复t-支配，并精确量化故障球内不可避免的覆盖重叠。
AI.method: 1. 引入旋转坐标 u=x+y, v=x-y，将高斯Lee球转化为奇偶约束正方形；2. 利用等度量映射 Φ(z)=iz̄ 证明两种伴随生成子 t+(t+1)i 与 (t+1)+ti 的局部修复等价性；3. 通过Lee球极值点论证单替换不可能，对偶角点对论证t=1的特例外；4. 构造对角/反对角修复对覆盖故障球；5. 利用角点不兼容性将双故障归约为两种规范相邻位移；6. 基于二项式恒等式推导逐顶点的容斥重叠公式；7. 对7,494个高斯实例进行格几何审计验证。
AI.result: 1. 失败球局部性定理：故障后未覆盖顶点恰在失败Lee球内；候选局部性：有用替换候选位于距离2t内；2. 单故障精确修复数：ρ_G(1)=3，ρ_G(t)=2（t≥2）；3. 单故障最小重叠公式：Ω_G(t)=t+1（t≥2），由旋转坐标切片下界和对角构造达到紧致；4. 双故障精确可加性：ρ_G^(2)(t,Δ)=4（t≥2），四种互不相容角点迫使至少四个替换；5. 多故障一般重叠恒等式 O(R)=Σ(-1)^j P_j(R)；6. 三重核心特化：最大重数≤3时，Ω_extra=P_2-A-C_3；7. 7,494个实例审计验证所有精确公式，最大重数证书为3。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了稠密高斯网络中完美资源布局故障后局部修复的精确理论框架。核心贡献包括：单故障和双故障修复数量的闭合公式及其最小重叠界、多故障场景下基于容斥原理的一般重叠恒等式，以及三重核心特化条件。旋转坐标系下Lee球到奇偶约束正方形的几何转译是贯穿全文的关键工具。审计计算验证了理论结果的可重现性，为高斯互连网络的实际容错部署提供了严格的数学基础。

title: Multi-Orientation Edge-Minimum Repair for Non-Redundant Fault-Tolerant Broadcasting in Dense Gaussian Networks
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Computers. Preprint also available on Zenodo: this https URL
summary: Dense Gaussian networks are degree-four algebraic interconnection networks with compact diameter and simple modular routing. This paper studies non-redundant one-to-all broadcast repair in the dense Gaussian network generated by $\alpha=k+(k+1)i$. We propose multi-orientation edge-minimum repair (MOEM), which evaluates a constant-size family of Gaussian broadcast-tree orientations, selects a fault-aware orientation, contracts the fault-pruned tree into healthy components, and reconnects those components using external component-crossing repair edges. The resulting structure is a rooted spanning tree of the healthy subgraph, so each healthy node receives the message exactly once and no faulty node is used. We prove that, for a chosen orientation with $c$ fault-pruned components and a connected healthy component graph, the repair step is non-redundant and uses the minimum possible number $c-1$ of external component-repair edges. We also prove that, for every one- or two-fault placement, the MOEM orientation family contains a repair with depth at most $k+2$. The depth proof combines a certificate framework, an explicit four-case off-axis analysis, and a five-component orthogonal-axis certificate. Exhaustive validation for $k=5,\ldots,10$ and large-scale validation through $k=200$ confirm the implementation and show that random two-fault repairs use approximately two external repair edges.

AI.tldr: 本文针对稠密高斯网络($\alpha=k+(k+1)i$ 生成)提出了多朝向边最小修复(MOEM)方法,用于1-2个处理器故障下非冗余一对全广播的局部修复。核心思想是评估8种确定性高斯广播树朝向,选择故障感知朝向,使用恰好$c-1$条外部跨越边连接健康组件,并证明修复深度不超过$k+2$。
AI.motivation: 一对全广播是并行/分布式系统的基本集体通信原语。非冗余广播(每个健康节点恰好接收一次)可避免重复流量和资源争用,正确性条件是形成健康子图的根生成树。单一固定的高斯广播树容易因主干故障而被分割;现有BFS重建方法会替换$\Theta(N)$条父边,代价过高。需要一种能保持直径级树结构、仅使用最小数量外部修复边、并控制修复深度的局部修复机制。
AI.method:
1. **网络模型**:稠密高斯网络$G_k$节点集$\mathbb{Z}_N$($N=k^2+(k+1)^2$),边为$\pm k$和$\pm(k+1)$,通过映射$\phi$与曼哈顿球$B_k$双射对应。
2. **8种确定性朝向**:包括x优先、y优先、符号偏好、较大/较小坐标优先等,构成常量大小朝向族。
3. **边最小组件修复**:删除故障后形成森林,构造组件图,贪心选择使预测深度$D(a,b,C)=dist(s,a)+1+ecc_C(b)$最小的跨组件边,每次将一个未修复组件接入已修复部分。
4. **$k+2$深度证明框架**:证书引理将局部附着不等式转化为全局深度界;按故障类型分四类模板——单故障、同轴/对轴双故障、分离偏轴O3(四种情况)、正交轴O6(五组件分解),均为每种配置显式构造附着顺序。
5. **复杂度**:每个朝向处理$O(N)$时间,常量倍数总开销$O(N)$。
AI.result:
1. **组件修复最优性**:对于所选朝向,健康组件图连通时,修复恰好使用$c-1$条外部跨组件边(下界由组件下界引理保证,上界由算法构造保证),且修复结果为非冗余广播树。
2. **深度界**:对任意1-2故障配置,$k\geq 5$时MOEM朝向族中存在某朝向的边最小修复深度$\leq k+2$。
3. **实验验证**:对$k=5,\ldots,10$穷举62,768个故障案例,100%成功,最大深度$k+2$,最大修复边数4;大规模随机验证$k=10,25,50,100,200$各1000次,平均修复边数$\approx|F|$,$k\geq 25$时无回退。
4. **难例识别**:发现6个正交轴签名案例仅有一个"好"朝向,验证了balanced-smaller-first朝向的不可替代性。
5. **固定朝向基线对比**:MOEM修复边数随$k$基本保持$\approx|F|$,而固定朝向局部修复在主干压力下随$k$增长。
AI.conclusion: MOEM为稠密高斯网络提供了一种高效、具备严格理论保证的非冗余故障容忍广播修复机制:组件修复定理适用于任意故障数(只要健康组件图连通),深度证书定理对$\leq 2$个故障证明了$k+2$的紧致深度界。组件修复代价$O(q)$($q$为故障数)对一般故障数成立。开放问题:三故障深度证书的完整分类(共线三轴故障可由嵌套区间证书处理,非共线组合是下一步重点)。该方法与BFS重建、预计算树多样性方法目标不同,是最小化外部跨组件修复边数这一目标下的最优局部修复方案。

title: AoiZora: Topology-Aware Auto-Parallel Optimization for Inference of Diffusion Transformers
summary: Video diffusion has quickly grown into a key generative serving workload, yet producing each clip demands many denoising iterations over large spatio-temporal latents, which puts low-latency inference out of reach on a single device. A denoising step is therefore typically distributed across multiple accelerators, and TPU sub-slices have become an attractive and practical fabric for doing so. Current auto-parallel systems, however, search almost exclusively over logical device meshes and disregard how a chosen sharding is actually laid out on the physical TPU interconnect -- an oversight that leaves large, topology-dependent performance on the table. We address this gap with AoiZora, a compiler-mediated topology planner built for low-latency video diffusion inference on TPU sub-slices. Its guiding principle is to reconnect logical sharding with physical placement by drawing on different points in the compilation flow: AoiZora first eliminates weak sharding candidates from inexpensive pre-compilation IRs, then compiles only the ones that survive and orders their physical placements using compiled HLO together with a topology-aware communication model. The winning plan is realized along the ordinary compiler path, leaving model code, compiler lowering, collective kernels, and network routing entirely intact. On TPU v5e sub-slices, AoiZora reduces Wan 2.1 one-step denoising latency by as much as 1.42x relative to existing solutions.

AI.tldr: AoiZora 是一个针对 TPU 子切片上视频扩散 Transformer 推理的、编译器介导的拓扑感知自动并行规划器。它通过两阶段搜索——先利用廉价的预编译 IR（StableHLO/Shardy）剪枝逻辑分片策略，再对幸存者进行完整 XLA 编译并基于编译后 HLO 集合通信图进行物理拓扑感知排序——在不修改模型代码、编译器底层或集合通信实现的前提下，将逻辑分片与物理放置重新关联。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散推理中，去噪步骤在大型时空潜变量上反复执行，单设备难以满足低延迟需求，必须跨多加速器分布。现有自动并行系统几乎只搜索逻辑设备网格，忽略分片在物理 TPU 互连上的实际布局，导致显著的、由拓扑决定的性能损失。作者通过 Wan 2.1 在 v5e-8 上的实验证明：相同逻辑分片的不同物理放置可造成高达 16.6% 的端到端单步去噪延迟差异，主要源于共享链路的争用而非跳数。
AI.method: AoiZora 的核心是"编译器保真度感知搜索"：第一阶段（Pre-Compile Stage）枚举 DiT 的工作负载轴（batch、token、head、hidden、MLP）作为分片候选，通过 JAX→StableHLO→Shardy 流水线降级，得到带分片注释的预测 DAG；插入隐式通信节点以模拟后端集合通信，并使用稳态吞吐上界 Q1 = max(C_comp, C_comm − C_ar) + C_ar 进行剪枝，仅保留 Top-K 逻辑分片。第二阶段（Post-Compile Stage）仅对幸存者执行完整 XLA 编译，枚举不同的物理轴顺序（即逻辑 mesh 到物理 TPU 坐标的映射），解析优化后的 HLO 提取集合类型、payload、replica group 和异步元数据，重建物理集合几何，并使用拓扑感知评分 Q2（包含按物理维度调度的资源模型和共享链路争用惩罚）排序 sharding-placement 对。最终选定的 plan 通过标准 JAX/XLA 执行路径实现，不改动模型代码、编译器降级、集合核或网络路由。规划可离线进行并按模型/形状/分配缓存，摊销到多次推理执行上。
AI.result: 在 TPU v5e-4/8/16 子切片、6 种 480p/720p × 21/41/81 帧的 Wan 2.1 负载上，AoiZora 相对专家调参的现有部署的几何平均加速比为 1.09×，相对 Alpa 启发的逻辑搜索基线为 1.11×，最高加速比分别达 1.42× 和 1.37×；在 v5e-4 上几乎无提升（拓扑自由度小），在 v5e-8/16 上收益显著。两阶段保真度：Pre-Compile 阶段 Spearman ρs 在 0.655–0.840 之间且在所有评估设置中均保留 top-1 逻辑分片（3/3 召回），Post-Compile 阶段 ρs 提升至 0.817–0.985。消融实验显示：仅用 Pre-Compile top-1 时延迟差距为 2.7%–81.9%，而单块代理的放置排序相关性 ≤ 0.371，验证了两阶段和双块代理的必要性。离线规划时间在 v5e-16 上为 250–376 秒，v5e-8 为 112–145 秒，v5e-4 为 47–108 秒，对于一次性配置生成具有实用性。
AI.conclusion: 在 TPU 子切片上部署视频扩散推理时，逻辑分片与物理放置的脱节是主要的性能瓶颈。AoiZora 通过将拓扑感知规划置于编译器规划边界（同时具备张量语义和后端集合图）解决了该问题：以廉价预编译 IR 做高召回逻辑分片剪枝，以完整编译 HLO 做精准放置排序，在不改模型代码、编译器降级、集合实现或路由的前提下提供可执行的并行方案。该工作论证了编译器介导的拓扑规划是一条相比单纯依赖逻辑 mesh 抽象更优的路径。

title: From GPU to Microcontroller: Online Ridge Regression for Edge-Deployable Traffic Prediction
comment: 8 pages, IEEE Intelligent Transportation Systems Conference, 2026
summary: State-of-the-art traffic flow forecasting models, including Graph Convolutional Networks and graph-less MLPs, require centralized GPU training across all sensors, making them impractical for resource-constrained intelligent transportation deployments. We show that much of this complexity is unnecessary. A parametric analysis of the recent graph-less model GLMST reveals that reducing its internal embedding dimension from 64 to 4 degrades MAPE by less than one percentage point, suggesting that the model's effective capacity far exceeds what the task requires. Motivated by this finding, we replace the neural architecture entirely with per-sensor Ridge regression using horizon-aligned periodic features, combined with Recursive Least Squares (RLS) for online adaptation. With only 444 parameters per sensor (80x fewer than GLMST) and test-time online adaptation, our method achieves the best MAPE on three of four PEMS benchmarks, and remains within one percentage point on the fourth. Because each sensor's model is self-contained and involves only elementary linear algebra, the entire pipeline (training, inference, and online adaptation) runs on edge hardware without a GPU. An ESP32 microcontroller (160 MHz, 520 KB SRAM) completes cold-start training in 7.4s and each predict-and-update in under 2ms with zero heap allocation; a single Raspberry Pi 5 core completes cold-start training in 0.21s and each predict-and-update in 0.26ms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于每传感器Ridge回归的交通流预测方法，替代现有GCN/MLP模型，使用horizon-aligned周期特征和递归最小二乘(RLS)在线自适应。该方法仅需444个参数/传感器（比GLMST少80倍），在4个PEMS基准中3个取得最佳MAPE，并成功在ESP32微控制器（冷启动训练7.4s，推理更新<2ms，零堆分配）和Raspberry Pi 5上部署，实现完全分布式的边缘推理。
AI.motivation: 当前主流的交通流预测模型（GCN、图无关MLP等）都需要在GPU上集中式训练所有传感器数据，难以部署在资源受限的智能交通系统(ITS)中。这些模型架构复杂度不断增长，边际收益却递减。GLMST虽去除了图卷积，但仍需集中式GPU训练。作者通过分析GLMST的过参数化现象（输入为单标量流，隐藏表示本质为秩-1），质疑神经时序混合器的必要性，探索能否用极简线性模型替代。
AI.method:
方法包含三个关键设计：
1. **Horizon-aligned周期特征**：为每个预测horizon h构造36维特征向量 = 12个recent lags + 12个daily-aligned lags (t+h-288-j) + 12个weekly-aligned lags (t+h-2016-j)。关键创新是周期性滞后与目标时间对齐而非输入窗口对齐，避免1-2pp MAPE退化。
2. **每传感器Ridge回归**：每个传感器每个horizon独立拟合Ridge模型（α=1.0），闭式解通过Cholesky分解避免显式求逆，总参数 = 12×37=444/传感器。无共享参数，无集中训练。
3. **RLS在线自适应**：用Sherman-Morrison公式从批量Ridge解warm-start P₀和w₀，测试时用遗忘因子λ（0.998~0.9995）增量更新，O(d²)每步操作。
4. **流式X^TX累加**：在ESP32上避免1.2MB堆分配，逐样本计算特征向量。
5. **GLMST参数分析**：理论证明输入投影产生秩-1矩阵（d_in=1），通过网格搜索(e∈{1,2,4}, s∈{8,16,24,32}, L∈{2,3,4})验证e=4已足够。
AI.result:
**主要性能**（表II，MAPE）：
- PEMS03: RLS Ridge 13.78% vs GLMST 14.74%（最佳，-0.96pp）
- PEMS04: RLS Ridge 13.04% vs GLMST 12.46%（差0.58pp）
- PEMS07: RLS Ridge 8.50% vs GLMST 8.76%（最佳，-0.26pp）
- PEMS08: RLS Ridge 8.82% vs GLMST 9.78%（最佳，-0.96pp）
- 3/4数据集MAPE最优，1个差距<1pp

**复杂度**（表III，PEMS03）：
- 参数：GLMST 35,585 → GLMST(4,24,4) 2,157 → Static Ridge 444 → RLS Ridge 444
- 推理FLOPs：GLMST 974K → GLMST(4,32,4) 46K → Ridge 876（>1000×降低）
- 训练时间：PEMS07上Ridge 3分钟 vs GLMST 78分钟（GPU V100）

**消融**：
- 仅有recent lags: 20.14% MAPE
- 添加周期特征: 15.47%（-4.67pp）
- RLS在线自适应: 13.78%（再-1.69pp）
- 空间邻接特征反而降低性能（线性模型无法捕获非线性空间交互）

**边缘部署**（表V）：
- ESP32 (160 MHz, 520KB SRAM)：冷启动训练7.4s，预测+更新1.93ms/12h，5KB峰值栈，零堆分配，285KB flash
- Raspberry Pi 5 (2.4 GHz)：训练0.21s/传感器，预测+更新0.26ms，4核可处理170个PEMS08传感器17.5ms/step
- ESP32存储：原始流量69.8KB + 模型状态30.5KB + 标准化参数2.4KB
AI.conclusion: 本文通过GLMST的参数分析揭示了交通流预测中神经模型的过度参数化现象：由于输入是单标量流，隐藏表示本质为秩-1，64维embedding的有效容量≤4维。这促使作者用每传感器Ridge回归（horizon-aligned周期特征 + RLS在线自适应）完全替代神经架构。该方法以80×更少的参数在多数PEMS基准上达到或超越神经基线，并首次实现交通流预测在微控制器级设备（ESP32）上的端到端部署，包括训练和在线自适应，零堆分配。贡献包括：（1）揭示GLMST过参数化的结构原因；（2）提出参数效率极高的线性模型并实现最佳/接近最佳精度；（3）验证完全分布式边缘部署的可行性。未来工作将探索传感器间通过紧凑模型摘要而非原始数据的协调机制，以及边缘可部署每传感器模型的基本精度极限。

title: LUMEN: Coordinated Failure Recovery for Distributed LLM Serving
summary: Modern large language model (LLM) serving clusters distribute inference requests across multiple worker processes on different GPUs, but failures are prevalent at scale. When a worker fails, the cluster simultaneously loses the failed worker's GPU-resident key-value (KV) caches and serving capacity, leaving surviving workers to absorb the redirected traffic while re-running interrupted requests from scratch. Existing fault-tolerant systems either restart interrupted requests from scratch or restore KV caches from checkpoints stored on a fixed neighboring worker, but both approaches route recovery work without considering current cluster load and leave the recovering worker idle during model reload. We present LUMEN, a fault-tolerant LLM serving system that treats recovery as a load-aware coordination problem across three decision points: checkpoint placement before failures, interrupted-request distribution at failure time, and serving capacity restoration during model reload. We evaluate LUMEN using both prototype experiments and large-scale simulations and demonstrate significant improvements in serving and recovery times.

AI.tldr: LUMEN是一个面向分布式LLM推理服务的容错系统，将故障恢复建模为负载感知的协调问题，通过三个关键机制（负载感知的KV检查点放置、局部性感知的恢复调度、推测解码辅助的渐进式恢复）显著降低worker故障后的TTFT、TPOT和恢复时间，且不引入稳态开销。
AI.motivation: 生产级LLM推理集群（>10,000 GPU）面临频繁的worker级故障（GPU错误、节点崩溃、网络故障等），导致：(1) GPU上KV cache丢失，(2) 推理服务容量下降。现有方案存在局限：Stop-and-Restart从零重算prefill，对长上下文请求代价高昂；Fixed-Checkpointing（如DéjàVu）静态指定邻居作为检查点持有者，会造成恢复热点；两者都使recovering worker在模型重载期间闲置。根因分析显示，单worker故障可使TTFT增4.0×、TPOT增1.6×，且该退化在4-64 worker规模下持续存在；中断请求的重放TTFT是无中断请求的5.9-8.4×。
AI.method: LUMEN包含三个协同机制：(1) **负载感知KV检查点**：集中式控制器维护负载表（队列延迟、可用存储、预留KV空间）和放置表，按 h(r)=arg min(q_w+λ·p_w(r)) 选择检查点持有者；通过页面标签（基于token序列哈希）实现任意worker的KV前缀恢复；异步双阶段pipeline（pinned CPU buffer→checkpoint store）不阻塞GPU关键路径。(2) **局部性感知恢复调度**：优先将中断请求路由至其检查点持有者以最大化KV复用；当持有者过载时，按"平均请求数"规则迁移部分请求，按checkpointed前缀长度升序迁移以最小化重算代价；通过部分prefill补全未检查点后缀。(3) **推测解码辅助渐进恢复**：recovering worker经历LOADING_DRAFT→ASSIST→HOTSWAP→FULL_SERVICE四状态；在target model后台加载时，加载轻量draft model向最拥塞的存活worker发送mirror request的推测token；单次融合batch中K+1位置统一结构（K draft + 1 committed）实现单次前向验证；按位置对齐draft KV缓存；后台预加载target权重至host内存，hot-swap时仅需快速host-to-GPU传输。架构增强SGLang gateway和引入集中式controller。
AI.result: **原型实验**（基于SGLang + Qwen3-32B/14B，4/8 worker集群）：(1) 单worker故障下，4-worker部署mean TTFT降低44.4%、TPOT降低15.9%、恢复时间降低50%（vs Stop-and-Restart）；8-worker部署mean TTFT降低29.6%、恢复时间降低64.1%。(2) 故障影响窗口内，无稳态开销（曲线与No-Failure重合）。(3) 故障数扩展：4个worker同时故障时，TTFT比Stop-and-Restart降低82.7%。(4) 路径分解：+Scheduling（仅KV复用）降TTFT 19.1%，+Progressive（仅推测路径）降TTFT 18.5%，两者互补。**大规模仿真**（基于Vidur + Llama-3-70B）：(5) 10-worker部署：mean TPOT降低22.6%（vs S&R）、17.6%（vs F-Ckpt），恢复时间降低18.7%/14.1%。(6) 比例故障率（25%）下4-64 worker扩展：TTFT稳定降低46.8-51.2%，TPOT降低30.7-43.8%。(7) 5个worker同时故障时TTFT降低63.6%（vs S&R）、33.9%（vs F-Ckpt）。(8) 推测深度K∈{2,4,8}和权重λ∈{0.25,4}敏感度均<0.5%（在置信区间内）。
AI.conclusion: LUMEN将分布式LLM服务的故障恢复视为跨三个决策点（检查点放置、请求分发、容量恢复）的负载感知协调问题，通过将检查点分布到多worker、动态调度中断请求、利用推测解码填充模型重载窗口，实现了显著的服务质量提升。系统在故障严重度高、集群负载高、失败比例大时增益最显著（TTFT最高降低82.7%），在4-64 worker规模下保持稳定优势，且不引入可测量的稳态开销。未来工作包括多检查点复制以应对检查点持有者自身故障。LUMEN的代码和仿真器将开源。

title: An Epistemic Analysis of Random Coordinated Attack
summary: The coordinated attack problem models the challenge of coordinating a joint action within a bounded time by communicating over unreliable links. It was the first distributed computing problem proven unsolvable. Its analysis also revealed the importance of common knowledge, a central concept in epistemic logic. However, the randomized version of coordinated attack, which is solvable, has not, to the best of our knowledge, been studied through the lens of probabilistic epistemic logic, where processes generate randomness by flipping coins. We present an epistemic logic framework for studying randomized algorithms that execute for a bounded number of rounds. The framework applies to coordinated attack, approximate agreement, and consensus, and supports dynamic graph models: synchronous systems in which reliable processes execute a bounded number of rounds while an adversary determines which messages are lost. Our approach combines techniques from the logical characterization of dynamic networks and task solvability with ideas from probabilistic dynamic epistemic logic. It is inspired by the operational model of Varghese and Lynch for randomized coordinated attack. More broadly, the resulting notion of probabilistic epistemic task solvability provides a foundation for the epistemic study of randomized distributed computation. Using this framework, we analyze the Varghese-Lynch algorithm from a knowledge-theoretic perspective, providing a formal treatment of the algorithm and its lower bound. As a byproduct, we strengthen the lower bound and show it is tight. The proof relies on indistinguishability arguments, demonstrating that reasoning about knowledge remains essential in the probabilistic setting. We also formalize the notion of information level introduced by Varghese and Lynch, showing that it corresponds to a specific epistemic formula.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个有界轮次随机算法的概率认知逻辑框架，将其应用于协同攻击、近似一致性和共识等问题，并使用该框架形式化分析了Varghese-Lynch随机协同攻击算法，证明了其下界是紧的。
AI.motivation: 协同攻击问题是分布式计算中首个被证明不可解的问题，其确定性版本在不可靠通信下无解，但随机化版本是可解的。然而，现有的概率认知逻辑研究未能在统一框架下分析有界轮次运行的随机分布式算法，缺乏对随机化分布式计算的认知（知识）层面的形式化研究。Varghese-Lynch操作模型虽然刻画了随机协同攻击算法，但缺乏逻辑刻画和下界的紧性证明。
AI.method: 1. 提出概率认知逻辑框架，结合动态网络逻辑特征化技术、任务可解性理论与概率动态认知逻辑（probabilistic dynamic epistemic logic）的思想。2. 适用于同步系统模型：可靠进程执行有界轮次，对手（adversary）决定消息丢失（动态图模型）。3. 定义概率认知任务可解性（probabilistic epistemic task solvability）概念。4. 将Varghese-Lynch算法在认知逻辑框架下进行形式化，重新定义其下界并证明其紧性。5. 使用不可区分性（indistinguishability）论证来证明相关结果。6. 形式化"信息层级"（information level）概念，揭示其对应的特定认知公式。
AI.result: 1. 建立了适用于有界轮次随机分布式算法的统一概率认知逻辑框架。2. 形式化分析了Varghese-Lynch协同攻击算法。3. 强化了Varghese-Lynch的下界结果，并证明该下界是紧的（tight）。4. 揭示了信息层级概念对应于一个特定的认知公式，为信息层级提供了逻辑刻画。5. 表明在概率设定下，推理关于"知识"仍然是本质性的工具。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为随机化分布式计算的认知研究提供了基础，通过概率认知任务可解性的概念和统一框架，连接了动态网络逻辑、概率动态认知逻辑和分布式计算任务可解性理论。对Varghese-Lynch算法的形式化分析表明：即使在概率环境下，基于知识的推理仍然不可或缺；该算法的下界是紧的，且"信息层级"具有清晰的认知逻辑对应物。

title: RouteBalance: Fused Model Routing and Load Balancing for Heterogeneous LLM Serving
summary: Heterogeneous LLM serving stacks split scheduling into two layers that optimize in isolation: model routers pick a model from quality and cost signals while ignoring instance load, and serving load balancers optimize queues while ignoring quality. We present RouteBalance, a serving-aware scheduling layer that fuses both into a single online assignment over concrete model instances, jointly trading off quality, latency, and cost. A batched in-process predictor stack and dead-reckoned instance state keep the joint decision cheap on the request hot path ($\approx$32 ms at 12 req/s). On a 13-instance, 28-GPU heterogeneous cluster serving four model sizes, a single deployed RouteBalance stack traces the upper region of the three-way quality-cost-throughput frontier. Sweeping one weight vector reaches both the highest routing-decision quality (DeepEval $0.419$, $+0.013$ over the strongest baseline, $95\%$ CI $[{+}0.005,{+}0.022]$; the ordering holds when a second judge re-scores the actually served text) and, at its cost-priority corner, per-request cost that ties the cheapest baseline. With router engineering equalized against concurrent-scoring baseline variants we build, its balanced preset serves at $2.8$ s and $30$ req/s, leading $2.6$ to $4.1\times$ ahead of enhanced BEST-Route at high load. (Deploying those routers as published, one serial scoring call per request, makes them collapse $23\times$ under load, a deployment-architecture effect we isolate separately, not the routing result.) A four-arm isolation shows the benefit follows from pricing latency at model-selection time; the learned predictors contribute calibration and SLO headroom rather than the headline frontier. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: RouteBalance 提出了一种面向异构 LLM 集群的融合调度层，将模型路由（model routing）与负载均衡（load balancing）合并为对具体模型实例的在线分配问题，在质量–延迟–成本三维权衡上由单一部署栈通过调整权重向量同时占据两端。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 服务栈将调度拆为两个独立层：模型路由器只依据质量与成本选择模型而忽略实例负载；负载均衡器只优化队列而忽略质量与成本。在异构集群中，三者强耦合：忽略负载会导致流量集中在高质量小池造成严重排队（实测延迟从 2.3 s 恶化至 60 s 以上），忽略质量则会以 +0.04–0.05 的 DeepEval 质量为代价。因此需要一个联合、面向具体实例的调度层。
AI.method: RouteBalance 按批次进行在线分配：每批用一次 MiniLM 嵌入 + FAISS k=10 KNN 头部得到每模型的预估质量与输出长度；用每层 XGBoost TPOT 头结合解析公式得到端到端延迟；按 LPT 顺序贪心分配，并对所选实例的 dead-reckoning 状态进行局部更新以避免聚集。目标函数为 3-simplex 权重 (w_qual, w_lat, w_cost) 下的加权和，并支持可选的预算准入过滤。所有预测器 CPU 内嵌并批量化处理，将请求热路径开销控制在约 28–32 ms。
AI.result: 在 13 实例 28 GPU 的异构集群（Qwen2.5 3B/7B/14B/72B × A30/V100×4/A100×4）上的 442 组配置、约 150 万请求评估中：质量天花板达 DeepEval 0.419（+0.013 vs BEST-Route，95% CI [+0.005, +0.022]；+0.043 vs Avengers-Pro），且在 cost-priority 角以 1.67×10⁻⁵ USD/req 打平最便宜基线；均匀权重预设下保持 2.3–2.8 s 至 30 req/s，工程均衡的 BEST-Route 在高负载下落后 2.6–4.1×。四臂隔离表明增益来自“模型选择阶段对延迟定价”，而非学习预测器本身；学习组件仅提供标定和 SLO 余量。结论经判官、种子和成本模型敏感性检验均稳健。
AI.conclusion: RouteBalance 通过将路由与负载均衡融合为对具体实例的在线分配，仅以权重向量调节即可在单一部署栈中同时覆盖最便宜与最高质量的工作点；其收益的根源在于“模型选择时即考虑延迟”这一动作，解耦的路由器-均衡器架构无法实现。该框架、脚本与数据集均已开源。

title: Latency Prediction for LLM Inference on NPU Systems
summary: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) requires exploring a large configuration space spanning parallelization strategies, batching techniques, and scheduling policies. Exhaustive measurement across this space is impractical, making latency prediction essential for system optimization. While NPUs have emerged as accelerators designed for LLM inference, no prediction methodology has been established for them. Specifically, applying prior work to LLM inference latency prediction on NPUs faces three challenges: undisclosed microarchitecture of commercial NPUs, unpredictable compiler optimizations, and latency non-linearity induced by bucketing. We present LENS, a latency estimator that predicts NPU inference latency without information on the microarchitecture or compiler, and captures the non-linear latency induced by bucketing. LENS profiles each bucket with two end-to-end (E2E) measurements and composes the results to predict latency for arbitrary input-output length combinations. We validate LENS across NPUs from multiple vendors, several LLMs, and diverse workloads, achieving a mean prediction error of 2.15\%. We further compare LENS against two methodologically related baselines, confirming the validity of its approach.

AI.tldr: LENS是首个面向NPU的LLM推理延迟预测工具,通过将NPU的桶(bucket)结构作为预测单位,仅需每个桶两次端到端测量即可预测任意输入-输出长度组合的延迟。在4款商用NPU(覆盖Neuron SDK和JAX/XLA)、3个模型(1B-14B)、4个数据集、248个配置上,平均预测误差仅2.15%。
AI.motivation: LLM推理部署需要在大规模配置空间(加速器选择、批大小、并行策略、桶选择等)中搜索最优解,但穷举测量不可行(如Vidur报告LLaMA2-70B在双GPU上需42,000 GPU小时)。虽然已有GPU环境的延迟预测方法(NeuSight、Vidur、MaverIQ等),但NPU具有静态编译特性和黑盒微架构,既有方法直接迁移到NPU时误差可达493%,因此亟需专门面向NPU的预测方法。
AI.method: LENS利用两个关键观察:(1)编译后二进制的E2E延迟可外部观测;(2)同一桶内所有输入共享同一编译二进制。基于此,将桶作为预测单位,通过对每个桶进行两次不同输出长度的E2E测量(联立线性方程组),解出该桶的TTFT(首token时延)和TBT(逐token时延),再根据输入长度确定prefill桶、根据KV缓存增长轨迹分段累加decode延迟。支持单请求、批量推理以及优化注意力核场景。
AI.result: 在248个测试用例上,平均预测误差2.15%、中位数1.69%,89.9%用例误差低于5%;在4款NPU上均保持稳定(Inferentia2-TP8: 2.20%、TPU v4: 2.65%、TPU v5e: 2.35%、TPU v6e: 1.46%);模型规模1B到14B均稳定;4种prefill/decode比例差异显著的数据集均小于5%。对比LLM Serving Sim 2.0和MaverIQ,LENS以5.3%的MAPE显著优于基线(后者在ArXiv BS=32上误差超200%);profiling时间18分钟(vs LLM Serving Sim 2.0的7小时)。两个案例研究进一步表明NPU的"更大batch不一定吞吐更高""更小桶不一定更快"反直觉特性必须依靠直接测量,LENS是支持该搜索的关键工具。
AI.conclusion: LENS是首个针对NPU的LLM推理延迟预测方法,通过将桶结构重新诠释为预测单位,以黑盒方式处理微架构和编译器不透明问题,捕获了桶边界处的不连续延迟,仅需每个桶两次E2E测量即可高精度预测任意输入-输出长度组合的延迟,有效支撑NPU部署配置空间的高效搜索,弥补了GPU方法在NPU上失效的研究空白。

title: Verified Detection and Prevention of Concurrency Anomalies in Multi-Agent Large Language Model Systems
comment: 32 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Verus/TLA+ verification artifact, reference Rust runtime, and Python harnesses, plus a supplementary appendix (Sections A-F, Tables S1-S6), included as ancillary files
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems share state through memory stores, vector indices, and tool registries. We model such sharing as long-running read-generate-write operations under deterministic-generation semantics -- the regime durable-execution engines enforce by deterministic replay -- and formalize four concurrency anomalies in TLA+: stale-generation, phantom-tool, causal-cascade, and tool-effect reordering, structural analogues of classical isolation anomalies, each with a TLC counter-example. The exclusion lattice over these anomalies is trivial; the contribution is the mechanically verified realizability and strict separation of one maximal chain within it, $L_0 \subsetneq \cdots \subsetneq L_4$, to our knowledge the first machine-checked consistency hierarchy for such runtimes. A development of 274 Verus obligations (zero assume, zero admit; trust base: two structural axioms and a mutex correspondence) proves the detectors sound and complete against the specifications and each runtime its avoidance set. Three deployed Rust runtimes realize L0-L1 (pessimistic locking, serializable snapshot isolation, default-SI), each verified against stale-generation and refined to its state machine; L2-L4 are exec-mode-verified with dependency-free prevention twins (A3, A6, A2: 0/1000 versus 1000/1000), and L2 is run live across three model families (A3 prevented in all 120 retracted sessions). We reproduce a silent lost update in ByteDance's deer-flow, formalizing its fix as a verified $L_0 \to L_1$ refinement, and exhibit tool-effect reordering in LangGraph's ToolNode on unmodified output, removed by an L3 commit-order sequencer. The verified detector, refinements, and realizability artifacts are the contribution; the phenomena and lattice are classical.

AI.tldr: 本文为多智能体大语言模型系统提出首个机械验证的一致性层次结构：在 TLA+ 中形式化四类并发异常（陈旧生成、幻象工具、因果级联、工具效果重排序），在布尔格上构造操作链 L₀⊊L₁⊊L₂⊊L₃⊊L₄，并通过 274 条 Verus 验证义务（零 assume/admit）机械证明检测器的健全性与完备性、各级运行时的安全性及与已部署框架的精化关系，复现并修复了 ByteDance deer-flow 的静默丢失更新与 LangGraph ToolNode 的工具效果重排序缺陷。
AI.motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统的共享状态（内存存储、向量索引、工具注册表）通过"读-生成-写"长时操作访问，其中生成阶段受神经推理延迟主导，外部工具效果不可逆。然而现有的一致性理论（硬件内存模型、数据库隔离、分布式系统一致性）均不直接适用：硬件模型假设操作延迟有界；数据库隔离理论假设读集在事务生命周期内受锁或快照保护；分布式系统将操作视为离散事件。最新多智能体失败分类（MAST）侧重认知与协调失败，未触及并发层面的异常。因此存在明确空白：缺乏对多智能体 LLM 运行时一致性层次的机械验证，也缺乏将经典异常理论移植到该运行机制（推理延迟作为一等公民、工具注册表为一等可变状态、外部效果不可逆）的形式化工件。
AI.method: 1) 在 TLA+ 中建模带只追加日志与逻辑时钟的读-生成-写操作语义；2) 将四类异常（A₁ 陈旧生成、A₂ 幻象工具、A₃ 因果级联、A₆ 工具效果重排序，A₄ 分裂视图在 Verus 模型层另行形式化）定义为历史谓词，每个由 TLC 在小参数下生成反例迹；3) 构造布尔格 ℒ=⟨2^𝒜,⊆⟩，在其中选择 24 条极大链之一的 L₀→L₁→L₂→L₃→L₄；4) 在 Verus 中机械验证：24 条检测器与规范的等价性义务、三策略运行时针对 A₁ 的 40 条安全性义务、四条规范-运行时精化义务（84 条，含悲观锁、SSI 投影、SSI 版本链、默认-SI）；5) 五个 L₂–L₄ 模型级安全性定理与可执行模式精化；6) 实证：700 条合成迹、300 段 gpt-4o 会话、900 段三策略基线（复现于 Claude Sonnet 4.5 与 Llama-3.2）、600 段 MAST-Data 提取、6 段 cookbook 场景、配对墙钟成本研究。
AI.result: 检测器链 24/24 验证（健全且完备）；三运行时安全证明 40/40 验证（默认-SI 条件于全写者假设，测得 3% 静默残差）；四精化文件 84/84 验证，共享两个结构性公理；L₂ 因果跟踪 22/22 验证；A₄ 单调主节点无分裂 9/9 验证；L₃ 提交序排序器 5/5 验证；L₄ 注册表快照 5/5 验证；总 274 条独立验证义务。运行时预防测量：L₂ 因果跟踪在 1,000 个合成场景中 0/1000 触发 A₃（未防护基线 1000/1000）；L₂ 在三个模型家族的 120 个实际回话中阻止全部 A₃（95% CI [0, 2.5%]）；A₆ 排序器在 33 轮 LangGraph 工具调用中实现 0/33 重排序（默认 24/33）。实证：MAST-Data 600 段映射迹 A₁ 触发 0/600（[0, 0.61%]）；cookbook 共享工作空间场景 A₁ 触发 90/100（无状态场景 0/100）；deer-flow 静默丢失更新形式化为 L₀→L₁ 精化；LangGraph ToolNode 工具效果重排序经 L₃ 排序器消除。成本：SSI 在配对分析中增加 ~8% token 开销；悲观锁 ≤1.6×（gpt-4o）至 ≤2.3×（Claude），非文献普遍假设的量级差异。
AI.conclusion: 本工作为多智能体 LLM 运行时一致性提供首个机械验证的层次结构：检测器、运行时安全、运行时-规范精化、模型-级别与可执行模式验证构成端到端已验证的链。四个异常及其在格上的分离通过机械证明承载；各格点的运行时机制（悲观锁→SSI→因果跟踪+saga→注册表快照）证明其避免集与级别匹配；精化锚定到 LangGraph reducer 与 AutoGen ETag 持久化层等已部署框架原语，且其中之一（deer-flow 修复）闭合了真实在野静默更新。格的价值在于精化可行性边界：当前运行机制（Atomix 约 L₃、SagaLLM {A₃} 离线、CodeCRDT L₀）多落链下，未有达到 L₄。检测器在 600 段 MAST 迹中无触发与 cookbook 共享状态场景 90% 触发，共同划定 A₁ 作用域：默认在 reducer/扇出结构中不存在，在共享可变单元格的并发设计中可复现。未来工作：随机 LLM 输出的概率精化（需 Hoeffding 浓度界与 Verus 缺乏实数概率论）、复制感知模型中 A₄ 的形式化、跨更多模型家族与部署模式的实证、代价感知精化。

title: When the Next Step Is Not One Step: Distribution-Aware Execution Modeling for Concurrent Go Programs
summary: Training a model to predict the next step in a concurrent program is harder than it looks: two runs of the same program from the same trace prefix can produce different next events, both valid, because the scheduler is nondeterministic. A model trained against a single label is learning to guess one outcome of a random process. We turn this around and use the nondeterminism as a training signal. We run each program many times, aggregate the observed next events into an empirical distribution, and fine-tune a 7B model to match that distribution with a KL objective. On 798 held-out predictions drawn from real production Go bugs (CockroachDB, Kubernetes, gRPC, etcd), fine-tuning on fewer than a thousand traces reaches 36.2% accuracy, ahead of Gemini 3.5 Flash used zero-shot (34.8%) and the same model without fine-tuning (28.6%). Distribution training matches cross-entropy on accuracy (35.8% vs. 36.2%) while reducing Expected Calibration Error from 0.205 to 0.169. We also derive a formal goroutine-leak signature for a class of select-blocked goroutines where P(GoUnblock)=0 holds by scheduler semantics, not by learning. We release the dataset, trained adapters, and all tooling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将并发Go程序的下一步事件预测重构为分布估计任务，利用调度器非确定性作为训练信号而非噪声。通过对同一程序多次运行聚合经验分布，使用KL散度目标微调7B模型，在真实生产级Go并发bug（CockroachDB、Kubernetes、gRPC、etcd等）上达到36.2%准确率，超越零样本Gemini 3.5 Flash（34.8%）和未微调基线（28.6%），同时降低期望校准误差。
AI.motivation: 传统的代码世界模型（Code World Models）假设执行是确定性的，在顺序代码中表现良好，但在并发程序中，调度器非确定性导致同一前缀可产生多个合法的下一步事件。基于单一标签训练等同于让模型猜测随机过程的一个结果，学到的信息有限。并发bug（死锁、竞态、goroutine泄漏）依赖调度且难以检测，使该问题在实践中尤为重要。需要一种将非确定性作为信号而非噪声的建模方法。
AI.method: 1. 任务形式化：给定Go程序P和追踪前缀τ_{1:k}，预测六个事件类型（GoBlock、GoCreate、GoEnd、GoSched、GoStart、GoUnblock）之一的分布。2. 数据集：130个Go程序（26个手工编写、38个生成、66个来自GoKer/GoBench的真实bug），每个程序用runtime tracer运行5次，在25%/50%/75%前缀深度采样。3. 训练：使用Qwen2.5-Coder（1.5B/7B）配合4-bit QLoRA（rank=16，α=32），比较交叉熵（按观测频率重复样本）和KL分布目标两种损失函数。4. 评估：在66个真实GoKer程序（训练时完全未见）上测试798个下一步预测，并通过符号调度器有限状态机进行多步一致性探针。
AI.result: 1. 主结果：7B模型微调后在真实GoKer测试集上达36.2%准确率（CE）和35.8%（KL），均超过零样本的Qwen2.5-Coder-7B（28.6%）和Gemini 3.5 Flash（34.8%/35.2%）。2. 校准：KL目标将期望校准误差从0.205降至0.169，模型熵与程序非确定性正相关（Spearman ρ=0.407, p=0.007）。3. 准确率天花板：三种方法都聚集在35-36%，根源在于稀有事件（GoEnd、GoSched训练频率<2%且预测准确率0%）和分布偏移（测试集GoCreate占21%而训练仅1.5%）。4. 形式化结论：推导出select-block泄漏的签名P(GoUnblock)=0，该性质源自Go调度器语义而非学习。5. 多步局限性：自回归预测平均仅约1步后即违反调度器不变量。
AI.conclusion: 将并发程序的下一步预测重构为分布估计是可行且有效的，少量并发追踪监督可泛化到结构不同的真实生产代码。KL分布训练在不牺牲准确率的前提下改善了校准。35-36%的准确率天花板由稀有事件失败和训练-测试分布偏移共同导致，单步训练无法扩展到多步仿真。未来方向包括：基于轨迹而非单步的训练、在追踪表示中编码channel和mutex状态、以及重平衡训练集以匹配真实Go代码的事件分布。作者发布了数据集、训练适配器及全部工具。

title: LogCopilot: Automating Log Aggregation Analysis through Large Language Models
summary: Logs record the runtime behavior of software and are widely used in various tasks such as debugging, testing, and fault diagnosis. With the increase in system size and complexity, log analysis has gradually become a challenging task. Current industrial systems typically use log aggregation systems such as Grafana Loki and ELK to simplify the log collection and analysis process. Engineers write queries using the DSL query language provided by these systems can complete a variety of log analysis tasks. However, writing these queries is often time-consuming and labor-intensive, as it requires engineers to have a thorough understanding of the DSL syntax and the detailed information contained in the logs. To address these challenges, this paper proposes LogCopilot, an automated log aggregation analysis framework based on large language models (LLMs). LogCopilot accepts natural language log analysis instructions and accomplishes automated log analysis through knowledge retrieval and tool calling. LogCopilot constructs a hierarchical knowledge base to represent and provide key knowledge in logs. And it achieves automated log aggregation analysis by generating and executing LogQL queries. The evaluation based on four log datasets confirm the effectiveness of LogCopilot, which achieves an average accuracy of 76.8% and outperforms baseline approaches. Moreover, experiment results shows that LogCopilot is effective in LogQL query generation.

AI.tldr: LogCopilot是一个基于大语言模型(LLM)的自动化日志聚合分析框架,接受自然语言日志分析指令,通过知识检索和工具调用,自动生成并执行LogQL查询完成日志聚合分析任务。该框架构建了层次化的日志知识库(变量-模板-工作流),在四个日志数据集(HDFS、OpenSSH、OpenStack、TrainTicket)上达到平均76.8%的准确率,显著优于LogSay、LogQLLM和Few-shot等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现代软件系统规模与复杂度不断增长,日志分析面临挑战。工业界广泛使用Grafana Loki、ELK等日志聚合系统,工程师需要熟练掌握LogQL等DSL语法及日志细节才能编写查询语句,学习成本高且耗时耗力。现有辅助方法(如LogAssist、LogNotion)仍依赖工程师编写分析语句;LogSay、LogQLLM等基于训练的模型则需要大规模标注数据集,泛化能力差,在系统快速演进时需频繁重新训练,存在显著局限。
AI.method: LogCopilot包含两个阶段:(1)离线知识库构建——通过Lilac日志解析器获取日志模板,基于分组ID(任务ID/时间窗口)聚类生成日志序列并识别工作流,使用LLM对变量、模板、工作流进行三层层次化语义摘要,采用Elasticsearch存储并通过text-embedding-3-large生成3072维向量;(2)在线日志分析——四步流程:意图理解(识别知识库问答或日志聚合分析任务)、知识检索(基于余弦相似度,对聚合分析任务检索模板与变量知识,对问答任务参考GraphRAG全局搜索方法进行评分排序)、聚合分析(基于CoT与上下文学习提示生成LogQL,结合Grafana Loki执行,并借鉴Reflexion思想进行最多三轮错误修正)、报告生成(输出包含Summary、Explanation及LogQL的结构化报告)。
AI.result: 在自建的400个跨四系统的日志分析基准(每系统100个任务)上:LogCopilot使用GPT-4o的平均准确率达76.8%,使用GPT-4o-LogQL达79.0%,显著优于LogSay(5.3%)、Few-shot(31.8%)和LogQLLM(9.0%);消融实验显示去除知识摘要后HDFS准确率下降22.4%,证明摘要的关键作用;纠错机制使LogQL语法正确率(SyntaxAcc)在HDFS上从0.888提升至1.000,跨数据集准确率提升6.3%-26.1%;知识检索平均召回率均超0.95,OpenStack达0.994。失败案例分析表明LogQL生成错误主要源于LLM对Grafana Loki数据模型与聚合函数语义理解不足。
AI.conclusion: LogCopilot通过结合LLM语义理解、层次化日志知识库与LogQL自动生成与纠错,有效实现了自然语言驱动的自动化日志聚合分析,在多个系统上大幅超越现有基线,验证了RAG式方法在日志分析任务中的可行性与优越性。未来工作包括扩展更多数据集、进一步研究LLM对数据模型的深度理解,以及通过集成数据模型视图的日志聚合任务进行LLM微调以提升LogQL生成的语义准确性。

title: Supporting the Adoption of Privacy-Enhancing Technologies through Requirements Engineering
comment: Accepted to the 34th International Requirements Engineering Conference (RE 2026), Montreal, Canada, from 17 to 21 August 2026
summary: In recent decades, privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs) have been recognized as a means of meeting regulatory and user privacy requirements in software systems that process personal data. Despite substantial research efforts, support from regulators, contributions by large technology companies such as Google and Microsoft, and growing interest among software practitioners, the practical adoption of PETs remains limited. Existing research consistently identifies recurring challenges to PETs adoption in SE, such as technical complexity and insufficient training. Despite ongoing research efforts, these challenges largely remain unresolved in practice. In this industrial challenge paper, we apply a practical, requirements engineering (RE)-driven perspective to examine challenges to PET adoption across multiple stakeholder groups (PET developers, integrators, and adopters) as well as across different disciplinary perspectives (engineering, law, and business). We argue that RE can facilitate the adoption of PETs by systematically addressing each of the complementary engineering, business, and legal viewpoints on privacy. Neglecting challenges in any of these viewpoints (e.g., the impact of PETs on software architecture, their business implications, and their contribution to regulatory compliance) can increase the impediments or even lead to implementation failure. In practice, explicit specification of these viewpoints within RE can enable meaningful coordination among stakeholders to more effectively realize the benefits of PETs in software engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇工业挑战论文，主张采用需求工程（RE）的多视角方法来解决隐私增强技术（PETs）在软件工程实践中采纳率低的问题。作者从工程、商业和法律三个相互依存的视角系统分析了PET采纳面临的挑战，并提出RE在协调这些视角、解决冲突和促进跨学科协作方面可发挥核心作用。
AI.motivation: 尽管隐私增强技术（PETs）受到学术界、监管机构及谷歌、微软等大型科技公司的关注和投入，且已有大量研究与解决方案，但PETs在实际软件工程中的采纳率仍然有限。现有研究普遍将障碍归因于技术复杂性和培训不足，但这些挑战长期未得到实质性解决。作者认为，根本原因在于缺乏一种能够系统整合工程、商业和法律等互补视角的协调机制，导致各利益相关方之间的冲突和错位未能得到有效处理。
AI.method: 本文采用工业挑战论文（industrial challenge paper）的形式，基于作者在隐私审查、PET选择与实施、隐私合规执行、遗留系统隐私设计、隐私工程项目及第三方隐私风险管理等方面的实践经验。首先回顾了相关文献中PET采纳面临的挑战（技术复杂性、激励机制不足、SDLC不成熟等），然后从三个互补视角——工程视角（涵盖企业级数据可见性、部署选项评估、架构实践影响等8个挑战）、商业视角（涵盖数据价值影响、业务流程变更、组织利益相关方等5个挑战）和法律视角（涵盖合规不保证性、补充组织措施选择、隐私移动靶点等6个挑战）——系统分析了PET采纳的障碍。最后，提出了RE支持PET采纳的愿景：包括利益相关方建模、跨视角约束建模、知识工程化以及基于追溯性的冲突解决。
AI.result: 论文识别了工程、商业和法律三大视角下的多项具体挑战：（1）工程视角——企业级数据可见性不足、部署选项评估复杂、传统架构方法不适用、工程师隐私意识缺乏、数据变换不可逆、PETs用例受限、技术激励有限、维护配置困难、PETs技术异构性等；（2）商业视角——数据价值影响、业务流程变更、多层级利益相关方协调、声誉收益有限、"隐私清洗"风险等；（3）法律视角——PETs不保证合规、需补充组织措施、隐私和合规是移动靶点、共享责任下角色关系复杂、匿名性相对性、跨司法管辖区差异、残余合规风险测量困难等。实践教训表明，PETs应作为隐私设计基线的组成部分，从产品生命周期伊始就予以集成。论文提出RE可通过四个层面促进PET采纳：管理异构视角、进行领域与知识工程化、解决视角间相互依赖性、促进协调与决策。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出结论：需求工程在应对PET采纳的多视角挑战中可发挥关键作用。RE不仅能通过建模来管理异构视角及其挑战，还能对复杂的法律视角进行领域和知识工程化，帮助解决视角间的相互依赖性问题，并最终促进有效的协调和决策制定，从而推动更高效、更有效的PET采纳。作者呼吁开展以行业为重点的实证研究，探讨"真实场景"中的PET和隐私需求挑战，并建议RE技术不仅适用于PET采纳，也应应用于未来PET的开发，以确保新PET能够满足各参与视角的需求和挑战。

title: OmniDroneX: An LLM-Assisted Holistic Drone-as-a-Service Ecosystem
comment: Ongoing project paper that is going to be submitted to JointCloud Computing
summary: Despite rapid advances in UAV technologies, current deployments remain limited due to several gaps in UAV systems research. To address these challenges, we propose OmniDroneX, a unified Drone-as-a-Service ecosystem, in which drones are transitioned from fixed function platforms into dynamically composable entities that can be integrated with external infrastructures to offer omni-capabilities. OmniDroneX bridges low-level physical primitives with high-level mission intent through a unified vendor-agnostic interface (libUAV) and a formal physical-service abstraction model (PT-SOA). A core innovation is the diverse application of large language models (LLMs) across multiple layers of the OmniDroneX architecture. LLMs are used to assist in identifying and formalizing primitive device functions and abstract service definitions, supporting automated service composition and workflow generation, and enabling interactive, natural-language mission specification and refinement. OmniDroneX also incorporates important categories of composition techniques that are essential in dynamic UAV systems, including physical layer composition for drone capability augmentation, as well as spatiotemporal, functional, collaborative, exception-aware, and QoS-based service compositions. Collectively, these features allow OmniDroneX to serve as a foundation for scalable, resilient, and self-evolving UAV ecosystems operating in complex and dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OmniDroneX，一个统一的无人机即服务（Drone-as-a-Service）生态系统，通过libUAV接口和PT-SOA物理服务抽象模型，将无人机从固定功能平台转变为可动态组合的实体，并利用大语言模型（LLM）实现自动化服务组合与自然语言任务规划，以构建可扩展、有韧性、自演进的无人机生态系统。
AI.motivation: 当前无人机（UAV）技术虽快速发展，但其实际部署仍受到现有无人机系统研究中若干空白的限制，亟需一种能够将底层物理能力与高层任务意图桥接、并支持动态组合与自适应演进的统一框架。
AI.method: 方法包括：（1）提出统一、与厂商无关的接口libUAV，作为连接底层物理原语与高层任务意图的桥梁；（2）构建形式化的物理服务抽象模型PT-SOA；（3）在架构的多层中多样化应用大语言模型（LLM），用于识别与形式化原语设备功能、抽象服务定义、支持自动化服务组合与工作流生成，以及实现交互式自然语言任务规约与优化；（4）纳入多类组合技术，涵盖物理层能力增强、时空组合、功能组合、协作组合、异常感知组合以及基于QoS的服务组合。
AI.result: 该工作提出OmniDroneX作为无人机系统的基础架构，融合了统一接口、形式化服务抽象、LLM驱动的智能服务组合以及多维度组合技术，使其能够在复杂动态环境中支持可扩展、有韧性、自演进的无人机生态系统运行。
AI.conclusion: OmniDroneX通过统一的软硬件抽象与LLM赋能的多层智能，为无人机系统从单一功能平台向动态可组合服务体的转型奠定了基础，有望推动无人机在复杂动态场景中的规模化、韧性与自主演进部署。

title: Why Model Credibility Isn't Enough: -Rethinking Trust in Simulation Architectures
comment: Annual Congress of Japan Society of Automotive Engineers (JSAE), May 2026, Yokohama, Japan
summary: Credibility of a simulation model is an important topic. Several approaches try to quantify the credibility of simulation. However, models are mostly assembled within a simulation architecture. Can the credibility of a simulation architecture be assessed based on the credibility of the models that comprise it? This paper aims to address this issue by providing an overview of the current state of the art in the field of assembly credibility. It will compare sensitivity analysis techniques, qualitative analysis by experts, explainability in AI, and networks. Finally, an assessment of the proposed approaches, based on criteria such as rigor, generalization, and resource requirements, will reveal the strengths and weaknesses of each approach.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨仿真架构的"组装可信度"（assembly credibility）问题，即能否通过评估组成模型的个体可信度来推断整体仿真架构的可信度。论文综述并比较了四种现有方法：敏感性分析、专家定性分析、AI可解释性方法以及网络分析方法，并基于严谨性、泛化能力和资源需求等标准进行综合评估。
AI.motivation: 仿真模型的可信度（credibility）研究已有较多成果，但实际应用中模型通常被组装在更大的仿真架构中运行。单个模型的可信度评估结果是否能够有效传递或组合到整体架构层面，这一"组装可信度"问题尚未得到系统研究，存在明显的研究空白。
AI.method: 采用文献综述与方法对比的研究方法，对组装可信度领域的现有方法进行系统性梳理与比较分析，具体涵盖四类方法：（1）敏感性分析技术——通过考察模型输出对参数扰动的响应来推断整体行为；（2）专家定性分析——依靠领域专家对模型间交互进行主观判断；（3）AI可解释性方法——借助XAI技术揭示模型内部决策机制；（4）网络分析方法——将仿真架构建模为网络结构，分析节点间依赖关系。评估框架基于三项标准：严谨性（rigor）、泛化能力（generalization）以及资源需求（resource requirements）。
AI.result: 由于所提供的仅为论文摘要，未给出各方法的实验对比数据或具体结论性结果。论文旨在揭示四种方法各自的优势与不足：敏感性分析具有较好的严谨性但计算开销大；专家定性分析资源需求低但严谨性与泛化性受限；AI可解释性方法为新兴路径但应用于可信度评估仍存争议；网络分析方法在结构化分析方面有潜力但依赖网络建模假设。
AI.conclusion: 组装可信度是仿真可信度研究中的重要但尚未成熟的问题领域。论文通过对比分析表明，没有单一方法能同时满足严谨性、泛化能力与低资源需求三项标准；不同方法各具适用场景，未来研究可能需要结合多种方法或开发新的混合框架来有效解决仿真架构的可信度评估问题。

title: PracRepair: LLM-Empowered Automated Program Repair Inspired by Human-Like Debugging Practices
summary: As software systems grow in scale and complexity, debugging and repair remain costly and time-consuming. Large language models (LLMs) have advanced automated program repair (APR), but existing LLM-based APR approaches still largely rely on static or retrieved context, error messages, and coarse-grained validation outcomes. As a result, they underutilize dynamic information for failure understanding and repair, including failure-execution dynamics and patch-validation dynamics. Effectively leveraging such information, however, is challenging: failure-execution traces are large and noisy, raw static-dynamic context is not self-explanatory, and patch-validation dynamics are often reduced to coarse feedback. To address these challenges, we propose \textsc{PracRepair}, a fully automated LLM-based APR framework inspired by human-like debugging practices. \textsc{PracRepair} constructs an on-demand static-dynamic context from buggy programs and failure executions, performs question-driven failure diagnosis to formulate explicit repair hypotheses, and iteratively refines candidate patches using validation diagnostics and trace-level behavioral changes. Experimental results on Defects4J V1.2 and V2.0 show that \textsc{PracRepair} consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Specifically, under GPT-3.5, \textsc{PracRepair} correctly fixes 139/136 bugs on Defects4J V1.2/V2.0, while under GPT-4o it further improves to 162/171. Moreover, \textsc{PracRepair} generalizes effectively to RWB (Real-World Bugs), achieving the best performance across multiple foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PracRepair，一种基于大语言模型的全自动程序修复框架，通过引入按需构建的静态-动态上下文、问题驱动的失败诊断以及基于验证诊断和轨迹级行为变化的迭代补丁优化，模拟人类调试实践，在 Defects4J V1.2/V2.0 和 RWB 基准上超越现有 SOTA 方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 自动程序修复方法主要依赖静态或检索上下文、错误信息及粗粒度验证结果，未能充分利用失败执行动态（如执行轨迹）和补丁验证动态信息；且原始静态-动态上下文不具自解释性，失败轨迹庞大且噪声多，验证反馈过于粗粒度，难以有效支撑失败理解与修复。
AI.method: PracRepair 框架包含三个核心机制：1）从缺陷程序和失败执行中按需构建静态-动态上下文；2）采用问题驱动的失败诊断（question-driven failure diagnosis），形成显式修复假设；3）基于验证诊断（validation diagnostics）与轨迹级行为变化对候选补丁进行迭代精炼（iterative refinement）。整体流程模拟人类调试实践。
AI.result: 在 Defects4J V1.2/V2.0 基准上，PracRepair 显著优于 SOTA 基线：使用 GPT-3.5 时分别修复 139/136 个 bug，使用 GPT-4o 时进一步提升至 162/171 个。此外，该框架在 RWB（Real-World Bugs）真实世界缺陷上同样取得最优表现，并在多种基础模型上展现出良好泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: PracRepair 验证了将动态执行信息（失败轨迹与验证动态）以按需、问题驱动、迭代的方式融入 LLM APR 流程的有效性，能突破传统静态/检索上下文与粗粒度验证的局限，在多个基准和模型上一致达到当前最优，展示了类人调试策略在自动化程序修复中的潜力。

title: Planning to Hammer: Difficulty-Aware Decomposition for Automating Rocq Proofs
summary: As AI-generated code proliferates, formal verification, particularly through interactive theorem provers such as Rocq and Isabelle, becomes increasingly important for ensuring software correctness. However, producing machine-checked proofs in such provers remains a bottleneck. Existing solutions bring complementary strengths to proof automation: large language models (LLMs) can propose high-level proof strategies but lack local rigor, while automated tactics such as CoqHammer can reliably discharge many local goals but lack long-range planning capabilities. To combine the best of both worlds, we present Quarry, a planning-based proof synthesis framework that separates proof planning from proof execution. Specifically, Quarry asks an LLM to actively propose multiple proof decompositions with arbitrary sublemmas, type-checks them in Rocq under temporarily admitted sublemmas, and ranks candidates using a proof-state-based difficulty model that estimates hammer solvability. It then recursively proves sublemmas within a bounded budget, effectively turning long proofs into sequences of hammer-solvable obligations. We implement Quarry on top of SerAPI and CoqHammer and evaluate it using multiple frontier LLMs across multiple benchmarks. The experimental results show that planning-based decomposition with solvability-aware ranking substantially improves automation while maintaining predictable cost. Under a uniform 10-minute wall-clock budget, Quarry improves over the strongest baseline by 7% to 13% in success rate across three Rocq benchmarks. These results demonstrate that reliable proof automation can be achieved by coordinating neural planning with symbolic execution rather than replacing either.

AI.tldr: Quarry 是一个面向 Rocq 形式化证明自动合成的规划型框架，通过将 LLM 的高层规划能力与 CoqHammer 的局部执行能力解耦（Generate–Rank–Solve 循环），并在候选分解之间引入基于证明状态特征的难度感知排序，在三个基准上将成功率较最强基线提升 7–13 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 交互式定理证明器（如 Rocq）中的证明合成长期存在瓶颈：LLM 擅长高层规划但缺乏局部严谨性（易出现虚构引理、类型错误、Admitted 漏洞），而 CoqHammer 等自动化策略虽能可靠完成局部一阶目标，却缺乏长程规划能力。两者互补但单独使用均不足以应对涉及多定义交互、需要归纳或深层 case 分析的复杂程序验证定理。核心挑战在于：长证明若无法在预算内被切分为可由 hammer 单独解决的子目标，整个递归尝试就会失败并浪费预算。
AI.method: Quarry 采用三阶段循环： (1) **Generate**：由 LLM 生成 k 个候选分解（若干子引理 + 目标证明脚本），在 Rocq 中以 Admitted 方式做类型验证，过滤掉类型错误、循环依赖等无效候选； (2) **Rank**：通过 SerAPI 对每个子引理执行 `repeat intro` 归一化，提取 28 维特征（19 维 intros-state 特征 + 9 维语句级特征），用线性模型 d_θ(ℓ)=θᵀφ(ℓ)+β 估计难度，候选分数取其子引理最大难度（max 聚合，体现瓶颈原则）； (3) **Solve**：在每个递归节点先尝试 CoqHammer 快速路径，失败时仅对排序最高的 B=1 个候选递归求解，整体在 60 次 LLM 请求、10 分钟时钟预算内完成。模型权重通过离线 trace 回放 + pairwise ranking loss 学习，训练集与测试集项目级别不相交。系统支持 dense-supervision 模式以记录完整候选–结果映射，便于离线策略评估。
AI.result: 在 CoqGym100、Wigderson100、TransBench58 三个基准上，Quarry 分别取得 55%、52%、16% 的成功率，较最强基线（PALM）提升 +7、+13、+13 个百分点；较 Cobblestone 提升 +17、+17、+14 个百分点。消融实验表明：难度排序带来 +3~4 pp 提升，深度 CoqHammer 集成带来 +6~14 pp 提升；max 聚合优于 mean/sum；28 维完整特征集优于仅 intros-state 或仅语句特征。效率上，>90% 的成功证明在 5 分钟内完成，中位求解时间 1–2 分钟，每个定理 LLM 请求数（7.2–9.8）低于 Cobblestone（11.5–14.4）。当 k=8 时已捕获大部分收益，k>12 后趋于饱和。错误分析表明，主要失败模式为"无显式子目标的内部推进"式证明（长链重写/展开），该类缺乏自然分解点的定理仍是框架的固有局限。
AI.conclusion: Quarry 验证了"先规划、后执行"的证明合成范式：通过让 LLM 主动提出任意子引理分解并经 Rocq 验证、再用基于证明状态特征的轻量难度模型筛选候选，可显著提高 hammer 可解子目标的命中率与整体证明成功率，同时保持可预测的预算开销。其模块化设计允许替换叶求解器（用 Cobblestone 替代 CoqHammer 可额外证明 10 个定理）。未来方向包括：引入 agentic 闭环以根据执行反馈动态修订分解策略，以及向 Lean 4、Isabelle 等其他 ITP 迁移。

title: Diagnosing and Repairing Shape-Prior Shortcuts in Long-Range Single-Shot Fringe Projection Profilometry
summary: Learning-based single-shot fringe projection profilometry (FPP) has been studied mostly at close range. The long-range regime (standoff beyond 1 m) remains largely unaddressed: inverse-square intensity falloff lowers fringe signal-to-noise ratio and degrades physical ground truth, the single-shot problem is ill-posed because fringe-order information is absent from one image, and these architectures have not been studied mechanistically. We present a diagnose-repair-verify study using mechanistic interpretability (MI) and conformal uncertainty quantification (UQ) as convergent diagnostics: they agree on one physical failure locus, driving and verifying an architectural repair. On a photorealistic synthetic benchmark (15,600 fringe images, 50 objects at 1.5-2.1 m), a best UNet baseline reaches 14.54 mm object mean absolute error (MAE). Three probes (linear probing, Grad-CAM, flat-plane out-of-distribution test) converge: the baseline solves the task via object-boundary shape priors rather than fringe-phase decoding. We repair this with PhiCalNet, which outputs wrapped phase rather than depth and applies a fixed differentiable calibration layer mapping phase to depth, removing the shape-prior solution from the hypothesis space architecturally rather than by a loss penalty. A physics-informed loss that enforces the same physics as a soft penalty on a depth-regressing network yields no measurable gain, isolating the architecture as the operative factor. PhiCalNet reduces object MAE 3.3x to 4.46 mm; the residual is carried by 0.103% of pixels at the +/-pi wrap discontinuity. Pixel-wise conformal UQ confirms the diagnosis: rejecting the top 5% of object pixels by snapshot disagreement cuts PhiCalNet RMSE by 64% (20.6->7.4 mm) versus 3.5% for the baseline. MI and UQ converge on the same failure locus.

AI.tldr: 本文针对长距离（>1 m）单次曝光条纹投影轮廓测量（FPP）中学习型网络存在的"形状先验捷径"问题，提出了一种"诊断-修复-验证"研究范式：通过机制可解释性（MI）与共形不确定性量化（UQ）作为收敛诊断工具，定位到最佳UNet基线依赖物体边界形状先验而非解码条纹相位；进而提出PhiCalNet架构——输出包裹相位而非深度，并经由固定可微校准层映射为深度，将形状先验解从假设空间中架构性地移除，使物体MAE降低3.3×至4.46 mm，并通过MI与UQ的"三路汇聚"（特征、误差结构、集成分歧）验证修复的有效性。
AI.motivation: 单次曝光学习型FPP在远距离（>1 m）场景下面临三大耦合挑战：1/r² 强度衰减导致条纹信噪比降低且物理真值获取困难；单次曝光本征不适定（缺少条纹阶次信息）；现有架构缺乏机制性研究。已有工作集中于近距离（内窥镜、桌面系统），远距离FPP基本未被探索。更关键的是，文献中端到端训练并以聚合误差评估的网络，可能通过捷径学习（形状模板）而非物理相位解码完成任务——在计量学中这意味着无法泛化到新几何体，但其存在性从未被机制性地裁定。
AI.method: 采用统一的"诊断-修复-验证"模板：（1）构建FPP-ML-Bench基准（15,600条纹图像，50个物体，1.5–2.1 m，基于VIRTUS-FPP的Isaac Sim光真实合成框架），系统消融归一化、背景处理、多帧组合、损失、架构；（2）用三种机制可解释性探针诊断最佳UNet基线：线性探测、Grad-CAM、平面OOD测试；（3）提出PhiCalNet架构——UNet骨干输出(sin φ, cos φ)→单位圆投影→atan2→用oracle k_gt解包裹→固定可微校准层映射为深度；（4）用PINN反事实（相同物理作为软损失惩罚）隔离架构性因素；（5）通过双模式Grad-CAM（相位模式vs深度模式）、平面OOD、像素级snapshot-ensemble共形UQ进行验证。
AI.result: 基线：UNet+Hybrid L1(α=0.7)达14.54 mm物体MAE（深度范围80 mm的18%），TransUNet/ResUNet/Pix2Pix分别差29%/60%/91%，1.9×架构差距表明表征极限而非容量极限。诊断：UNet中边缘信息比深度信息线性可读性强2.82×；Grad-CAM边缘/条纹注意比1.28；平面OOD在1.8 m处塌缩为近零背景预测。修复：PhiCalNet将物体MAE降至4.46 mm（3.3×），三帧扩展达1.16 mm；PINN对照在λ扫描内无改善，隔离架构性为操作因素。误差残差由0.103%物体像素（±π包裹不连续处）承担。验证：PhiCalNet中相位为最易解码特征（enc3最优），深度probe loss高5-6×；双模式Grad-CAM在相同权重上从相位模式1.06移至深度模式1.54；平面OOD在1795±6 mm处恢复正确深度。UQ：剔除5%高分歧像素使PhiCalNet RMSE降64%（20.6→7.4 mm）而UNet仅3.5%。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献：(1) FPP-ML-Bench——首个开源光真实单次曝光FPP合成基准，附标准化object/background/overall评估协议；(2) 通过架构/归一化/损失/多帧的系统消融隔离设计选择；(3) 首次将机制可解释性应用于FPP，三种探针汇聚诊断出最佳UNet的形状先验捷径；(4) 提出PhiCalNet——通过相位输出空间+固定可微校准层在架构层面而非损失层面移除捷径假设，PINN反事实验证此为操作因素；(5) 解析与经验地表征包裹边界残差，多帧扩展闭合信息论缺口；(6) 首次将共形预测应用于FPP（亦是像素级深度回归中的早期应用），双模式Grad-CAM隔离校准层为深度输出边缘偏置的来源。MI、误差空间结构、UQ集成分歧的"三路汇聚"在单物理位置（±π包裹线）上达成，作为可迁移的方法学模板贡献于其他物理信息学习场景。

title: Informative Missingness to Generate Irregular Clinical Time Series
summary: Laboratory tests in electronic health records are collected irregularly, and the absence of a test order can be as informative as the measurement itself. Such missingness reflects clinicians' decisions and patient physiology, making it important to model it directly rather than treat it as a preprocessing artifact. Here we present a diffusion-based approach for generating clinical time series that jointly models laboratory values and their observation patterns using the public Data Analytics Challenge on Missing Data Imputation (DACMI) benchmark derived from MIMIC-III. To preserve realistic sampling, we align chart times into 4-hour intervals and segment admissions into 7-day windows, producing trajectories that pair each lab value with a corresponding observation indicator. Standard transformations and normalization are applied to stabilize training. Our method extends the TimeDiff framework to learn continuous lab values and discrete missingness patterns through complementary diffusion objectives. Experiments show that the generated data closely match real patient trajectories across individual lab distributions and joint value-missingness embeddings, demonstrating that diffusion models can capture clinically meaningful dependencies between patient physiology and clinicians' testing behavior under MNAR-like (missing-not-at-random) missingness. These preliminary results indicate that our model can serve as an initial component toward developing clinical foundation models. By producing synthetic priors that preserve key physiology-missingness relationships, this work motivates the subsequent training of Prior-Data Fitted Networks capable of leveraging informative missingness, which we will investigate in the extended work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的临床时间序列生成方法，通过扩展TimeDiff框架，在MIMIC-III衍生的DACMI基准上联合建模实验室检验值（连续变量）及其缺失模式（离散变量），以捕捉MNAR（缺失非随机）机制下临床决策与生理状态之间的信息性缺失关系，为临床基础模型提供合成先验。
AI.motivation: 电子健康记录中的实验室检验呈不规则采样，且缺失本身具有临床信息（反映医生决策与患者病情）。现有生成模型多关注近规则信号（如生命体征），或将缺失视为需填补的预处理伪影，忽视缺失模式与生理状态间的耦合关系；因此需要能联合建模检验值与缺失模式的生成方法，为下游临床基础模型（Prior-Data Fitted Networks）提供保真的合成先验。
AI.method: 1) 基于DACMI/MIMIC-III数据集，提取13项血液检验值并构建二值缺失掩码，将charttime离散为4小时间隔，划分为7天（42步）非重叠窗口，共16,580个训练样本；2) 对值做log/Box-Cox变换与z-score标准化，缺失掩码保持二值；3) 扩展TimeDiff框架，通过互补扩散目标联合学习连续值（高斯损失，排除真实缺失点）与离散缺失模式（λ=10⁻⁵加权），并引入delta条件（距最近观测的时间步数）辅助去噪网络；4) 训练200,000步，Adam优化器，学习率8×10⁻⁵，批大小64，生成16,000个合成窗口；5) 评估采用单变量EMD、DTW轨迹距离（缺失感知）以及26通道UMAP联合嵌入。
AI.result: 1) 合成数据在单变量分布上与真实数据高度吻合（如血红蛋白、白细胞计数的密度曲线与尾部形态匹配良好）；2) UMAP联合嵌入（13值+13掩码）显示真实与合成样本在26通道空间中显著重叠，未生成支持域外样本；3) 表1定量比较显示：加入delta条件后平均EMD（0.05）和DTW（37.65）均优于无delta设置且更接近Real-Real参考；4) 局限性：合成缺失率（约0.74）系统性低于真实缺失率（0.79），模型仍低估未观测频率，缺失生成过程需进一步改进。
AI.conclusion: 初步验证了TimeDiff经扩展后可联合建模实验室值与信息性缺失模式，合成窗口在边缘分布与值-掩码联合结构上均接近真实分布，表明扩散模型在MNAR缺失机制下生成真实合成实验室轨迹具有潜力；可作为开发临床基础模型的初步组件，后续工作将基于此合成先验训练能够利用信息性缺失的Prior-Data Fitted Networks，用于分布偏移下的插补与预测。

title: The Critical Role of Model Selection in Causal Inference: A Comparative Analysis of Classification Models within the InferBERT Framework for Pharmacovigilance
summary: Distinguishing causal adverse drug events (ADEs) from spurious correlations remains a central challenge in pharmacovigilance. The InferBERT framework integrates transformer models with Do-calculus, but its success hinges on the underlying classification model. This study evaluates the impact of model choice in InferBERT, assessing whether simpler models suffice, if domain-specific pre-training helps, whether scaling to LLMs improves causal detection, and the effect of post-hoc calibration. We performed a comparative study on two benchmarks: Analgesics-induced Acute Liver Failure (AILF) and Tramadol-related Mortalities (TRAM). Four models were evaluated-XGBoost (baseline), ALBERT (original InferBERT), BioBERT (biomedical transformer), and Med-LLaMA (medical LLM)-using 5-fold cross-validation repeated over 20 runs. We measured accuracy, Expected Calibration Error (ECE) pre- and post-isotonic regression, and Jaccard concordance of causal terms with PRR, ROR, and EBGM; significance was tested with paired t-tests. BioBERT achieved the highest accuracy on both datasets, while Med-LLaMA underperformed despite its size and parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Domain-specific pre-training was decisive. Calibration improved ECE but had mixed effects on accuracy and causal discovery. BioBERT's superiority also yielded the strongest concordance with traditional pharmacovigilance signals. These results show that domain-specific pre-training provides a clear advantage over simpler baselines and larger LLMs. Investing in manageable, domain-aware models is more effective for computational pharmacovigilance than simply scaling model size.

AI.tldr: 本文在InferBERT因果推断框架下，系统比较了四种分类模型（XGBoost、ALBERT、BioBERT、Med-LLaMA）在药物警戒因果信号检测中的表现。结果表明，经过生物医学领域预训练的BioBERT在预测准确率和因果术语识别一致性上均显著优于其他模型，而参数量最大的Med-LLaMA反而表现最差，证实了领域专业化的预训练比单纯的模型规模化更为重要。
AI.motivation: InferBERT框架将Transformer与Do-calculus结合用于药物不良事件因果推断，但其性能高度依赖于底层分类模型。原研究未系统分析：(1) 简单统计模型是否足够；(2) 领域专用预训练是否带来优势；(3) 扩大模型规模（如LLM）是否提升因果检测能力；(4) 后验概率校准的影响。本研究旨在填补这些空白，明确模型选择对预测性能和下游因果发现的影响。
AI.method: 在两个公开FAERS药物警戒基准数据集（镇痛药致急性肝衰竭AILF：36,661份报告；曲马多相关死亡TRAM：27,245份报告）上比较四种模型：(1) XGBoost（表格基线）；(2) ALBERT（原InferBERT模型，~12M参数）；(3) BioBERT（生物医学Transformer，~110M参数，全量微调）；(4) Med-LLaMA（医疗LLM，8B参数，4-bit量化+LoRA PEFT）。采用5折交叉验证重复20次的严谨实验设计，通过固定模板将结构化特征转化为自然语言句子供Transformer输入。评估指标包括分类准确率、等校准误差ECE（同位回归前后）、以及与三种传统药物警戒方法（PRR、ROR、EBGM）识别的因果术语Jaccard一致性指数，统计显著性通过配对t检验评估。
AI.result: BioBERT在两个数据集上均取得最高准确率（AILF: 0.928，TRAM: 0.990），且在所有成对比较中均达统计显著（p<0.0001）；Med-LLaMA表现最差（AILF: 0.772，TRAM: 0.920）。同位回归校准稳定改善了ECE，但对准确率和因果发现的影响不一致甚至为负。BioBERT的预测优势转化为与PRR和EBGM信号的最高一致性，并在因果树中识别出其他模型遗漏的临床合理风险因素（如酒精、女性性别）。这表明预测准确率与因果效用之间存在直接联系。
AI.conclusion: 分类模型的选择是InferBERT框架成败的决定性因素。领域专用预训练（BioBERT）相对于简单基线（XGBoost）、通用Transformer（ALBERT）和大型医疗LLM（Med-LLaMA）均具有决定性优势。预测能力的提升直接转化为更稳健的因果信号识别。研究为计算药物警戒提供了明确指引：在模型选择中应优先考虑深度、相关的领域知识，而非单纯追求模型规模化。同时，后验校准应作为可选步骤处理，需根据其对下游因果分析的具体影响进行评估。

title: Noise-Driven Escape from Metastable Phases explains Grokking in Deep Neural Networks
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at HiLD 2026: 4th Workshop on High-dimensional Learning Dynamics
summary: Deep neural networks (DNNs) exhibit first order phase transitions under variations of the L2 regularization strength, with each transition marking the onset of a new learnable feature. Below a critical regularization strength, all features are in principle learnable, but coexisting metastable states, separated by energy barriers, can trap the network and impede convergence. A strength of DNNs is their ability to generalize. But many open questions remain, among them the origin of so called grokking: the abrupt, delayed onset of generalization after prolonged apparent overfitting. We show for linear DNNs that grokking is consistent with hysteresis in first-order L2 phase transitions: using L2 regularization to engineer deliberate trapping, we demonstrate that a model in a low-accuracy metastable state escapes only when SGD noise drives it across an energy barrier, with escape times following Arrhenius scaling. We reproduce grokking-like delayed convergence across two orders of magnitude in escape time by deliberately trapping models in metastable phases. Using sparse sub-sampling we also reproduce the canonical grokking curve where test error eventually approaches the final training error. Our work suggests that the number of metastable states equals the number of learnable features -- one per singular value of the data covariance -- the potential for hysteresis grows naturally with task complexity. We provide evidence that the same mechanism likely operates in general nonlinear DNNs. Our results provide routes toward more efficient learning schemes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出深度神经网络中"grokking"现象（训练损失饱和后测试性能突然提升）的机制：L2正则化引发的一阶相变产生亚稳态，SGD噪声驱动模型以Arrhenius动力学逃逸越过能垒，从而产生延迟泛化。
AI.motivation: Grokking现象自Power等人提出以来，其物理机制尚无统一解释：现有工作涉及熵垒、玻璃态弛豫、分布偏移等观点，但均存在争议。作者试图从统计物理角度，利用L2正则化产生的一阶相变与亚稳态磁滞（hysteresis）现象，为grokking提供一个可解析处理、可实验验证的统一机制。
AI.method: 采用深度线性网络（L=3, w=10, p=2, 共D=170个参数）作为可精确求解的最小模型。通过准静态改变正则化强度β构建相图，识别由数据协方差矩阵Σ_yx的奇异值η_i决定的一阶鞍结点分岔。利用检查点初始化（先在高β下训练至收敛，再在低β下继续训练）将模型刻意"困"在不同秩的亚稳态中。把SGD小批量噪声等效为Langevin动力学的有效温度T_eff ∝ η_lr/B，预测逃逸时间服从Kramers-Arrhenius定律 ln τ = ln τ_0 + ΔE_eff/T_eff。通过扫描学习率并测量逃逸时间验证Arrhenius标度律（R²=0.991）。用稀疏子采样（25/5000）复现规范grokking曲线。
AI.result: 三个核心结果：（1）一阶L2相变产生d个共存亚稳态（每个可学特征对应一个），能量垒将模型困在低精度相中；（2）逃逸过程服从Arrhenius动力学，ln τ ∝ B/η_lr，有效能垒ΔE_eff=0.15±0.05，远大于最低路径能垒ΔE_min≈0.003（差距由Kramers-Langer公式中D=170维的熵与曲率修正解释）；（3）刻意困于亚稳态可跨越两个数量级的逃逸时间复现grokking的延迟、突变性、初始化敏感性；稀疏采样下复现了训练/测试误差先分离后突然接近的规范grokking曲线。预测：grokking应分d个离散阶段；网络越深能垒越高；通过调整η_lr和B可直接控制逃逸时间。
AI.conclusion: grokking本质上是一阶L2相变中亚稳态的热激活逃逸过程，而非必须依赖记忆化或熵垒机制。线性网络中精确可解的结果有望推广到非线性网络（因非线性网络同样表现出一阶L2相变）。该框架提供三条可证伪的预测：阶段式grokking、深度依赖性、超参数控制。实际意义：因ln τ ∝ B/η_lr，仅通过超参数选择即可加速或抑制grokking延迟。此外，"记忆化"与"泛化"可被视为模型穿越一系列秩级联时部分进展的描述，不一定是原始概念。

title: Towards Fast GNN Surrogates for CO2 Migration in Complex Geological Formations
summary: This chapter discusses how a data-driven machine learning approach can reproduce key aspects of the physical behavior of multiphase flows in complex geological formations. We propose an end-to-end graph neural surrogate tailored to CO$_2$ plume migration forecasting in geological storage. The method is evaluated on the SPE11A benchmark, a well-known industry test case designed to assess CO$_2$ storage scenarios and characterized by sharp gas-water interfaces, strong advective transport, and rapid convective mixing with fingering development. The benchmark is reformulated as a graph in which nodes represent computational cells and edges encode transmissibility-based interactions enriched with geometric attributes. Directional transport arising from grid geometry, permeability contrasts, and geological heterogeneity is captured through an anisotropic message-passing mechanism, where interaction weights are computed via geometry-conditioned edge embeddings, biasing message aggregation toward physically relevant transport directions. Temporal evolution is modeled in latent space using an autoregressive residual formulation trained with multi-step supervision. The proposed model produces competitive forecasts of gas saturation and liquid-phase density, which are key indicators for CO$_2$ storage monitoring, with cumulative errors that remain moderate over extended forecasting horizons.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AnisoMeshGraph-LSTM，一种用于CO2地质封存中羽流迁移预测的端到端图神经网络代理模型。该模型在SPE11A基准上引入了几何条件下的各向异性消息传递机制、GraphConv-LSTM潜在时间动力学模块和残差自回归训练策略，在长时序预测中实现了有竞争力的精度和显著的加速效果。
AI.motivation: 传统数值油藏模拟器计算成本高昂，难以支持长期模拟和不确定性量化。现有图神经网络代理（如MeshGraphNet）采用各向同性消息传递，无法充分捕捉储层流动中由网格几何、渗透率对比和地质非均质性引起的强方向性传输特征。
AI.method: 将SPE11A基准重新构建为图结构，节点为计算单元，边基于传导率定义。提出三个核心创新：(1)各向异性消息传递机制——通过几何条件化的边嵌入计算交互权重，偏向物理相关的传输方向；(2)GraphConv-LSTM潜在时间动力学模块，在潜在空间中捕获时间依赖性；(3)残差自回归状态更新，采用闭式自回归多步监督训练，使用显式Euler推进。
AI.result: 在SPE11A基准（2cm网格，4800时间步，10条轨迹）上，模型对气相饱和度和液相密度的50步累积RMSE分别约为2.47×10⁻²和1.69×10⁻²kg/m³，相对误差约10⁻⁵。50步推理仅需160秒，而传统模拟需111-135分钟。模型能较好再现密度驱动指进现象和尖锐气-水界面，对未见地质构型具有泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: AnisoMeshGraph-LSTM通过几何条件化的各向异性消息传递有效捕捉了储层流动的方向性传输特征，在注入期和注入后阶段均能产生有前景的长时预测。各向异性空间建模对基于图的代理模型具有重要价值，为物理信息代理模型开辟了方向。局限包括：早期注入阶段预测精度较差、未考虑地质力学、仅限2D实验尺度、长滚动预测中误差累积仍具挑战。

title: Finsler Geometry, Graph Neural Networks, and You
summary: Graph neural network architectures based on the graph Laplacian approximate the Laplace-Beltrami operator, thus limiting their application to isotropic operators. As a nonlinear alternative to the Laplace-Beltrami operator, we consider estimates of the Finsler Laplacian on point clouds sampled from a manifold. We prove that these discrete estimates converge to the true operator on the manifold as the number of point samples grows. Moreover, we show that this operator can be expressed as a graph neural network layer, which we use to define a family of Finslerian graph neural networks constrained to express Finsler geometry. We show that Finslerian graph neural networks recover the geometry underlying nonlinear diffusion equations in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Finsler几何的图神经网络架构（Finslerian GNN），通过离散化点云上的Finsler Laplacian算子，突破了传统基于图Laplacian的GNN仅能处理各向同性算子的局限性，理论证明了离散估计随采样点数增加几乎处处收敛到连续算子，并在恢复非线性扩散方程几何的反问题实验中显著优于标准GNN。
AI.motivation: 传统基于图Laplacian的图神经网络隐式地将数据建模为黎曼流形上的采样，限制了其只能处理各向同性（isotropic）算子。Finsler几何作为黎曼几何的自然推广，允许非对称、非椭圆的各向异性几何结构，但目前缺乏将其系统性地引入图神经网络并保证收敛性的理论框架。
AI.method: 1. 在带有Minkowski范数F的加权Finsler流形上，通过对偶范数F*的平方定义能量泛函E[f]，其Fréchet导数给出非线性Finsler Laplacian Δ[f] = (1/p) div(pJ(∇f))，其中J(ξ) = F*(ξ)∇_ξF*(ξ)。2. 在点云上定义经验梯度估计（通过核加权协方差矩阵的软伪逆C†_ε,n），并据此构造经验Finsler Laplacian Δ_ε,n。3. 证明收敛定理：当ε = O((log n/n)^{1/(3d+4)})时，max_j |Δ[f](x_j) - L[f](x_j)| → 0（几乎处处）。4. 利用细胞层（cellular sheaf）框架将Finsler图Laplacian表示为GNN层，其中J作为在提升空间（余切空间）中应用的非线性激活函数。5. 通过用参数化映射Ĵ(ξ) = W^⊤σ(Wξ)（其中σ为1次正齐次激活函数）替换J，定义Finslerian GNN族，在图神经扩散方程f˙(t) = -L̂_W(t)[f(t)]框架下学习Finsler度量。6. 命题3.1证明：若V=W、rank(W)=D且σ'>0，则Ĵ诱导的F̂*是（几乎）Minkowski范数，线性激活下则退化为黎曼范数。
AI.result: 1. 理论结果：Finsler图Laplacian在点云上以O(ε_n)的均匀逐点误差几乎处处收敛到连续Finsler Laplacian（定理2.3）。2. 收敛实验：在环面上使用ℓ_3范数定义的Finsler Laplacian，验证了当n从250增至9500时，图Laplacian与真实Laplacian的余弦相似度随n增长而提升，最优ε随密度增加缓慢减小，与理论一致。3. 学习几何反问题实验：从单位正方形（周期化为环面）上n=600个点的图中，利用20%标注节点恢复Randers度量（漂移向量v=[0.25, 0.25]）下的热扩散，ReLU FGNN在训练图和测试图上的MSE分别为1.6×10^{-5}和1.1×10^{-5}，显著优于线性FGNN（4.6×10^{-4}/1.4×10^{-4}）和标准ReLU/线性GNN（1.5×10^{-1}量级）；FGNN在未见过的测试图上无性能损失，而标准GNN出现过拟合。4. 定性结果：ReLU FGNN成功恢复了与真实Minkowski范数单位球匹配的度量，而线性FGNN仅能恢复椭圆（黎曼）形状。
AI.conclusion: 本文发展了在采样点云上逼近Finsler几何Laplacian算子的拓扑与代数工具，所提出的经验Finsler Laplacian具有均匀逐点收敛性，适用于PDE计算和半监督学习。通过将Finsler Laplacian结构与一类非线性GNN相关联，揭示了过度依赖各向同性的图信号处理和GNN方法的局限性，并提出将神经架构设计与已知几何结构（如Minkowski范数）相绑定可使学习解通过诱导几何获得可解释性，为各向异性、几何感知的图学习开辟了新方向。

title: Constrained Diffusion Models with Primal-Dual Inference
summary: This paper develops constrained diffusion models with primal-dual inference (PDI) to sample from optimal distributions of entropy-regularized optimization problems with \emph{average} constraints. We formalize constrained sampling in the Lagrangian dual domain, where the optimal distribution takes the form of a Gibbs distribution indexed by the optimal dual variable. Rather than estimating this dual multiplier before sampling and freezing it throughout generation, PDI jointly infers the optimal primal distribution and its parametrizing dual variable. Each reverse diffusion step denoises using the score field associated with the current multiplier and then updates the multiplier through dual ascent using the estimated constraint violation of the denoised samples. To enable this conditional score field, we train a single dual-conditioned score network over the family of Gibbs distributions induced by the dual variables encountered during inference. We prove that the time average of the dual variables generated along the inference trajectory converges to a neighborhood of the dual optimum and bound the effect of residual dual mismatch on the terminal distribution through schedule-dependent stability factors. We evaluate PDI on constrained sampling from a mixture of Gaussians, wireless resource allocation, and portfolio management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出约束扩散模型与原对偶推理（PDI）框架，用于从带平均约束的熵正则化优化问题的最优分布中采样。PDI将拉格朗日对偶变量作为推理时的状态变量，在反向扩散过程中交替执行去噪与对偶上升，联合推断原问题分布与对偶乘子。通过训练单一的对偶条件化分数网络建模整个Gibbs分布族，理论上证明了时间平均对偶变量收敛到最优对偶的邻域，并通过调度相关的稳定性因子界定了残余对偶失配对终端分布的影响。实验在约束高斯混合、无线功率控制（200用户）和投资组合管理（500资产）三个任务上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 标准扩散模型缺乏在采样过程中强制执行统计约束（如期望约束）的可靠机制。无线资源分配、投资组合管理等场景需要带平均约束的熵正则化随机优化问题，其最优解是概率分布而非确定性策略。现有方法（如双重训练DT）需在采样前估计并冻结对偶变量，但每个问题实例可能需要不同的最优乘子，估计困难且昂贵，且训练后采样器无法响应生成过程中的约束违反。点态约束方法（如PDM、PDL）则在每个样本上强制约束，过于保守，牺牲了最优性。
AI.method: PDI将约束采样形式化为拉格朗日对偶域中的鞍点问题，其中最优分布为关于最优对偶变量的Gibbs分布。核心算法包含：(1) 原始-对偶推理：在每个反向扩散步骤中，使用当前乘子对应的Gibbs分数场去噪，然后通过Tweedie后验均值估计约束违反量来更新乘子；(2) 训练单一的对偶条件化分数网络，覆盖推理过程中遇到的整个Gibbs分布族；(3) 利用探索-利用回放缓冲机制生成训练对（噪声样本, 对偶变量）；(4) 多个并行采样链增强鲁棒性。算法包含训练阶段（Algorithm 1）和推理阶段（Algorithm 2）。理论分析方面，证明了时间平均对偶变量以O(1/√T)速率收敛到最优对偶的邻域（Theorem 1），并通过稳定性乘积Ψ_{s,T}界定了Wasserstein距离下的终端分布误差传播（Theorem 2）。
AI.result: 在三个任务上验证：(1) 约束高斯混合（K=12个模态，M=10个约束，30维空间）：PDI在保持完全可行性的同时获得最佳目标值和模态多样性，优于PDM和PDL；(2) 无线功率分配（N=200用户）：PDI-Net达到95.5%可行性、5%分位速率0.613、平均违反0.0062，在均值速率与可行性之间取得最佳平衡，显著优于未约束模型（85.6%可行性）和PDM（91.9%）；(3) 投资组合管理（N=500资产）：PDI-Net取得最高可行性0.91下均值回报0.189，为约束满足的扩散方法中最佳。消融实验表明：固定对偶变量（无论最终迭代还是时间平均）均劣于完整PDI动态；DDPM余弦和线性噪声调度提供最佳稳定性；PDI对分布外约束（不同r_min）表现出比DT更强的鲁棒性；DT+（冻结对偶并额外训练1000轮）可接近PDI性能但训练成本显著更高。
AI.conclusion: PDI通过将拉格朗日对偶变量的推理从训练阶段移至采样阶段，实现了约束扩散采样的新范式。其核心优势在于：单一对偶条件化分数网络能够跨问题实例和约束配置泛化，推理时对偶更新与去噪的紧耦合使得分数场始终与当前乘子匹配，路径依赖的Gibbs分数场序列产生了优于固定乘子采样的混合效应。噪声调度在控制对偶失配传播中起关键作用——早期高噪声阶段抑制误差，后期低噪声阶段在乘子已收敛后进行精炼。局限性包括：收敛保证仅适用于时间平均对偶迭代而非最终迭代或原始分布本身；对偶变量先验和熵正则强度β需问题特定调优。未来方向包括自适应对偶步长、机会约束问题及更大规模应用。

title: Sum-of-Squares Degree Barriers for the Reweighted-Hinge Method in Robust Halfspace Learning: A Christoffel-Function Characterization
summary: A certificate that removes outliers sees the data only through its low-degree moments, and an adversary exploits exactly this, hiding corruption where the clean data already looks typical, in the blind spot no bounded-degree test resolves. That blind spot turns out to have an exact size: the Christoffel function of the clean marginal, the very quantity modern data analysis thresholds to detect outliers, here read from the adversary's side as the corruption a bounded-degree certificate cannot remove. We turn this inversion into the organizing principle of the reweighted-hinge approach to robustly learning $\gamma$-margin halfspaces under malicious noise (Shen, 2025; Zeng and Shen, 2025): the governing resource is the Sum-of-Squares degree of the outlier-removal certificate, and the resolution principle states that the maximal corruption mass which can hide at a center $c$ from a degree-$2t$ certificate is exactly the Christoffel function $\lambda_{t+1}(c)$ of the clean marginal. Three consequences follow, all against the certificate method (not information-theoretic). A margin-degree tradeoff: certifying the dense pancake to error $\epsilon$ costs SoS degree $\Omega(\log(1/\epsilon))$ or margin $\Omega(\sqrt{\log(1/\epsilon)}/\sqrt{d})$, explaining why the $\log(1/\epsilon)$ margin Shen (2025) records is forced, with a weighted-Chebyshev reduction making the threshold $2t=\Theta((|c|/s)^2)$ tight modulo one classical weighted-extremal estimate. A degree-$2$ outlier barrier: the resolution principle realized as an explicit instance on which degree $2$ is stuck at $\eta^{1/2}$ while degree $4$ escapes, locating the method's small breakdown rate in the degree, not the analysis. And a degree-$2t$ algorithm tracing the frontier $\eta^{1-1/2t}$ (recovering Shen (2025) at $t=1$), whose gain is an explicit constant, capped by the pancake density and shown unimprovable by the degree-$2$ barrier.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于Christoffel函数的统一框架，揭示了重加权hinge方法在恶意噪声下鲁棒学习γ-margin半空间的核心资源是异常值去除证书的SoS(平方和)次数。核心"分辨率原理"指出：能够隐藏在中心c处不被次数-2t证书检测到的最大污染质量，恰好等于干净边缘分布的Christoffel函数λ_{t+1}(c)。由此推导出三个紧密相关的结论：(1)margin-次数权衡；(2)次数-2异常值屏障；(3)次数-2t算法追踪前沿η^(1-1/2t)。
AI.motivation: Shen(2025)与Zeng-Shen(2025)的重加权hinge方法在鲁棒学习γ-margin半空间时存在两个公认的局限性：(1)可容忍的恶意噪声率η₀极小（如2^(-32)），且"无法接近1/2的最优崩溃点"；(2)所需margin具有"不自然"的对数依赖γ=Ω(log(1/ε)/√d)，而非所期望的Ω(1/√d)。作者认为这两个限制并非特定常数或松散不等式的人为产物，而是由证书的SoS次数这一单一资源所决定。本文旨在将次数确立为该方法的关键资源，并通过Christoffel函数提供完整刻画。
