title: Continuous-time Optimal Stopping through Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Simulation based solvers for optimal stopping problems must discretize the stopping decision. Under classical dynamic programming, a coarse exercise grid with only a few stopping opportunities can materially undervalue the optimal expected reward, whereas on a very fine grid, approximation errors accumulate through the backward recursion. To remove this limitation, we develop a new reinforcement-learning inspired algorithm that enables us to learn the exercise rule at arbitrarily fine time resolution. Our CARLOS (Continuous-time Adaptive Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Stopping) algorithm utilizes an aggregate deep neural network (ADNN) to learn a joint space-time decision boundary. Starting from a coarse time grid, we progressively increase the frequency of stopping opportunities, while in parallel training the ADNN to refine its timing-value estimates. We moreover design an adaptive sampling strategy that gradually concentrates training effort near the stopping boundary. Benchmarked results show that CARLOS delivers higher prices than existing Bermudan solvers, approaching the American upper bound, and achieves high computational efficiency relative to non-RL comparators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARLOS算法（Continuous-time Adaptive Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Stopping），通过聚合深度神经网络（ADNN）和强化学习，解决了最优停止问题中长期存在的Bermudan离散化与连续时间American期权定价之间的价值缺口问题。该方法从粗时间网格出发，逐步细化停止频率，并采用自适应采样策略和"延迟停止"探索机制，在多个维度的期权合约上实现了接近American上界的高精度定价，同时计算效率显著优于直接在高密度网格上训练的ADNN。
AI.motivation: 基于模拟的最优停止问题求解器（如Longstaff-Schwartz蒙特卡洛方法）必须对停止决策进行时间离散化。粗网格会导致显著的American-Bermudan价值低估，而细网格则因动态规划反向递归中的误差累积而失效。尽管该领域研究丰富，但可行Bermudan求解器与原始American合约之间的差距从未得到充分解决。此外，现有方法通常仅在单一离散网格上独立训练多个时间步的回归替代模型，未能利用各时间步之间的结构相似性。
AI.method: CARLOS算法采用两阶段框架：第一阶段使用传统LSMC在粗网格上生成训练数据，并训练一个将时间t与状态x同时作为输入的聚合深度神经网络（ADNN）来近似整个时空时机价值超曲面；第二阶段通过强化学习循环（5-12次），在并行训练ADNN的同时逐步细化求解器网格（默认每步减半），应对"概念漂移"挑战。核心技术创新包括：(1) 探索-利用平衡的自适应采样密度（由探索、边界正向、边界负向、终端四类锚点组成），随网格细化将探索比例逐步重分配至利用；(2) "延迟停止"（delayed stopping）技术——为起源于停止区域的路径设置等待期Δ_wait，使其有机会进入延续区域以扩展延续区，避免RL过程持续收缩；(3) 基于验证路径奖励差的Delta法置信区间，自适应决定何时过渡到更细的求解器网格。神经网络默认使用3层ReLU前馈网络，Adam优化器，均方误差损失。
AI.result: 在7个1-5维的美式期权基准合约（Basket Put和Max Call）上测试：CARLOS在所有合约上的价格均高于现有Bermudan文献值，更接近PDE上界。例如M2.A合约的CARLOS价格为14.171，接近PDE上界14.214，捕获了相对Bermudan基线13.901超过90%的2%价值差距。在计算效率方面，CARLOS相比直接在高密度网格上训练的ADNN基线实现3-5倍加速（M3合约达到10倍）。消融研究验证了关键设计：平衡的探索-利用权重（λ_exl=0.55, λ_±=0.2, λ_ter=0.05）、逐步重分配因子c_expl=0.25、延迟停止系数c_dlst∈[1.1,1.3]、网格半减半调度，以及5-12个RL循环即可实现数值收敛。
AI.conclusion: CARLOS首次实现了基于蒙特卡洛模拟框架的连续时间最优停止求解，通过ADNN提供任意时刻的停止规则。其"一石二鸟"的网格迭代细化机制同时控制概念漂移并显著降低运行时间。两种关键创新——探索性停止和自适应训练样本——有效解决了随网格细化而收缩的延续区域问题。CARLOS在缺乏PDE基准的高维场景下，产出的价格高于所有先前文献报告值。未来工作可探索CNN/LSTM等替代架构，并将该思想推广至多重停止（swing options）、最优切换、最优脉冲控制以及深度BSDE求解器等相关控制问题。

title: SpatioTemporal Causal Network Diagnostics for Geographic Tipping Point Early Warning
summary: Geographic tipping points in ecosystems, climate subsystems, or ice sheets pose severe challenges for localized early warning. Classical spatial indicators such as Moran's I summarize global spatial structure, but they struggle with three issues: spatial dilution, Euclidean assumptions, and correlated noise. This paper introduces SpatioTemporal Causal Network Diagnostics (ST-CND), a framework that addresses these three issues by representing the geographic field as a time-evolving directed causal network. The core workflow is as follows: (1) infer which spatial nodes help predict other nodes via transfer entropy, replacing fixed Euclidean neighborhoods with data-driven information-flow topology; (2) estimate local recovery rates within each candidate subnetwork via dynamic mode decomposition; and (3) identify the most vulnerable subnetwork by combining three signals, namely high internal fluctuation, high internal synchronization, and low external coupling, thereby suppressing false alarms from spatially correlated noise. Validated on synthetic bifurcations and two observational sea-surface temperature benchmarks, namely Indo-Pacific SST and North Atlantic AMOC, ST-CND delivers localized and interpretable warnings. On the AMOC task, it achieves an AUROC of 0.783 and a critical-subnetwork IoU of 0.378, outperforming recurrence-network and lambda-AR1 baselines. The framework provides an interpretable and scalable pipeline for spatial early warning in Earth system science.

AI.tldr: ST-CND（时空因果网络诊断）是一个针对地理临界点早期预警的框架。它将地理场建模为时变有向因果网络，通过传递熵推断信息流拓扑，用动态模态分解（Graph-DMD）估计局部恢复率，并结合"高内部波动+高内部同步+低外部耦合"三信号准则定位最脆弱子网络，从而克服传统空间指标（如Moran's I）面临的空间稀释、欧氏假设和相关噪声三大问题。在AMOC（北大西洋经向翻转环流）任务上取得AUROC 0.783和关键子网络IoU 0.378，优于循环网络和λ-AR1基线。
AI.motivation: 地球系统（生态系统、气候子系统、冰盖等）的临界点（如AMOC、亚马逊森林、萨赫勒等）一旦跨越将产生严重影响。现有空间早期预警指标存在三大局限：（1）空间稀释——小区域局部临界信号被全局平均掩盖；（2）欧氏假设——固定邻域结构无法捕捉远程遥相关（如太平洋气候遥相关、青藏高原季风-冰冻圈耦合）；（3）相关噪声——空间相关红噪声可使Moran's I等全局自相关指标产生误报，无法区分内部耦合与外部噪声。这些问题在斑块状系统（旱地植被、永久冻土、季风边界）中尤为突出。
AI.method: ST-CND采用滚动窗口流水线，包含三大核心步骤：（1）因果拓扑重构——在去趋势残差场上计算配对KSG传递熵，通过IAAFT代理检验和Benjamini-Hochberg FDR校正构建有向邻接矩阵A^(t)，形成数据驱动的因果邻域M_i^(t)；（2）子图约束物理衰减提取——在每个候选子网络上执行Graph-DMD（基于Gavish-Donoho最优秩截断），将离散特征值映射为连续时间增长率ω，获得主导衰减代理γ_lead；（3）临界子网络识别——计算DNSD三信号：内部标准差SD_in、内部平均绝对Pearson相关PCC_in、外部平均绝对相关PCC_out，构建比值指标I_ST-CND=(SD_in·PCC_in)/(PCC_out+ε)以抑制红噪声误报，并结合γ_lead的衰减门控得到风险分数R_ST-CND；（4）通过五特征（γ_lead、I_ST-CND、SD_in、PCC_in、PCC_out）的弹性网逻辑回归输出标定化的倾覆概率P_tip。算法复杂度：TE为O(N²)，Graph-DMD为O(N·r²·w)。
AI.result: （1）合成实验——Allen-Cahn反应扩散场局部成核、遥连接空间系统、相关红噪声零假设、随机鞍节点轨迹四类验证表明ST-CND能定位局部前兆、恢复非局部遥连接、控制红噪声误报，且Graph-DMD在多变量恢复率追踪上优于全局DMD和Hankel-DMD；（2）Moran's I在σ=0至4.0的平滑下从-0.0078升至0.9532（queen权重），几乎全误报，而ST-CND保持在名义5%水平；（3）AMOC/HadISST（1870–2022，2°网格）：AUROC 0.783（95% CI 0.760–0.807），AUPRC 0.533，IoU 0.378，相对循环网络（AUROC 0.500）和λ-AR1（0.596）分别提升+0.283和+0.187；（4）OISST印度洋-太平洋（1982–2022，4°网格）：AUROC 0.720（0.652–0.782），AUPRC 0.330，IoU 0.240，均优于经典EWS、Moran's I和Donges气候网络基线，并提供独有的有向因果拓扑输出。
AI.conclusion: ST-CND整合信息流拓扑、动态因果网络评分与DMD恢复率估计，将全局欧氏统计转化为局部化、可解释、信息流驱动的诊断，显著提升了空间早期预警的定位能力、遥连接恢复能力和红噪声鲁棒性。局限性包括：配对TE的O(N²)复杂度限制高分辨率应用；推断的邻接为信息流图而非结构性因果图（Wiener-Granger意义，非Pearl干预意义）；非均匀红噪声下的鲁棒性仍待解决。未来方向包括PCMCI因果发现、Hankel-DMD、Floquet/特征值稳定性分析、时间不可逆性诊断以及多尺度分层ST-CND扩展。该框架可推广至生态、流行病学、社会等具有遥连接与红噪声污染的空间扩展系统。

title: Reducing Learner Redundancy in Boosting via Residual Orthogonalization
summary: While sequential residual fitting is the bedrock of standard boosting frameworks, it inherently breeds learner redundancy by repeatedly revisiting correlated error components. To address this bottleneck, we propose a shift from residual fitting to \textit{residual orthogonalization} and introduce SCBoost. Our framework tackles redundancy through two complementary mechanisms: Spectral Residual Projection (SRP) and Covariance-Regularized Weighting (CRW). During training, SRP projects each residual target onto the orthogonal complement of the historical prediction subspace, forcing successive learners to capture only novel empirical innovations. During aggregation, CRW optimizes ensemble weights on a validation set with an explicit covariance penalty to mitigate remaining correlations. Theoretically, we provide a finite-sample geometric characterization proving that SRP yields an exact additive residual-energy decomposition. Furthermore, under an isotropic-noise assumption, we rigorously establish the conditions under which this projection improves the effective Signal-to-Noise Ratio. Extensive experiments across ten benchmark datasets demonstrate that SCBoost delivers strong out-of-the-box performance, particularly in accuracy and F1 score. This work reinterprets boosting through a geometric lens, suggesting that explicit redundancy control is a principled and necessary step toward more efficient ensemble architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCBoost框架，将传统Boosting的残差拟合转变为残差正交化，通过谱残差投影(SRP)在训练阶段净化学习目标，并结合协方差正则化加权(CRW)在聚合阶段抑制冗余，在10个基准数据集上取得优异的开箱即用性能。
AI.motivation: 标准Boosting框架(如XGBoost、LightGBM)几十年来一直依赖序贯残差拟合机制，导致新学习器反复拟合高度相关的误差分量，形成"冗余瓶颈"，限制集成模型的泛化能力。现有提升多样性的方法(如负相关学习NCL、随机化策略)仅将多样性作为软约束附加在损失函数中，未触及问题的根源——残差目标本身的强相关性。
AI.method: SCBoost包含两个互补机制：(1) 谱残差投影(SRP)：在训练新学习器前，对历史预测矩阵做截断SVD，按能量阈值α选取top-k左奇异向量构建正交补空间，将残差投影到该正交补上，使新学习器仅拟合与历史预测正交的信息成分；(2) 协方差正则化加权(CRW)：在验证集上优化集成权重，最小化逻辑损失加协方差惩罚项w^T C w（基于模糊分解动机）。算法将数据划分为训练集与内部验证集，采用80/20嵌套验证策略。理论上证明了SRP是有限样本下的精确正交投影（命题2.1），并给出固定子空间各向同性噪声下SNR改善的充要条件ρ < k/n（命题2.2）。
AI.result: 在10个基准数据集上，SCBoost以默认参数在9个数据集上取得最佳或并列最佳的ACC和F1分数，在Madelon、Jasmine、Bioresponse、Pol、Elevators上提升显著（Wilcoxon检验p<0.01）。即使与经过Optuna调优的7个SOTA基线相比，SCBoost仍在5个数据集的ACC和F1上全部胜出。多样性指标（Q统计量、Disagreement、Ambiguity）和预测历史的扁平奇异值谱验证了SRP对冗余的有效抑制。消融实验表明SRP与CRW均贡献性能，组合时效果最佳。噪声鲁棒性实验中，SCBoost在10%-30%标签翻转噪声下保持竞争力。但计算开销方面，由于SRP需O(nT³)的SVD运算，SCBoost比XGBoost和LightGBM慢1-2个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 本文从几何视角重新诠释Boosting，提出显式冗余控制是实现更高效集成架构的原理性必要步骤。理论分析明确了正交化提升有效SNR的精确条件。实验证实了该框架在开箱即用场景下的强大性能。未来工作将聚焦于设计计算上更可扩展的投影技术，以将该非冗余Boosting范式部署到更大规模的工业应用中。

title: When Dynamics Models Read the Wrong Time Steps: Label-Free Event Credit Re-Anchoring for Robust Global Readouts
summary: Learned dynamics models often answer global physical questions, such as fault severity or impact stiffness, by pooling a per-step feature sequence into one readout vector. This sequence-to-global interface creates an under-studied temporal credit problem: with only trajectory-level supervision, a model can predict accurately in training conditions while reading from abundant smooth correlates rather than the brief physical events that determine the target. We call this failure temporal credit dilution. It is not exposed by the training loss and is not removed by standard physics-informed residuals, because the error lies in where the global readout assigns functional credit. We introduce Credit-in-Event, an interface-level probe for measuring how much pooled credit lands on event steps, and prove in closed form that a pooled linear reader routes credit to a spurious background channel as the event fraction shrinks. We then propose CREST, a training-free and label-free readout that estimates a transient event core from learned features and re-anchors the pooled representation through event-versus-rest contrast. Across simulated gear and impact systems, recurrent and attention encoders, and public bearing vibration data, CREST reduces out-of-distribution error while restoring event credit. Ablations show that stable-step selection and receptive-field shrinking fail, confirming that the gain comes from event-core credit re-anchoring rather than a generic locality or stability prior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"时序信用稀释"(temporal credit dilution)问题——序列到全局的动力学读出器在分布内表现良好,但实际上将功能信用分配给与标签相关的平滑背景特征,而不是决定目标的稀疏物理事件。论文提出Credit-in-Event探针量化该问题,并设计CREST方法——一种无需训练、无需标签的读出器,通过低通残差估计瞬态事件核心并以事件-背景对比的方式重新锚定池化表示。
AI.motivation: 学习动力学模型常通过将逐步特征序列池化为单一读出向量来回答全局物理问题(如故障严重程度、冲击刚度)。由于只有轨迹级监督,模型可能依赖训练时与标签相关的平滑背景统计量而非真正决定目标的稀疏瞬态事件;这种失败无法被训练损失或物理信息残差暴露,只在分布偏移下才显现。现有捷径学习方法依赖分组/环境标签,而物理测量流中此类标签通常不可得,故需要在读出器层面、单一训练分布下进行干预。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析:建立稀疏事件两通道生成模型,证明池化线性读出器的事件信用随事件占比ε以Θ(ε²)缩减,而背景线索保持高信噪比(命题1);并证明输入梯度显著性无法揭示此失败(推论1)。2) Credit-in-Event探针:基于步骤特征与池化向量的余弦对齐定义ECM、Prec@|E|、CiE@1等指标。3) CREST方法:对每通道特征做高斯低通滤波后取残差得到瞬态性分数r_t,据此估计事件占比ε̂与对比权重α;用top-K'选择并膨胀得到选择掩码M,计算选择区、剩余区、全局均值后以α(选择-剩余)+(1-α)全局形成新池化向量,选择过程不可微且使用stop-gradient。4) 预算律:证明最优选择预算对应真实事件核心,过小或过大均会升高OOD风险。
AI.result: 在SG-Drive齿轮系统、冲击振子系统两个模拟器以及CWRU公开轴承振动数据上,使用循环和注意力两种编码器,单一无标签CREST配置在OOD上相对注意力池化分别降低29%(齿轮)和50%(冲击)误差,显著性p<0.001;事件信用(CiE@1与ECM)翻倍至三倍;在CWRU持有负载划分上将误差从0.874降至0.589。消融实验表明:稳定步骤选择(非瞬态)表现最差,感受野缩小无法修复信用分配,组鲁棒优化失败,证明增益来自事件核心的信用重锚定而非通用局部性或稳定性先验。掩蔽验证表明CREST确实依赖其选择的步骤(移除后误差灾难性上升),而注意力读出器几乎不使用真实事件。
AI.conclusion: 论文识别了序列到全局读出器中的时序信用稀释失败模式,从理论上解释了池化为何稀释稀疏事件信用,并提出了一种无需训练、无需标签的CREST读出器,通过瞬态核心重锚定恢复事件信用,降低分布外误差。局限包括:不适用于目标由扩散慢动力学决定、或虚假线索与事件共定位且同为瞬态的情况;实际数据仅覆盖一个公开轴承基准的单一持有负载协议;选择器基于学习特征,其与噪声的独立性假设是一种理想化。论文强调:对于全局物理问题,读出器"读哪些时间步"与损失函数同等重要。

title: Expanding SPHERE-JEPA: A Family of Statistical Regularizers for the Hypersphere
summary: In Self-Supervised Learning (SSL), preventing representation collapse by explicitly enforcing a uniform distribution on the unit hypersphere has proven to be effective. However, current frameworks typically rely on sliced statistical regularizers such as SIGReg (used in LeJEPA) and SUSReg (used in SPHERE-JEPA), which approximate this continuous objective via Monte Carlo sampling along random 1D directions. This stochasticity injects projection variance into the training gradients, destabilizing optimization, and hindering convergence. In this work, we first show that analytically integrating out these random projections natively yields a deterministic Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), bypassing the variance of sliced methods. Motivated by this equivalence, we formulate full-dimensional objectives for MMD, Kernel Stein Discrepancy (KSD), and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence directly on the sphere to enforce a uniform distribution. To prevent spatial bias, we equip these tests with rotationally invariant kernels constructed via spectral theory, systematically evaluating two canonical families: smooth exponential decay (Heat) and strict frequency cutoff (Bandlimited) filters. Empirically, removing projection-induced noise results in more stable optimization, faster convergence, and consistent improvements over stochastic sliced regularizers on ImageNet and Galaxy10. Furthermore, we reveal that the choice of the statistical test shapes the geometry of the learned latent space: MMD and KSD favor locally clustered organization suitable for object-centric domains, whereas the continuous KDE-based KL divergence promotes fine-grained instance separation, yielding the strongest results on unclustered procedural texture retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文针对自监督学习(SSL)中防止表征坍缩的均匀性正则化方法进行研究，指出当前基于切片统计正则化（如 SIGReg、SUSReg）的随机投影方法会引入梯度方差、破坏优化稳定性。作者通过解析积分随机投影方向，证明其等价于确定性的最大均值差异(MMD)，并据此在球面上直接构建 MMD、核 Stein 差异(KSD)和 KL 散度的全维度目标函数，配合基于谱理论构造的旋转不变核（热核与带限核），实现了更稳定、更快速的训练收敛，并在 ImageNet 与 Galaxy10 上全面优于切片方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于球面均匀性约束的 SSL 框架（如 LeJEPA、SPHERE-JEPA）依赖 SIGReg 或 SUSReg 等切片统计正则化器，这些方法通过沿随机 1D 方向进行蒙特卡洛采样来近似连续的均匀性目标。这种随机投影方式会在训练梯度中引入投影方差，从而破坏优化稳定性并阻碍收敛。因此，亟需一种确定性的、无投影噪声的全维度均匀性正则化方法，以提升 SSL 训练的可重复性与效率。
AI.method: 1. 理论推导：证明对随机投影方向进行解析积分后，切片统计正则化器自然等价于确定性的 MMD，从而绕过切片方法的方差问题。2. 全维度目标构建：在球面上直接构建 MMD、核 Stein 差异(KSD) 以及基于核密度估计(KDE)的 KL 散度目标函数，以强制表征服从均匀分布。3. 旋转不变核设计：利用谱理论构造具备旋转不变性的核函数，系统比较两类典型核族——光滑指数衰减型（热核，Heat）与严格频率截断型（带限核，Bandlimited），以消除空间偏置。4. 系统性实验：在 ImageNet 和 Galaxy10 数据集上对比切片方法，评估优化稳定性、收敛速度与下游性能。
AI.result: 1. 优化层面：消除投影噪声后，优化过程更稳定、收敛速度更快。2. 性能层面：在 ImageNet 和 Galaxy10 上相较随机切片正则化器取得一致性的性能提升。3. 几何层面：不同统计检验塑造出不同的潜在空间几何——MMD 与 KSD 倾向于局部聚类组织（适合以对象为中心的领域）；基于 KDE 的 KL 散度促进细粒度的实例分离，在无聚类结构的过程性纹理检索任务上取得最佳表现。4. 核函数层面：热核与带限核各有优势，为不同数据特性提供了灵活的核选择。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过将切片统计正则化器解析等价转化为确定性 MMD，建立了无需随机投影的全维度球面均匀性正则化框架。所提出的基于 MMD/KSD/KL 的目标函数配合旋转不变谱核，在稳定性、收敛性与下游任务性能上均优于现有切片方法。更重要的是，研究揭示了统计检验的选择会显著影响所学潜在空间的几何结构：MMD/KSD 适合对象中心数据，KDE-KL 适合细粒度纹理数据，为 SSL 中均匀性正则化的核与统计检验设计提供了系统性指导。

title: Physics-Constrained Neural Networks for Improved Short-Term Weather Forecasting: A Case Study over the South Pacific
comment: Presented at ICLR 2026 Workshop AI and PDE
summary: This study introduces enhancements to physics-constrained neural networks (PCNNs) that improve the accuracy and stability of hybrid short-term weather forecasting models. Building on the WeatherGFT architecture, three innovations are proposed. First, an upgraded numerical solver, combining a fifth-order weighted essentially non-oscillatory scheme (WENO-5), a beta-plane approximation, and subgrid-scale viscosity, permits a fourfold increase in the integration time step to 1200 s while reducing the daily mean squared error by up to 26%. Second, a unified autoregressive hybrid block replaces the original chain of 24 specialised modules, eliminating overfitting to specific lead times. Third, the physical core is integrated with two state-of-the-art neural backbones, resulting in PI-PredFormer and PI-IAM4VP. Evaluation on the WeatherBench South Pacific subset from 2000 to 2004 shows that these hybrids reduce root mean squared error at 1-12 h lead times by 8-22% compared to purely neural counterparts, while better preserving physical consistency. These results demonstrate that incremental refinement of hybrid components offers a practical route toward more accurate and efficient short-range weather forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文在WeatherGFT架构基础上提出三项改进：(1)使用WENO-5格式、β平面近似和次网格粘性升级数值求解器，将时间步长提高4倍至1200秒并降低日均MSE达26%；(2)将24个专用模块替换为统一的单小时自回归混合块，消除特定预报时效的过拟合；(3)将物理核心与PredFormer和IAM4VP两种先进神经骨干结合，构建PI-PredFormer和PI-IAM4VP混合模型。在WeatherBench南太平洋子集(2000–2004)上的评估显示，所提混合模型在1–12小时预报时效内将RMSE较纯神经模型降低8–22%，同时更好地保持物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 短期天气预报(1–24小时)对航空、海运和应急响应等关键领域至关重要。传统数值天气预报(NWP)计算成本高且依赖经验性参数化方案，而纯机器学习模型虽速度快但常违反物理规律。WeatherGFT等混合模型尝试结合两者优势，但仍存在三个问题：(1)求解器受CFL条件限制，时间步长小，计算效率低；(2)24个专用模块链在固定训练时效上易过拟合，时效间误差不连续；(3)缺乏与最新高效时空预测架构的整合。因此需要系统性地改进混合模型的物理核心和神经骨干的耦合方式。
AI.method: 三项核心创新：(1)**升级求解器**：采用五阶WENO格式计算水平导数、引入β平面纬度相关科氏力项f(φ)=f₀+βRφ、添加次网格涡粘性ν_e∇²u(ν_e≈10⁴ m²/s)，使时间步长从300秒提升至1200秒，GPU计算时间减少70%以上。(2)**统一混合块**：将24个15分钟专用模块压缩为包含6个PDE核和2个神经模块的单个小时级自回归块，使用可学习权重γ∈R^(C×H×W)自适应平衡物理与神经贡献；每步由两个30分钟子步组成以适应Shifting Windows注意力机制。(3)**两种混合架构**：PI-PredFormer采用MIMO策略，PredFormer因子化时空注意力生成12小时预报后，每15分钟施加事后物理修正（3个20分钟PDE核）；PI-IAM4VP采用半自回归策略，将输入分为历史观测流X和自回归预测流Y，结合空间编码器、ConvNeXt预测器和解码器，每小时嵌入物理修正。实验在WeatherBench南太平洋子集(5.625°N–39.375°S, 174.375°E–95.625°W)上进行，分辨率128×256，13个气压层(50–1000 hPa)，2000–2003年训练、2004年评估。
AI.result: 在南太平洋2000–2004年WeatherBench数据上的评估结果显示：(1)**求解器升级**：Z的RMSE在6小时内保持低于0.2（基线仅3小时），T的低误差延伸至近12小时，Q在1小时初始RMSE降低近30%，所有变量误差增长均放缓。(2)**WeatherGFT-Single**：参数从256M降至99M，消除了24模块链的过拟合，长时效精度与原版相当甚至更优。(3)**短期(1–3 h)**：PI-PredFormer在Z150上表现最佳（1h: 81.9 m/s²），物理修正对仍锚定在观测的状态最有效。(4)**中短期(1–12 h)**：PI-IAM4VP在多数变量上误差最低，混合模型较纯神经模型RMSE降低8–22%，且物理一致性更优（ACC保持更高值）。(5)**长时效(24–60 h)**：纯数据驱动模型PredFormer反超（24h Z150: 218.93 vs PI-PredFormer 7%相对增加），因累积误差超出简化物理约束的修正能力。(6)空间诊断：混合模型在u150和q1000上再现更真实的天气尺度结构和湿度梯度，纯神经模型存在网格伪影和过度平滑。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过增量式改进混合模型组件，证明了物理约束与神经架构协同设计在1–12小时关键预报窗口中的实用价值。WeatherGFT-Single、PI-PredFormer和PI-IAM4VP三种模型分别从求解器效率、时空注意力和半自回归耦合三个维度推进了混合范式。未来工作应聚焦于：(1)神经与物理组件的更紧耦合，包括PDE求解器与神经骨干的联合训练；(2)响应预报状态的自适应权重方案；(3)纳入参数化次网格物理过程；(4)扩展至更大区域并引入辐射和地表通量等附加强迫项，以迈向业务化规模的稳健混合预报系统。物理信息修正最有效的场景是频繁施加且预报仍锚定在观测信息时；超长时效中纯数据驱动模型因简化PDE核心的不完整性而保持竞争力。

title: EnvRL: Learn from Environment Dynamics in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for training Large Language Models (LLMs) as agents. However, conventional RL methods for long-horizon agentic tasks often struggle with sparse outcome rewards. Intuitively, this overlooks the rich environment dynamics information contained in rollout interaction trajectories. We argue that the interaction experience inherently serves as an implicit supervision signal, reveals the underlying transition mechanisms of the environment, and enables the agent to construct a more accurate internal model of the environment.. Therefore, in this work, we investigate how to leverage this additional signal to improve policy learning. Specifically, we propose EnvRL, a framework that incorporates environment dynamics learning into agentic RL via two auxiliary objectives: state prediction and inverse dynamics. By jointly optimizing with the primary RL objective, we encourage the agent to internalize environment dynamics from its own interaction experience. Extensive experiments on two long-horizon agentic benchmarks demonstrate that EnvRL achieves significant improvements on success-rates over RL-only baselines, e.g., when trained with GRPO, lifting Qwen-2.5-1.5B-Instruct from 72.8% to 77.4% on ALFWorld, and from 56.8% to 67.0% on WebShop.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EnvRL 框架，针对智能体强化学习（agentic RL）中长程任务奖励稀疏的问题，将环境动力学学习（状态预测与逆动力学）作为两个辅助自监督目标，与主 RL 目标联合优化，从而让 LLM 智能体从自身交互经验中内化环境转移机制。
AI.motivation: 现有 agentic RL 方法（如 GRPO、GiGPO）主要依赖稀疏的轨迹级结果奖励，在长程多轮交互任务中信号有限；然而 rollout 交互轨迹中蕴含丰富的环境动力学信息（状态如何随动作转移），这些隐式监督信号尚未被充分利用，制约了策略学习的效率与上限。
AI.method: 1) **状态预测（SP）**：给定当前状态 s_t 和动作 a_t，预测下一状态 s_{t+1}，学习前向环境动力学 p(s_{t+1}|s_t, a_t)；2) **逆动力学（ID）**：给定相邻状态 (s_t, s_{t+1})，从候选动作集中推断导致该转移的动作 a_t，强化"动作-状态变化"的因果推理；3) 两者以 token 级交叉熵损失形式实现，复用 RL rollout 数据，只需额外一次前向传播；4) 采用**余弦衰减调度**控制辅助权重 λ_SP(t)、λ_ID(t)，使早期侧重动力学学习，后期平稳回归主 RL 目标；5) 与 GRPO/GiGPO 等策略优化方法正交，可即插即用。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 两个长程智能体基准上，EnvRL 持续提升多种基线和模型规模下的成功率：以 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct + GRPO 为例，ALFWorld 成功率从 72.8% 提升至 77.4%（+4.6），WebShop 从 56.8% 提升至 67.0%（+10.2）；在 7B 模型上结合 GiGPO 进一步达到 94.5% / 76.3%；在 SearchQA 工具调用任务上平均提升 +1.88%。消融实验表明 SP 与 ID 均贡献显著，移除任一项均带来明显下降；余弦衰减优于线性衰减和无衰减；OOD 测试场景下 EnvRL 仍保持泛化优势；辅助目标仅带来约 1.6s 的额外计算开销（rollout 154.6s），且能以约 68.5% 的训练步数达到基线最终性能；同时显著减少成功回合所需的交互轮数与响应长度。
AI.conclusion: EnvRL 是一种轻量、通用、即插即用的 agentic RL 增强框架，通过将环境动力学学习作为辅助自监督信号，有效缓解了稀疏奖励问题，在不同环境、模型规模与 RL 基线下均稳定提升性能与样本效率，为 agentic RL 提供了一种新的"从交互经验中学习"的视角。局限性包括：状态预测目标尚未适配多模态模型、辅助权重缺乏自适应调节机制，以及所探索的动力学监督信号仍有进一步拓展空间。

title: Delta-Based Target Reformulation for Short-Term Electricity Load Forecasting Using LSTM and Transformer Models
summary: Accurate short-term electricity load forecasting is critical for the reliable and economic operation of modern power systems, under non-stationarity arising from weather variability, calendar effects, and evolving consumption patterns. While deep learning models such as LSTMs and Transformers show promising performance, most existing studies focus on direct absolute load prediction without explicitly addressing target non-stationarity. Motivated by classical time-series differencing techniques in ARIMA models, this paper investigates a delta-based target reformulation for short-term electricity load forecasting using deep learning. Instead of directly predicting absolute load values, the proposed formulation trains models to predict the change in load between consecutive time steps, with final forecasts reconstructed using the last observed load. This aims to stabilize the learning target and reduce forecasting difficulty. Using multi-year, hourly real-world electricity load data from India, augmented with meteorological variables from the NASA POWER project and calendar features, this study evaluates LSTM and Transformer models under both formulations, benchmarking them against LightGBM. Experiments are conducted for hour-ahead and day-ahead horizons, assessing performance via Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE). Results show that delta-based reformulation consistently improves forecasting accuracy for hour-ahead prediction across all evaluated models, yielding MAPE reductions of over 50% compared to absolute formulations. For day-ahead forecasting, delta targets specifically benefit deep sequence models (LSTM and Transformer), while LightGBM remains competitive under the absolute formulation. These findings indicate that while delta reformulation is a powerful inductive bias for neural networks, its efficacy is model- and horizon-dependent.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了一种基于差分（delta）的目标重构方法，用于短期电力负荷预测，通过让模型预测相邻时间步的负荷变化而非绝对负荷值，提升LSTM和Transformer模型的预测精度。基于印度Chandigarh八年实测数据，验证了该方法在小时级预测中可降低MAPE超50%，并发现其效果具有模型与预测时长的依赖性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习短期负荷预测研究多直接预测绝对负荷值，未显式处理目标非平稳性问题。经典ARIMA模型通过差分处理非平稳性并稳定预测任务，受此启发，作者探究将差分思想应用于深度学习模型的目标重构，以期降低学习难度并提升预测精度。
AI.method: 提出delta-based目标重构策略：模型预测相邻时间步的负荷增量ΔL = L_{t+h} - L_t，而非直接预测绝对负荷L_{t+h}；多步预测时通过累加求和重建绝对值。采用LSTM和因果Transformer（Causal Transformer）作为深度学习模型，并使用LightGBM作为基线对比。输入特征包括168小时历史窗口、滞后负荷特征、滚动统计、NASA POWER气象数据（温度、湿度、湿球温度、风速）以及日历特征（小时、星期、月份的正弦余弦编码、节假日指示变量）。训练采用峰值加权MAE损失函数（对高负荷时段赋予2倍权重），评估指标为MAE和MAPE。数据按时间顺序划分：训练集2017.1-2022.12、验证集2022.12-2024.3、测试集2024.3-2025.6。
AI.result: 小时级预测：所有模型在delta形式下均显著优于绝对值形式，MAPE降低超50%——LSTM从5.67%降至2.55%（最优），LightGBM从5.57%降至2.67%，Transformer从6.96%降至3.50%。日级预测（T+24）：Transformer-Delta表现最佳（MAPE 6.88%），其次是LSTM-Delta（7.15%）；LightGBM在绝对值形式下更优（7.81% vs delta形式8.43%），因多步累加导致误差累积。两个深度学习模型均满足行业基准（小时级MAPE<3%，日级MAPE<7%）。
AI.conclusion: Delta-based目标重构是一种强大的归纳偏置，能有效稳定学习目标、提升深度学习模型预测精度。其效果具有模型与预测时长依赖性：所有模型在短时预测中均受益；长时预测中深度序列模型（LSTM和Transformer）仍受益，但树模型（LightGBM）因缺乏显式序列记忆而出现误差累积。实践中建议：LSTM用于超短期（小时级）调度，Transformer用于日级规划。

title: A fairness-aware extension of Stochastic Multicriteria Acceptability Analysis for ranking
summary: Fairness has become a central concern in ranking problems involving individuals or social groups, particularly under the Responsible Artificial Intelligence agenda. In Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis, Stochastic Multicriteria Acceptability Analysis (SMAA) provides a robust framework for handling uncertainty and incomplete preference information, but it does not explicitly address fairness in the resulting rankings. This paper proposes SMAA-Fair, a fairness-aware extension of SMAA for ranking problems. The approach reweights the simulated rankings generated by SMAA according to their level of group fairness, so that fairer rankings contribute more strongly to the acceptability indices and central weights vector. The framework is independent of the aggregation model and can incorporate different fairness metrics. In this study, Statistical Parity, normalized discounted Kullback--Leibler divergence (rKL) and normalized discounted cumulative Kullback--Leibler divergence (nDKL) are adopted. Rankings are derived from the fairness-adjusted acceptability matrix using expected ranking and maximum acceptability ranking. We also derive the central weight according to the degree of fairness in the obtained rankings. Numerical experiments with synthetic and real data show that SMAA-Fair improves the representation of protected groups among favourable ranking positions, while preserving robustness to preference uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SMAA-Fair，一种面向排序问题的公平性感知的随机多准则可接受性分析（SMAA）扩展方法。该方法根据模拟排序的群体公平性水平对其进行重加权，使得更公平的排序对可接受性指数和中心权重向量的贡献更大，从而在保持对偏好不确定性鲁棒性的同时，提升受保护群体在有利排名位置中的代表性。
AI.motivation: 在负责任人工智能（Responsible AI）议程下，公平性已成为涉及个人或社会群体的排序问题中的核心关注。多准则决策分析（MCDA）中的随机多准则可接受性分析（SMAA）虽然能有效处理偏好不确定性和不完全偏好信息，但并未显式地考虑排序结果的公平性。此外，在MCDA应用中纳入公平性考量同时处理偏好不确定性仍是该领域的一个开放性问题。因此，作者希望将群体公平性整合到SMAA框架中，扩展其应用范围。
AI.method: SMAA-Fair框架的核心思想是保留标准SMAA模拟过程的同时，根据每次模拟排序π^(l)所表现出的群体公平性水平对其贡献进行调节。具体步骤为：(1) 通过蒙特卡洛模拟采样L个权重向量并生成对应排序；(2) 为每个排序计算公平性指标值（采用统计均等SP、归一化折扣KL散度rKL和归一化折扣累积KL散度nDKL三种度量）；(3) 将公平性指标值映射为公平性权重f_l^Ω = max(指标值) - 当前指标值，使更公平的排序获得更高权重；(4) 构造公平性调整后的可接受性指数b̂_i^{s,Ω} = Σ f_l^Ω，并进行归一化；(5) 推导出公平性感知中心权重向量w_i^{c,Ω}，将权重向量的质心向更公平排序方向移动。排序结果通过预期排名（Expected Ranking）和最大可接受性排名（Maximum Acceptability Ranking, MAR）两种方法从公平性调整后的可接受性矩阵中提取。该框架与聚合模型无关，可兼容任何单调的多准则聚合方法。
AI.result: 在两个合成数据集（模拟结构性群体偏差和条件性结构偏差场景）和一个真实数据集（基于世界银行2020年可持续发展数据的179个国家排名）中，SMAA-Fair在所有配置下均展现出一致的公平性改善效果。在合成数据实验中，经典SMAA倾向于将特权群体排在前列，而公平性感知方法显著提升了弱势群体在top-10中的代表性，并有效降低了对引入偏差的准则（如机构声望）的权重分配。在真实数据实验中，针对top-20位置的公平性改善效果尤为突出：受保护群体（前发达经济体）的代表性从基线SMAA下的不均衡分布调整至与该群体在数据集中的实际比例（约80.5%）相匹配的水平（75%-85%），且这一改善在所有六种方法配置（3种公平性指标×2种排名方法）下均保持一致。
AI.conclusion: SMAA-Fair成功将群体公平性考量整合进SMAA框架，是一种模型无关的扩展方法。该方法通过模拟排序的公平性重加权机制，在保持对偏好不确定性鲁棒性的同时，有效改善了受保护群体在有利排名位置中的代表性。代价是可能违反Pareto支配性——这是实现分配公平性的合理权衡，因公平性与效用之间存在固有张力。未来研究方向包括：扩展至多个或重叠的受保护群体、纳入暴露公平性和个体公平性等其他公平性概念，以及研究非线性聚合函数（如Choquet积分）下的框架行为。

title: Blind Recovery of Latent Domains via Unsupervised Symmetry Discovery
summary: Primary motivation in blind inverse problems is to recover signals of interest from corrupted observations without knowing the obfuscating mechanism. Blind deconvolution is a prominent approach when the corruption is convolutional, but it is not applicable when general linear transformations obfuscate the domain structure. In this work, we propose an unsupervised framework for recovering latent domains and signals by discovering symmetries of the data distribution. Our framework models observations as linear measurements of signals sampled from a latent random field, and optimizes a shallow group-convolutional network by imposing stationarity and locality regularization at the model output. The model learns a latent symmetry action and an appropriate filter, thereby mapping unstructured observations to a symmetry-based representation that reveals latent signals. Experiments on stochastic processes, Ising models, shuffled and bit-scrambled images, and neural recordings show that the method recovers latent domains and signals from unstructured observations, suggesting symmetry discovery as a new direction for unsupervised structure learning and blind inverse problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无监督框架，通过发现数据分布的对称性来恢复潜在域和信号，适用于一般线性变换（而非仅限于卷积）导致的盲反问题。该方法优化一个浅层群卷积网络，施加平稳性和局部性正则化，在合成波形、Ising模型、乱序和位混淆MNIST图像以及神经记录等多种实验上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统盲反卷积方法仅适用于卷积形式的退化，而实际中许多未知变换（排列、位混淆、散射等）不具卷积结构，破坏了观测的显式几何，使得恢复潜在信号及其定义域都变得困难。因此，需要一种更通用的、不依赖卷积假设的盲反问题方法。
AI.method: 1) 将潜在域建模为局部相关平稳随机场，观测为潜在信号通过未知线性测量算子得到；2) 优化一个群卷积提升网络，学习对称群作用ρ̂和分辨滤波器w₀；3) 损失函数由三项组成：平稳性（最小化y表示与其沿各轴平移版本的JS散度）、分辨率（最小化总相关，诱导马尔可夫结构）和InfoMax（最大化联合高斯熵）；4) 理论分析证明了从平稳性到平移等变性再到卷积核、最终到对称识别的链条；5) InfoMax在固定L²范数约束下使核谱平坦，与紧凑性偏好结合恢复出δ核。
AI.result: 在GSN波形上r>0.85（优于GLASSO和协方差匹配基线）；在Ising模型上r=0.956；乱序MNIST 15×15和27×27上r=0.995和0.947（显著优于UMAP/Isomap的0.790和0.702）；位混淆MNIST上r=0.944和0.941；神经记录视觉编码数据集上圆形相关系数r_cc=0.851（vs Isomap 0.551, UMAP 0.347）。消融实验表明分辨率项对防止坍缩至关重要。Morris敏感性分析显示对超参数变化具有强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 对称性发现可作为无监督结构学习和盲反问题的新方向。该方法能在不依赖显式物理先验或卷积结构的情况下，从高维非结构化观测中恢复潜在域和信号。局限性包括：对平稳性和局部性先验的依赖可能导致部分满足时信号失真；计算复杂度受对角化过程限制（O(d³)）；目前仅适用于矩形或环形域，推广到更一般域几何需要发现非交换对称结构。

title: Continual Self-Improvement with Lightweight Experiential Latent Memories
summary: Large language models achieve strong reasoning performance by scaling inference-time compute, yet remain fundamentally stateless, discarding the rich, self-produced reasoning traces generated during this process. We investigate whether models can instead learn online from this experience, converting transient computation (reasoning traces) into persistent reusable knowledge, and without external supervision or access to future data. We show that In-Context Learning (ICL) over raw reasoning traces fails to generalize, reflecting a fundamental limitation of token-level reuse: individual traces lack the abstraction needed for transfer, even after refinement (e.g. self-reflection). In contrast, drawing inspiration from recent works on unsupervised reinforcement learning, we find that lightweight per-instance training with self-generated test-time signals (majority voting) as rewards yields substantial gains, often surpassing full-dataset offline training, motivating a shift from raw traces to learned latent representations. Building on this insight, we propose an online method that distills inference-time compute spent on encountered problems into compact modular latent memories capturing the underlying reasoning structure. These memories are stored and retrieved for future inputs, enabling continual improvement while avoiding catastrophic forgetting through modular design. Importantly, our method is highly efficient, parametrized as extremely lightweight soft prompt memories (~0.001% of model parameters) and trained with only a few gradient steps, yet achieving performance competitive with full parametric updates and offline training. Across challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks, our approach significantly outperforms zero-shot and raw data ICL baselines, while transferring effectively across datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ELM（Experiential Latent Memory），一种在线持续自我改进方法，将大语言模型在测试时计算产生的推理经验蒸馏为轻量级、可模块化的"软提示"潜在记忆（约占模型参数的 0.001%），使用 GRPO 配合多数投票自生成奖励进行训练。该方法在流式场景中逐样本积累记忆并通过检索增强推理，在数学推理基准上显著优于零样本和基于原始推理轨迹的 ICL 基线，性能可媲美全参数离线训练。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在推理时通过扩展测试时计算获得强大性能，但本质上是"无状态"的，丢弃了生成的丰富推理轨迹。现有工作存在两类局限：(1) 基于原始推理轨迹的 ICL 方法因"文本瓶颈"无法捕获抽象推理结构，难以泛化；(2) 基于无监督强化学习（如 TTRL）的离线方法需要预先访问完整测试集，且对全模型更新会导致灾难性遗忘和性能随数据积累退化。论文旨在解决核心问题：模型如何在无外部监督、无法访问未来数据的流式场景中，将瞬时计算转化为可复用的持久知识，实现持续自我改进。
AI.method: ELM 方法包含两个关键设计：(1) 记忆创建——对每个遇到的样本，使用 GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）配合多数投票自生成内部奖励（无需真实标签），冻结主模型，仅训练 20 个 token 的软提示（约 0.001% 参数），10 步梯度更新即可形成"经验潜在记忆"；(2) 记忆检索与路由——提出两种检索机制：基于输入嵌入的"input retrieval"和基于 KV 激活的"kv retrieval"（按层计算余弦相似度后取均值）；为应对记忆噪声，引入响应路由（verifier），在零样本响应与记忆增强响应不一致时使用 PRM 验证器选择更优者。算法在流式协议下逐样本运行：检索→生成双响应→路由选择→GRPO 训练新记忆→加入记忆池。
AI.result: 在 MATH500、AMC23、AIME24 三个数学推理基准上，使用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 两个模型族验证：(1) 离线实验中，单样本训练的软提示记忆泛化能力常超过全数据集离线训练（GRPO/TTRL），且优于 LoRA 和全模型参数化（软提示仅 0.08M 参数 vs LoRA 42M vs 全模型 7-8B）；(2) 在线实验中，ELM 稳定优于零样本及 ICL、Reasoning Bank、LAG 等训练免费基线，例如在 MATH500 上 Llama 达 51.4%（零样本 45%）、Qwen 达 72.5-72.6%（零样本 67%），常匹配或超越离线 GRPO/TTRL；(3) 记忆在 AIME24 与 AMC23 之间表现出跨数据集迁移能力；(4) 记忆存在样本特异专门化现象（top-2 记忆 IoU 仅 0.37-0.55），证明检索与路由机制的必要性；(5) LoRA 记忆在在线设置中完全失败，原因是检索系统性地偏向离线表现差的记忆（"检索错位"问题）。
AI.conclusion: ELM 展示了将测试时计算蒸馏为轻量级模块化潜在记忆的可行性，单样本训练即可获得强泛化能力，性能媲美全参数离线训练，同时避免了灾难性遗忘和持续计算开销。该工作迈出了大语言模型持续自我改进的第一步。但仍存在若干开放问题：如何识别能产生高质量记忆的样本（目前未发现简单免训练统计量与记忆效用间的强相关性）、记忆的组合性、更新/合并/淘汰机制，以及如何将记忆最终蒸馏回主模型。未来工作可探索更高效的决策策略替代验证器、记忆的离线合并与巩固等方向。

title: QueryMarket: Cost-Aware Online Active Learning in Data Markets
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
summary: Data acquisition is a major bottleneck for learning in real-time streams: analysts must decide on the fly which labels to purchase while respecting a rolling budget. However, existing online active learning rarely unifies pricing, information gain, and rolling budget constraints under concept drift. We introduce QueryMarket, a market-inspired framework that queries each incoming data point based on its estimated utility to the model and its price. Within this framework, we propose OVBAL (online variance-based active learning), which integrates data pricing with information-driven selection by estimating each sample's marginal utility via a D-optimality criterion with exponential forgetting and executing cost-aware purchases under rolling budget constraints. OVBAL yields a simple, fully online decision rule that adapts to nonstationary streams and heterogeneous label costs. Experiments on synthetic data and a real-world solar power generation forecasting task show that OVBAL is particularly effective under seller-centric pricing and yields a more favorable long-run error-cost trade-off in the real-world task under both pricing schemes.

AI.tldr: QueryMarket是一个面向流式数据场景的市场驱动型在线主动学习框架，其中分析师需在滚动预算约束下即时决定是否购买标签。论文提出了OVBAL（在线方差驱动主动学习）策略，基于D-最优性准则结合指数遗忘机制评估样本边际信息增益，并在买卖双方异质定价下执行成本感知查询。实验表明，OVBAL在卖方定价下优势显著，在真实太阳能预测任务中两种定价机制下均能获得更优的长期误差-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 在线流式学习场景中，标签获取成本高且常需实时决策，但现有在线主动学习很少同时整合定价、信息增益与滚动预算约束，并应对概念漂移问题。论文旨在填补这一空白，将数据市场机制引入流式标签采集过程，使分析师能在非平稳环境中平衡样本效用与购买成本。
AI.method: 1）QueryMarket框架建模：分析师发布愿意支付价格（WTP，bid=φ·ℓ̂），卖方发布愿意出售价格（WTS，η_t），交易在bid≥η_t且预算可行时发生；支持买方定价（p_t=bid）与卖方定价（p_t=η）两种机制。2）OVBAL策略：采用线性回归模型（支持非线性特征嵌入），通过指数遗忘和Newton-Raphson递归更新维护参数β_t、信息矩阵H_t和残差方差σ²_y,t；以未缩放预测方差u_t= x̃_tᵀ H⁻¹_{t-1} x̃_t作为效用代理，通过滚动分位数τ_t控制查询率；并以D-最优对数行列式增益ℓ̂_t=log(1+u_t/λ)作为估计效用，构成成本感知查询规则：u_t≥τ_t 且 φ·ℓ̂_t≥η_t 且预算足够。3）评估协议：采用观察者（prequential）协议、滚动预算机制（每步补充γ）、价值货币比（VfM）准则用于选择遗忘因子λ，并在合成数据与UNISOLAR太阳能预测任务上与Greedy和Random Sampling基线对比。
AI.result: 1）合成实验（时变线性回归，T=20000）：在卖方定价下，OVBAL以£89.94总成本和79个标签获得最低运行MSE与最优误差-成本权衡；在买方定价下Greedy更优（因可低价大量购买）。2）太阳能预测（UNISOLAR Site 10）：OVBAL在两种定价下均提供最佳长期误差-成本权衡；买方定价下仅购47个标签（Greedy为662）即获最低运行MSE，卖方定价下购458个标签获得最佳性能，且整体支出与基线相当。3）OVBAL在卖方主导的异质定价环境与真实非平稳流中优势最为明显。
AI.conclusion: QueryMarket将市场机制系统地引入流式在线主动学习，OVBAL通过D-最优效用估计、指数遗忘自适应与预算感知查询，实现成本-信息联合驱动的标签采集。其相对优势取决于定价机制：在卖方定价与真实非平稳数据上表现突出，在买方定价的受控合成场景中可能被低成本的贪婪策略超越。整体工作为流式学习中的数据市场设计提供了首个统一框架与实用基线。

title: From Drift to Coherence: Stabilizing Beliefs in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are often hypothesized to perform implicit Bayesian inference, yet a key coherence condition, the martingale property of predictive beliefs, has been shown to fail in controlled synthetic in-context learning settings. We revisit this question in a more typical usage regime: generic multiple-choice question answering. Exploiting the discrete answer space, we compute exact predictive distributions and study belief dynamics induced by autoregressive answer resampling. We introduce prompted predictive resampling (PPR), where an LLM generates a sequence of answers to the same question. Empirically, PPR reveals early-stage belief drift, indicating martingale violations. However, after sufficient resampling steps, the belief process self-stabilizes and converges to a coherent predictive distribution. Based on this observation, we further propose (i) a seed-answer prompting strategy to accelerate stabilization, and (ii) a self-consistency loss that amortizes early-stage drift into the model via fine-tuning. Experiments on multiple-choice QA benchmarks show that our methods substantially reduce belief drift and improve predictive coherence without sacrificing accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型在多选问答（MCQA）任务中是否满足贝叶斯推断的鞅性质（martingale property）。作者提出了"提示式预测重采样"（PPR）框架，发现LLM的预测信念在初始阶段存在显著漂移（鞅违反），但经过充分重采样后会自稳定。基于此，提出了种子答案提示策略和自一致性损失（SC Loss）以加速稳定化。
AI.motivation: LLM常被视为进行隐式贝叶斯推断的学习器，其中鞅性质是衡量预测信念一致性的关键条件。先前工作（Falck et al., 2024）仅在受控的合成ICL场景中观察到鞅违反，但缺乏对实际部署场景（如多选问答）的检验。本文旨在将鞅分析扩展到LLM最典型的使用模式——重复回答同一固定问题，探究鞅违反的严重程度及可缓解性。
AI.method: 1. 将输出空间限制为离散的有限答案集，从而可精确计算预测分布；2. 提出提示式预测重采样（PPR），要求LLM以换行符分隔连续生成多个答案；3. 引入"种子答案"机制，将独立采样的i.i.d.答案作为前缀注入prompt以加速稳定；4. 提出自一致性损失（SC Loss），通过交叉熵使早期k1步预测匹配后期k2步预测，理论上等价于强制c.i.d./鞅条件；5. 使用LoRA对Llama-3.1-8B和Olmo-3-7B进行微调。理论保证：定理4.2证明SC损失上界可控制鞅残差。
AI.result: 在CSQA、AI2-ARC、TinyMMLU三个MCQA基准上验证：1. PPR揭示初始n≤5步存在显著漂移，但边际分布最终自稳定；2. 种子答案显著抑制早期漂移；3. AM-PPR（SC微调后）大幅降低EMD（期望鞅漂移）指标，减少burn-in阶段；4. 在准确率不降低的前提下，AM-PPR改善ECE、NLL、Brier Score等校准指标；5. 框架可扩展到32B模型和连续嵌入空间的推理路径分析（GSM8K、GPQA）。
AI.conclusion: LLM的鞅违反在实际MCQA任务中主要是瞬态的，可通过自稳定、种子提示和训练时摊销（SC损失）有效缓解。鞅性质是贝叶斯一致的必要条件而非充分条件——仅强制鞅性不能保证完全校准。该框架为LLM预测一致性提供了可操作的对齐目标，并可推广到复杂的多步推理轨迹分析中。

title: Meta-classification of one-class classification models using ranking correlation and nearest neighbor
summary: Machine Learning (ML) techniques have been applied to various problems. However, applying ML to ML models is an unexplored direction. For this purpose, this paper considers a meta-classification of one-class classification (OCC) models, because all ML models could be approximated as OCC models. The proposal represents OCC models as normality rankings and classifies them using nearest-neighbor and ranking-correlation metrics. The experiment classifies OCC models, where classes correspond to training datasets, algorithms, and hyperparameters. The proposal achieves high accuracy when class labels are datasets. Moreover, it can classify algorithms when the training datasets contain the same class. In addition, the discussion highlights that the classification of OCC models is essentially the classification of datasets that treats multiple samples as a single input. The experiment demonstrates the classification of datasets using sleeping records. The proposed method can provide a unified solution for classifying OCC models, datasets, and rankings. Source code is uploaded to the public repository this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种对单类分类（OCC）模型进行元分类（meta-classification）的新方法，即将机器学习技术应用于机器学习模型本身。具体而言，该方法将OCC模型表示为"正常性排序"（normality rankings），并利用最近邻算法和排序相关性指标（Spearman、Kendall Tau）对其进行分类。实验表明，该方法能以高准确率区分训练数据集、OCC算法及其超参数，并且可作为一种统一方案用于数据集、OCC模型和排序的分类。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器学习技术已被广泛应用于各类问题，但将机器学习应用于机器学习模型本身（meta-learning的角度）仍是一个尚未充分探索的方向。由于几乎所有ML模型都可以被近似为OCC模型（例如二分类/多分类模型可分解为多个OCC模型），因此对OCC模型进行分类具有重要意义。其应用场景包括：联邦学习中检测训练集差异、集成学习、模型可解释性（XAI）、以及将数据集本身作为分类对象等。
AI.method: 方法核心包含两个步骤：1) **模型表示**：将OCC模型作用于一个独立的"排序集"（ranking set），通过score函数计算得到分数向量，再通过argsort两次操作将其转化为"正常性排序"（rank值）；2) **分类**：使用最近邻（Nearest Neighbor）算法作为惰性学习器，以排序相关性（Spearman或Kendall Tau）作为距离度量，在训练阶段存储所有训练模型的排序，在测试阶段将测试排序与所有训练排序进行比较，相似度最高的训练样本的标签即为预测结果。实验使用KDD cup数据集训练OCSVM、LOF、IF、GMM四种OCC算法及它们的集成模型，并设计了多组分类任务（数据集类别、算法类别、超参数类别）。
AI.result: 1) **训练数据集分类**：normal vs abnormal（2类）准确率100%；normal vs abnormal vs mix（3类）99.3%；normal-abnormal比例（11类）83.6%。2) **算法分类**：基础学习器（4类）分类准确率100%；集成模型（15类）在normal训练集上达85.5%，但在abnormal训练集上仅23.7%。3) **超参数分类**：类别型超参数（如OCSVM核函数、GMM协方差类型）准确率较高（93.8%-100%），而数值型超参数（如LOF邻居数、IF最大特征数）准确率较低（2.8%-49.9%），但作为回归问题表现尚可。4) **讨论应用**：在呼吸障碍生物信号分析和睡眠记录数据集分类案例中验证了方法的实用性。5) **消融实验**：排序集应同时包含训练集未涉及的正常与异常样本，以获得最佳性能。6) **时间复杂度**：自定义实现的Spearman相关性可在3分46秒内完成4400个模型的OVO相关性计算，远快于SciPy实现的3小时38分钟。
AI.conclusion: 本文是首篇针对OCC模型分类的期刊文章，提出了一种统一解决方案，可同时用于分类OCC模型、数据集和排序三者。其核心洞察在于OCC模型与训练数据集之间存在一一对应关系，因此对OCC模型的分类本质上是对数据集的分类（将多样本作为单一输入）。该方法在区分训练数据集特征和OCC算法方面表现出高准确率，但在集成模型和数值型超参数的精细分类上存在局限。主要限制包括：最近邻计算的可扩展性问题、依赖score函数的可访问性、对黑盒模型适用性有限。论文还展望了对二分类/多分类模型以及更深层级元模型（元元分类）的未来研究方向。

title: Monotonic Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks: A Theoretical and Empirical Study of Monotonicity as an Inductive Bias
summary: Monotonicity has been a long-running architectural inductive bias for neural networks, motivated by tabular, scientific, and economic settings where outputs are known to respond monotonically to certain inputs. Existing approaches are MLP- or flow-based and lack per-edge functional transparency; the only Kolmogorov--Arnold Network (KAN) variant with monotonicity, MonoKAN, enforces the constraint only on a restricted parameter subset and requires a projection-style training procedure. We close this gap with \textbf{MKAN}, a KAN with hard monotonicity guaranteed for \emph{all} parameter values via exponential reparameterization of B-spline coefficients, positive edge weights, and a monotone base activation. Training reduces to standard unconstrained gradient descent. Our headline theoretical contribution is a \emph{representation-cost} theorem: any $C^K, K >0$ feature extractor inducing a ball-shaped semantic-neighborhood partition admits a monotone realization of the equivalent neighborhood structure at $N' = N^* + k \le 2N^*$, where $k$ is the number of non-monotone coordinates of the original. The bound is architecture-agnostic and gives a principled sizing rule for monotone encoders. Empirically, MKAN is competitive with state-of-the-art monotone NNs on the SMM/ICML-2024 benchmark while being the only method that combines hard unconstrained monotonicity with KAN's per-edge functional transparency; the $2N^*$ prediction is validated in a self-supervised feature-size sweep on four real datasets, and on a controlled monotone-generative dataset MKAN recovers ground-truth factors with substantially higher Spearman alignment than KAN, MLP, and linear baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MKAN（Monotonic Kolmogorov-Arnold Network），一种通过指数重参数化B样条系数、正边权和单调基础激活实现"硬单调性"保证的KAN变体。核心理论贡献是"表示成本"定理：任何C^K特征提取器可在至多2N*维下实现单调化且保持语义邻域划分。实验在SMM/ICML-2024基准上与SOTA单调神经网络竞争，并在自监督设定中验证了2N*预测及在受控单调生成数据上显著更高的Spearman对齐。
AI.motivation: 单调性是表格数据、科学和经济学应用中广泛存在的先验知识（如药物剂量与毒性、债务与违约风险等应保持单调关系）。现有单调神经网络（MLP-based、lattice-based、flow-based）均缺乏KAN所提供的逐边函数透明性。唯一的KAN单调变体MonoKAN仅在受限参数子集上保证单调性且需投影式训练，限制了其使用。作者旨在弥合这一空白，提出兼具硬单调性、投影自由训练和逐边可解释性的KAN架构。
AI.method: 方法包含三个关键技术组件：(1) 指数重参数化B样条系数——引入无约束参数ω，通过γ'^(k)=ω^(1)+Σexp(ω^(t))的累积形式保证系数严格递增，从而对所有参数值实现单调B样条；(2) 正边权约束——使用exp(w)确保有效权重为正；(3) 单调基础激活——用ReLU替代原KAN的SiLU。组合为MKAN层：F'^(j)=Σ(exp(w'^(s))·ϕ'(x_i)+exp(w'^(b))·ReLU(x_i))+b_j。理论方面，核心是表示成本定理（Theorem 3）：任何C^K特征提取器F若诱导球形语义邻域划分且有k个非单调坐标函数，则存在维数N'=N*+k≤2N*的递增特征提取器F'能保持相同划分。证明基于单调分解定理（Theorem 1）将F分解为F_inc+F_dec，再通过构造性证明利用半度量ρ_s和Lemma 2将原邻域映射到新空间中。
AI.result: 监督实验：SMM/ICML-2024基准上，MKAN在分类任务（COMPAS 69.6%、LoanDefaulter 65.49%、Heart Disease 89.6%）上与SMM等SOTA竞争，并在部分任务中领先；回归任务（BlogFeedback RMSE 0.154、Auto MPG MSE 6.7）表现相当。多变量单调函数近似上，MKAN在N_in=2,4,6下MSE分别为0.01、0.01、0.05，匹配或接近SMM，显著优于无约束KAN（高输入维数下MSE高达16063）。自监督实验：在受控单调生成椭圆数据集上，MKAN达到Spearman r=83.0、DCI=72.6，远超KAN（49.4、10.1）和MLP（40.1、27.6）；特征维度扫描实验在MNIST、Fashion MNIST、Dry Bean、MAGIC四个数据集上验证了2N*预测——KAN在N*维特征下的性能位于MKAN在N*和2N*维之间。
AI.conclusion: MKAN是首个对所有参数值保证硬单调性、支持无约束梯度下降训练、保持KAN逐边函数透明性的架构。Theorem 3将单调性的代价精确表征为嵌入维度的量化权衡（最差2倍），而非类别性限制，并通过四个真实数据集上的特征维度扫描得到验证。在强单调结构数据上，单调性约束表现为有益偏置而非开销。局限性包括：缺乏自适应网格范围、Theorem 3是存在性结果非学习保证、假设球形邻域、未探索FactorVAE风格TC惩罚、深度堆叠时指数重参数化可能病态。未来方向：部分单调性、椭球邻域定理和单调生成数据下的可识别性。

title: Predictive Analytics in E-Commerce for CustomerBehavior Forecasting using hybrid Ret-DNN withXGBoost Model
comment: 2025 2nd International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
summary: In recent years, electronic (E) commerce services have rapidly increased in the daily lives of people, which helpsthem to purchase products online. However, retail platforms have struggled to understand customer behavior and make it difficult to predict their future purchases. To overcome these challenges, this study proposes a hybrid Retail Deep NeuralNetwork (Ret-DNN) with an Extreme Gradient Boosting(XGBoost) model for capturing temporal features and tabular dynamics of retail data. First, data were sourced from a UnitedKingdom (UK)-based online retailer that contains transactions with almost 500,000 records. Then, the collected data were pre-processed using a series of techniques, such as data cleaning, outlier handling, temporal feature extraction, feature encoding, and z-score normalization, to ensure that the data were ready for model training and testing. Subsequently, the preprocessed data were fed into the Ret-DNN model, which acts as a feature extractor to understand the complete context of customer transactions. Further, the extracted data were fed as input into the XGBoost model, which predicted the final output as the purchase probability of customers. Finally, the proposed Ret-DNN XGBoost model achieved better results by attaining aMean Absolute Error (MAE) 0.2193 when compared to the existing Ret-DNN model. Keywords: Customer behavior forecasting, extreme gradientboosting, electronic commerce, predictive analytic, retail deepneural networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合零售深度神经网络（Ret-DNN）与极限梯度提升（XGBoost）的混合模型，用于预测电子商务客户的购买概率，并取得了优于单一Ret-DNN模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 随着电子商务服务的快速发展，零售平台难以理解客户行为并准确预测其未来购买行为，因此需要一种有效的方法来捕捉零售数据中的时间特征和表格动态信息，以提升客户购买预测的准确性。
AI.method: 1. 数据来源：英国某在线零售商的约50万条交易记录；2. 数据预处理：包括数据清洗、异常值处理、时间特征提取、特征编码和Z-score标准化；3. 模型构建：采用Ret-DNN作为特征提取器理解客户交易的完整上下文；4. 预测阶段：将Ret-DNN提取的特征输入XGBoost模型，由XGBoost输出客户的购买概率。
AI.result: 所提出的Ret-DNN与XGBoost混合模型取得了平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.2193的预测结果，优于现有的单一Ret-DNN模型。
AI.conclusion: Ret-DNN与XGBoost的混合模型能够有效结合深度学习的特征提取能力与梯度提升的预测能力，提升电子商务场景下客户购买行为的预测精度，为零售平台的客户行为分析提供了一种可行的技术方案。

title: Half a Link can Be Enough to Predict a Whole Link: Understanding Generalization in Knowledge Graph Foundation Models
summary: Knowledge graph (KG) foundation models (KGFMs) are zero-shot generalizers: trained once, they can predict links on unseen graphs without retraining. However, understanding when and how they can robustly generalize across KGs is still an open question. In this paper, we shed some light on their generalization mechanisms highlighting how their performance on unseen KGs is not uniform when it comes to partially seen links, which we call half-links. In fact, we show that to predict a test triple $(h,r,t)$ it might suffice in practice to have observed the half-link $(h,r)$ or $(r,t)$ in the inference graph. This yields a taxonomy of four scenarios when combinations of these half-links are observed or not. In a rigorous stratified analysis over these scenarios, we reveal that SoTA KGFMs use seen half links for predictions, while unseen half-links pose different challenges. As such, our finer-grained taxonomy can be a diagnostic protocol for robust KGFM generalization and highlights where novel KGFMs can improve.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"半链接（half-link）分类法"，将测试三元组 (h,r,t) 分解为查询半 (h,r,?) 和答案半 (?,r,t)，并根据两者是否在推理图中被"见过"（seen）构建四种场景（SQSA、SQUA、UQSA、UQUA）。通过在 51–57 个零样本基准上对 ULTRA、MOTIF、TRIX 进行分层分析，揭示 KGFM 在不同场景间存在约 0.4 MRR 的性能差距——这一差距与聚合指标本身相当，却被聚合 MRR 掩盖。
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅以聚合 MRR 评估 KGFM 在未见知识图上的泛化能力，无法区分不同预测难度：(1) 不同基准的"半链接可见"构成差异巨大，受数据集划分方式影响；(2) 查询半与答案半在结构上不对称，前者可能成为干扰信号；(3) 全未见场景（UQUA）对真正泛化的检验被忽视。作者需要一种更细粒度的诊断协议来揭示 KGFM 何时何因能稳健泛化。
AI.method: (1) 将测试三元组 (h,r,t) 分解为查询半 (h,r,?) 与答案半 (?,r,t)，以推理图 G_i 中是否存在见证三元组定义"seen/unseen"，交叉得 2×2 四种场景。(2) 审计 Galkin et al. (2024) 的 57 个基准中各场景占比。(3) 用冻结骨干的 ULTRA_rand 区分架构贡献与学习贡献；用分心诊断 (D(h,r) 干扰率) 量化查询半的负面作用。(4) 在关系图层面引入"偶发覆盖"度量，比较 ULTRA（二元共现）、MOTIF（高阶 motif）、TRIX（实体标注 + 迭代耦合）三种关系图设计。(5) 在 Family 3 上对预训练检查点做逐基准微调，观察排序翻转。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1) 场景构成是划分伪影——SQSA 平均占 40.9%，UQUA 不足 10%。(2) 强场景与弱场景 MRR 差约 0.37–0.41，排序为 UQSA > SQSA > UQUA > SQUA，对所有模型和家族均成立。(3) 答案半是积极信号、查询半是干扰信号：ULTRA_rand 在 UQSA 上 MRR 0.419 vs SQUA 上 0.129；预训练主要放大答案半优势（+0.128 vs +0.004）。(4) 关系图表达力在 UQUA 上差异最显著：MOTIF 最高（0.267），TRIX_noiter 因实体标注导致偶发覆盖 < 0.6% 而低于 ULTRA（0.188 vs 0.245）；完整 TRIX 通过迭代实体–关系耦合恢复 UQUA（+0.08）。(5) 微调在 Family 3 上反转未见答案半的排序：TRIX 从第一跌至最后，ULTRA/MOTIF 升至前列，表明存在"提取缺口"。
AI.conclusion: 半链接分类法可作为 KGFM 稳健泛化的可复用诊断协议：(1) 建议与聚合 MRR 并列报告分层 MRR，以摆脱对划分方式的依赖；(2) 答案半的"半条链接"就足以预测整条链接，且这一不对称源于 r 类型消息传递的架构本身；(3) 提升 UQUA 既需要更表达力的关系图，又需架构层面的机制（如迭代实体–关系耦合），且关系图表达力仅在"实体无关"而非"逐实体"时才有帮助；(4) 未来 KGFM 应针对未见答案半的提取缺口设计架构。局限：分析限于基于 GNN 的 KGFM（ULTRA/MOTIF/TRIX），FLOCK 初步观察呈现相同模式但需更多评估；非 GNN 范式（如基于 LLM 的链接预测器）尚未验证。

title: Recursive Scaling in Masked Diffusion Models
summary: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for sequence generation. Scaling MDMs is conventionally achieved by increasing the parameter count or the number of denoising steps. We introduce Recursive Masked Diffusion Models (R-MDMs), which add recursive depth as a third scaling axis by repeatedly applying the same denoising transformer within each diffusion step. Recursion enables iterative refinement of the output through parameter reuse, increasing effective model depth without increasing parameter count. Across structured generation tasks, including Sudoku and Countdown, we show that R-MDMs achieve substantially improved parameter efficiency: a model with $L$ recursive iterations often matches the performance of non-recursive baselines with roughly $L\times$ more parameters. Moreover, recursive refinement can partially substitute for additional denoising steps, allowing recursive models to reach the same generation quality with fewer forward passes at inference time. These results suggest that recursive depth is a practically useful scaling mechanism for MDMs, improving both parameter efficiency and the allocation of test-time compute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出递归掩码扩散模型（R-MDMs），将递归深度作为继参数规模和去噪步数之后的第三维缩放轴，通过在每个扩散步内重复应用同一去噪Transformer实现迭代精炼，无需增加参数量即可提升有效模型深度。
AI.motivation: 传统MDM缩放主要依赖增加参数数量和去噪步数，但MDM具有双向注意力机制，使其天然适合利用递归计算进行全局约束传播（区别于自回归模型中受限于因果顺序的递归）。研究者旨在探索递归深度能否作为正交于参数和步数的有效缩放机制，同时实现参数效率和推理时计算效率的提升。
AI.method: 提出R-MDM架构：在每个去噪步内，对一个K层共享Transformer块递归应用L次（记为K⊗L配置），权重完全共享，参数总量与单次通过（K⊗1）基线相同。引入基于归一化递归进度的步嵌入（step embedding）以区分不同递归位置。设计了四种训练损失变体（All-steps、Final、Weighted、Truncated）和递归步数调度策略（固定、随机、反向课程学习Schedule 10→1）。在Sudoku（9×9和25×25）、Countdown（k=3,4,5）和Text8上进行了等参数和等FLOP对比实验。
AI.result: 在结构化任务上：(1) 6层递归5次的模型（10.6M参数）在Sudoku上达到93.6%有效率，匹配甚至超越30层单通过基线（53.1M参数）；(2) Countdown-5在T=30时，L=10达56.4% RTR，显著优于基线15.6%；(3) 递归精炼可大幅减少去噪步数——在Sudoku 9×9上达到95%有效率仅需15次前向传播（L_s=3, T=5），而基线需要40步，计算量减少2.7×；(4) 反向课程学习（Schedule 10→1）显著优于固定步数和其他调度策略；(5) All-steps损失配合学习式步嵌入表现最佳。但在Text8非结构化任务上，递归模型在似然指标上反而劣于基线，尽管定性样本显示生成更连贯。
AI.conclusion: 递归深度是MDM的有效缩放机制，尤其适用于具有可利用迭代结构的任务。它可同时替代参数缩放（最高5×更少参数）和去噪步数缩放（最高4×更少步数），实现参数效率和推理计算效率的双重提升。MDM的双向注意力使每次递归执行全局约束传播，比自回归模型的递归更具迭代效率。但该机制在非结构化任务中的适用性仍需进一步研究，未来工作应聚焦于更大规模模型验证、机制可解释性以及代码/数学等中间结构化任务的应用。

title: ConTex: Reformulating Counterfactual Generation For Time Series Forecasting
summary: Decision-making with deep learning-based time series forecasting requires not only accurate predictions but also actionable insights. However, current architectures do not inherently provide such information. Specifically, guidance is needed on how current conditions must be modified to shift from a predicted outcome to a desired future scenario. Counterfactual explanations provide a natural framework for this task, as they represent minimal input changes that alter the model's prediction, indicating when and how intervention is required. Existing approaches rely on instance-wise optimization, leading to inconsistency across instances, high computational costs, and limited applicability in real-time settings. To address these limitations, we reformulate counterfactual generation for time series forecasting as the problem of learning a globally consistent intervention strategy, allowing counterfactuals to be generated through a single shared function. We propose Counterfactual Time Series Explanations (ConTex), a model-agnostic, decomposed architecture comprising a temporal context encoder and a conditional encoder, followed by two heads that capture interventions in terms of temporal relevance and modification strength. This structure overcomes the instability and inconsistency of instance-based approaches by producing targeted, interpretable interventions across time and feature dimensions in a single forward pass, making it suitable for real-time applications. Across multiple forecasting architectures and benchmark datasets, ConTex achieves state-of-the-art validity while generating sparse counterfactuals that minimize the number of necessary interventions. Additionally, our approach reduces computational cost by at least 12-36x compared to instance-wise generation and supports real-time inference at approximately 0.007 seconds.

AI.tldr: ConTex 提出了一种模型无关的摊销式反事实生成框架，将时间序列预测中的反事实生成从逐实例优化重构为学习全局一致的干预策略。该方法通过时间编码器与条件编码器的分解架构，结合 FiLM 调制，生成可解释的稀疏干预（时间相关性掩码 + 修改强度），实现在单次前向传播中高效生成反事实序列。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测中的反事实生成方法普遍依赖逐实例优化（如 ForecastCF），存在三大核心问题：1) 跨实例不一致；2) 计算成本高昂，不适用于实时场景；3) 目标轨迹常与输入耦合（如基于输入的边界设定），模糊了真正需要干预的部分。该工作旨在将这些方法替换为摊销式（amortized）学习，使任意输入可通过单一共享函数快速获得反事实，并提供可解释的"何时+如何"干预信息。
AI.method: ConTex 架构由三部分组成：(1) 时间编码器（TCN，优于 BiLSTM）提取输入时序上下文 h_x；(2) 条件编码器（MLP）将目标轨迹中心、宽度、当前预测、斜率编码为条件向量 c，并通过 FiLM 调制与时间拼接融入 h_x；(3) 两个预测头分别输出时间相关性掩码 m∈[0,1]^T 和修改强度 s∈R^T，干预量 z=m⊙s，反事实序列 x_cf=x+z。训练目标为复合损失：L_center（轨迹中心对齐）+ L_valid（约束满足率，sigmoid 平滑）+ L_prox（MAE 近端）+ L_sparse（掩码 L1/L2 紧凑性 + 二值化正则）。采用稀疏度退火策略（0.1→1.0，10 个 epoch）。目标校准采用基于模型输出分布的分位数区间，控制难度。
AI.result: 在 4 种预测骨干（PatchTST、N-HiTS、DLinear、TiDE）与 4 个基准数据集（NN5、Electricity、Tourism、M4）上共 16 种组合中：(1) 有效性 Ratio 与 S-AUC 在 16/16 情况下均优于 ForecastCF；(2) 紧凑性在 14/16 情况下最佳；(3) 平均 S-AUC 从 BaseNN 的 0.677 提升至 0.830（+22.6%），平均 Validity Ratio 从 0.891 提升至 0.910；(4) 推理时间约 0.007 秒/样本，最难设置下较 ForecastCF 加速 3.7–4.2 个数量级，端到端计算成本降低 12–36 倍；(5) 消融实验验证了 MAE 近端损失、条件编码器、掩码-强度分解以及当前预测条件输入的必要性。生成的时序相关性掩码可作为前向目标条件归因的解释手段。
AI.conclusion: ConTex 证明时间序列预测中的反事实生成可由逐实例优化有效替换为基于全局干预策略的摊销推理。结构化分解（where to intervene 与 how to intervene）产生更有效、更稀疏且成本低数个数量级的反事实，并在多数情况下超越基于检索的参考方法。其分解架构还为目标条件下的特征相关性提供了前向、干预驱动的解释视角，弥补了传统事后归因方法的不足。局限包括：未显式强制分布合理性约束（依赖隐式正则），且邻近性与稀疏性超参数仍需轻量级数据集调优。未来方向包括引入更现实的目标约束与更复杂的目标公式。

title: NoiseTilt: Noise-Tilted Reverse Kernels for Diffusion Reward Alignment
summary: We introduce the Noise-Tilted Reverse Kernel (NTRK), a reward-guided diffusion sampler that injects reward gradients through the noise term, leaving the pretrained reverse kernel unchanged and requiring only a single sample per step. Reward-guided sampling at inference time has greatly expanded the versatility of pretrained diffusion models. Yet existing methods face a trade-off. Gradient-based guidance shifts the reverse mean, steering generation but pushing intermediate states outside the region that the model was trained on and degrading quality. Search-based methods preserve quality but gain no gradient signal. No prior method achieves both. NTRK resolves this by keeping the reverse mean fixed and biasing the noise term toward high reward. We introduce a whitening operator, the central mechanism behind NTRK, that makes the reward gradient safe to inject as noise without losing its guiding signal. Across various reward alignment tasks, NTRK outperforms recent state-of-the-art baselines without losing sample quality. Remarkably, on aesthetic generation, NTRK surpasses the reward of the best baseline at 500 NFEs using only 25 NFEs, a 20$\times$ reduction in compute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出噪声倾斜反演核（NTRK），一种用于扩散模型奖励对齐的推理时采样方法，通过白化算子将奖励梯度注入噪声项而非均值项，保留预训练反演核结构，实现单步单样本的高效高质量奖励引导采样。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在推理时奖励对齐存在核心权衡：基于梯度的方法（如DPS）通过偏移反演均值注入奖励信号，但会破坏噪声兼容性并降低生成质量；基于搜索的方法（如SVDD）保持质量但缺乏梯度信号。作者指出所有现有方法都无法同时获得梯度引导和噪声兼容性。
AI.method: 核心方法NTRK保持预训练反演均值不变，将奖励梯度通过白化算子𝒲处理后注入噪声项，形式为 ε̃ = √ρ·𝒲(∇r) + √(1-ρ)·ε。白化算子基于二阶排序统计量（2OS）置信区间投影，结合逐块均值/能量约束和多正交变换域（Fourier、Hadamard）投影，将任意向量映射到典型高斯噪声流形。该方法在均值不变前提下实现单步单样本的奖励引导。
AI.result: NTRK在多个任务上达到SOTA：审美图像生成中以25 NFE超越500 NFE最佳基线（计算量减少20倍）；文本对齐图像生成、偏好对齐视频生成（VideoReward 3.465 vs DPS -0.130）、数量感知生成等任务中均最优；与微调模型（MixGRPO）正交可叠加；在FLUX和Z-Image两种底模上一致有效。消融验证了白化算子各组件（2OS、逐块统计、多域投影）的必要性，且额外计算开销低于10%。
AI.conclusion: NTRK通过将奖励信息路由到噪声项而非均值项，解决了扩散模型推理时奖励对齐中梯度引导与噪声兼容性的根本权衡。白化算子是其核心机制，使奖励梯度可安全注入为噪声而不失去引导信号。该方法在效率、质量和通用性上均显著优于现有方法，为扩散模型的推理时奖励对齐提供了一个简单且广泛适用的机制。

title: Edge Flow: A Tractable and Predictive Continuous-Time Model for Gradient Descent at the Edge of Stability
summary: Gradient descent in deep learning may operate at the edge of stability (EoS), a regime in which the largest eigenvalue of the loss Hessian hovers near the stability threshold $2/\eta$, where $\eta$ is the learning rate. Classical analysis tools such as gradient flow and the descent lemma do not apply here, motivating the search for a continuous-time model valid at EoS. We propose Edge Flow, a system of three coupled ordinary differential equations that provides a tractable, faithful, and predictive model of gradient descent dynamics at EoS. Edge Flow decomposes the dynamics into a center, an oscillation direction, and an oscillation magnitude. The center follows a modified gradient flow on a symmetrized loss; the direction tracks a top eigenvector of the Hessian via Rayleigh quotient dynamics; and the magnitude grows or decays exponentially depending on whether the sharpness exceeds or falls below the threshold $2/\eta$. Crucially, sharpness stabilization emerges from the coupled dynamics via a self-stabilization feedback loop. Discretizing Edge Flow only requires two gradient evaluations and one Hessian--vector product at each iteration. We demonstrate empirically that Edge Flow tracks the dynamics of gradient descent at least as faithfully as previously proposed continuous-time EoS models, while in addition resolving the oscillation of the sharpness at the onset of EoS, and that it provides a principled framework for understanding and mitigating instabilities in this regime.

title: From Reasoning Traces to Reusable Modules: Understanding Compositional Generalization in Language Model Reasoning
summary: Post-training pipelines that combine supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with reinforcement learning (RL) have emerged as the key recipe for transforming large language models (LLMs) into robust reasoners. We argue that this combined success is driven by compositional generalization, which we formalize through a hierarchical latent selection model. In this framework, reasoning traces are generated by a cascade of discrete latent selection variables corresponding to reusable atomic modules, including both skills (local operations) and routing mechanisms (how intermediate information is selected, reused, and composed). Within this model, we theoretically show that SFT and RL play asymmetric, complementary roles: SFT supplies the raw module materials in compositional traces, and RL decomposes those traces to identify the latent atomic modules and enable compositional generalization. We design controlled experiments to validate this theory. Our results demonstrate that RL can extract atomic modules from compound traces supplied by SFT and recombine them to solve new configurations. Moreover, we find that training on compound traces yields stronger generalization than training on isolated atomic modules. Finally, we investigate the relationship between SFT and RL data and identify an effective protocol in which SFT ensures coverage of all atomic modules through compositional traces, while RL focuses on novel compositions outside the SFT support to drive exploration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"分层潜变量选择模型",从理论上解释了大语言模型SFT+RL后训练流程中组合泛化能力的来源: SFT提供包含原子模块的组合轨迹原材料,RL通过奖励信号将这些纠缠的轨迹分解为可复用的技能(skills)与路由机制(routing mechanisms),从而实现在新组合上的泛化,并通过受控实验总结出SFT覆盖原子模块、RL探索SFT支持集外新组合的有效数据配对协议。
AI.motivation: 1. 现代大语言模型的推理能力飞跃主要依赖"SFT+RL"两阶段后训练,但两者各自贡献以及数据如何配对的机制尚不清晰。2. 现有研究多从经验层面评测RL对组合泛化的提升,缺乏对"RL如何重塑推理轨迹以实现组合泛化"的理论解释。3. 实践中SFT常出现"记忆式模仿"、对未见组合泛化差的现象,亟需一个统一的潜变量视角来指导后训练数据设计。
AI.method: 1. **模型构建**: 将推理过程形式化为分层潜变量选择模型——问题描述符P引发离散潜变量层级S=[S₁,…,S_L],其中S索引两类可复用原子模块: 技能(skills,局部操作)与路由机制(routing mechanisms,信息选取与组合方式),最终生成可观察的推理轨迹D。2. **理论分析**: 提出可识别性条件(条件C.1,包含锚点足迹、限制选择集、邻域覆盖、无冗余状态等),证明定理3.1(层级潜变量在分量重标记意义下可识别)与定理3.4(若每个新组合具有"局部见证者",则可组合泛化);提出命题3.2(SFT的"隐藏支持"使模块纠缠不可分)与命题3.3(RL通过可达性+奖励信息性富集关键局部事件)。3. **受控实验**: 在合成字符串变换任务(24个原子技能+10个路由机制)上系统干预SFT/RL数据组成,考察原子技能恢复、组合泛化、SFT-RL数据分布关系等。4. **真实模型补充证据**: 在Qwen3-4B上分析数学推理轨迹的n-gram组合多样性,并用SAE对Gemma-2-2b-it进行因果发现。
AI.result: 1. RL能从SFT提供的复合轨迹中分解出可复用的原子模块,并将其重组以解决新组合;在L_train=3的设置下,RL在L=1原子任务上比纯SFT提升43.7%,在未见组合上平均提升40.3%,且复合轨迹RL(42.6%)远优于原子模块RL(14.8%)。2. 若RL阶段缺少某个原子技能(去除1/3技能),仅注入孤立原子数据无法恢复深度泛化,必须注入包含该原子的组合轨迹;路由机制移除实验呈相同规律,且低深度组合的再注入效果更佳。3. SFT与RL数据分布关系对未见组合性能影响显著: 分离式(SFT∩RL=∅)泛化最强,嵌套式(SFT⊃RL)最弱;SFT应覆盖全部原子模块且使用组合轨迹,RL应聚焦SFT支持集之外的新组合。4. 真实模型分析显示RL后短n-gram(n=2,3)组合多样性显著增加,SAE因果发现也证实了技能-路由分层结构在真实模型内部确实涌现,且在长reward shaping、KL/熵正则化、采样数、温度等超参下结论稳健。
AI.conclusion: 本文构建了一个基于"分层潜变量选择"的理论框架,严格证明SFT与RL在组合泛化中扮演非对称互补的角色: SFT负责通过组合轨迹提供原子模块的"原材料",RL负责通过奖励重采样分解纠缠的轨迹以恢复可复用的技能与路由机制。理论(定理3.1与3.4)与受控实验共同支持一条简洁的实践准则——SFT应通过组合轨迹覆盖全部原子库存,RL应聚焦SFT支持集之外的新组合以驱动探索,为后训练课程设计提供了一种将SFT/RL分布视为组合超参数的新视角,并指明未来可自适应追踪欠探索局部接口以提升RL样本效率的研究方向。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Minimum Zero-Forcing Sets
summary: This paper explores the problem of finding the minimum zero-forcing set on undirected graphs and proposes an adapted machine-learning framework to solve the problem. The minimum zero-forcing set problem is a graph coloring problem where the color of an initial set of nodes propagates throughout a network. The set of nodes is zero-forcing if it forces all uncolored nodes to change color under the constraint of the color-change rule. There are several applications to this problem across different domains such as network science, network control, and designing logical circuits. Finding the minimum zero-forcing set is shown to be NP-hard. We propose a reinforcement learning framework, SD-ZFS, that adapts the S2V-DQN architecture to the ZFS problem. We train several models on this adapted framework and analyze the performance across graph datasets that have varying structures. We evaluate how the models trained on the framework generalize, scale, and transfer to different network types. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the framework when compared against the optimal solution and greedy heuristic. We provide further insight into how the ZFS problem can be solved through machine-learning and the influence of network structure on the problem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于深度强化学习的框架SD-ZFS（Structure2Vec-DQN-ZFS），用于求解无向图上的最小零强迫集（Minimum Zero-Forcing Set, ZFS）问题。该问题已被证明是NP-hard问题，应用于网络科学、网络控制和逻辑电路设计等领域。作者将S2V-DQN架构适配到ZFS问题上，训练了三个模型分别在随机网络（Erdős–Rényi）、无标度网络（Barabási–Albert）和真实网络（Facebook）上，并在多种图数据集上评估其泛化性、可扩展性和迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 最小零强迫集问题在网络科学、网络控制和逻辑电路设计中有广泛应用，但该问题是NP-hard问题。现有方法如Wavefront算法、组合算法和整数规划在大规模图上计算效率低；贪心启发式虽然多项式时间，但仅基于局部信息且无法保证近似比。因此需要一种能结合图结构信息、适用于大规模图且能学习长期策略的机器学习方法。
AI.method: 作者将S2V-DQN（Dai et al., 2017）框架适配到ZFS问题上。S2V部分使用mean-field推理（图嵌入）迭代更新节点表示，捕捉局部邻域结构信息；DQN部分使用MLP将节点嵌入和图嵌入映射为q-score。采用Double DQN、n-step回报、Huber损失和经验回放进行训练。状态表示当前部分解，动作是选择节点加入零强迫集，奖励为每添加一个节点给予-1的惩罚。训练了三个模型：SD-ZFS ER（Erdős–Rényi网络）、SD-ZFS BA（Barabási–Albert网络）和SD-ZFS FB（Facebook网络）。
AI.result: 1）在Small_ER数据集上，SD-ZFS ER平均比贪心算法少4.47个节点（偏差11.45%），近似比为1.048，接近最优。2）SD-ZFS BA在Large ER数据集上以81.8%胜率超越贪心算法。3）三个模型在COLLAB、IMDB-BINARY、BA_Scale等数据集上均能匹配或超越贪心算法。4）在Large_ER和BA_Scale上证明模型可扩展到1000节点。5）REDDIT数据集是唯一所有模型都未能超越贪心算法的数据集，分析表明该数据集呈"hub-and-spoke"结构（叶节点占61%），证明其最优ZFS为|V|-2。6）与Ahmad et al. (2024)的GCN方法相比，SD-ZFS在Small_ER上解的质量更优（偏差11.45% vs 5.36%差于贪心，实际SD-ZFS优于GCN）。
AI.conclusion: SD-ZFS框架在多种网络类型上能够有效求解最小零强迫集问题，性能可匹配或超越贪心启发式方法，并接近最优解。模型具备良好的泛化性、可扩展性和迁移能力。网络结构对问题难度有重要影响：高度密集或高聚类系数的网络使得ZFS计算策略影响甚微；hub-and-spoke结构的网络对所有方法都构成挑战。未来的工作方向包括：进一步调整框架以适应具有特殊拓扑（如完全图、hub-and-spoke、树或路径）的网络结构。

title: Rethinking Dataset Distillation for Classification: Do Distilled Sets Outperform Coresets?
summary: Dataset distillation (DD) has emerged as a prominent approach in data centric machine learning, aiming to synthesize compact training sets for efficient training by compressing the information in large datasets into a small number of synthetic samples. However, DD methods are often evaluated under inconsistent evaluation protocols, ranging from standard ERM to single/multi-teacher supervision, making it difficult to isolate the effectiveness of distilled data from evaluation. Moreover, many prior methods claim that DD outperforms data pruning approaches such as coreset selection (CS), based on the assumption that restricting condensed datasets to subsets of real samples fundamentally limits their expressiveness. In this work, we critically evaluate DD methods through large-scale experiments using standardized datasets and evaluation protocols to assess their intrinsic effectiveness. We benchmark seven state-of-the-art (SOTA) DD methods on ImageNet-1K, ImageNet100, and ImageNette, using three widely adopted training protocols against three CS strategies. Our results show that while some DD methods fail to outperform even simple random subsets, the SOTA DD approaches are comparable to or worse than coresets on large-scale datasets and incur a substantially higher cost for construction. Beyond accuracy, we also evaluate the representativeness, diversity, and quality of condensed sets, and find that coresets consistently achieve better coverage of the original data distribution. These findings highlight the limited practical advantages of current DD methods and show that coresets remain competitive and are often a more computationally efficient alternative for data-centric learning.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模标准化实验系统性地比较了7种SOTA数据集蒸馏(DD)方法与3种核心集选择(CS)方法，在ImageNet-1K、ImageNet-100和ImageNette三个数据集上，使用硬标签、单教师软标签和多教师软标签三种评估协议进行评测。研究发现：在大规模数据集上，DD方法并不优于甚至劣于CS方法（尤其是AUM和Concepts），且DD方法的构造成本远高于CS方法；同时CS在代表性、多样性和分布覆盖方面表现更优。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集蒸馏(DD)研究存在两个核心问题：(1)评估协议不一致（从标准ERM到单/多教师监督），导致难以分离蒸馏数据本身的有效性与评估流程的影响；(2)许多DD工作声称优于核心集选择(CS)，但缺乏系统性的CS基线对比，尤其在大规模数据集上。该研究旨在通过标准化实验严谨评估DD的内在有效性。
AI.method: 实验设计包括：(1) DD方法：7种SOTA方法（VLCP、D3HR、Minimax、DiT、MGD³、ManifoldGD、FADRM+），覆盖训练型生成、免训练生成和解耦蒸馏三类；(2) CS方法：3种（随机采样、AUM、概念引导）；(3) 数据集：ImageNet-1K、ImageNet-100、ImageNette；(4) 评估协议：硬标签、单教师软标签(RDED)、多教师软标签(EDC)；(5) 评估指标：准确率、构建时间、代表性、多样性、FID。还提出了IPC-CCS（基于类内覆盖的核心集选择算法）以及misratio超参数的消融研究。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 在ImageNet-1K硬标签协议下，AUM在10 IPC时超过最佳DD方法3.3%（ResNet-18）和4.8%（ResNet-50），50 IPC时超过4.2%；(2) 即使在软标签协议下，CS仍具有竞争力；(3) 多个DD方法甚至不如简单的随机子集；(4) 在小规模ImageNette上DD方法有优势，但在ImageNet-100/1K上优势消失；(5) 最佳DD方法因评估协议而异，说明DD对评估流程敏感；(6) CS方法（AUM）的构建时间与IPC无关（恒定），而DD方法与IPC呈线性关系；(7) CS在代表性-多样性权衡中占据右上角，覆盖更广，FID更低；(8) 定性分析显示DD方法存在模式坍缩和视觉伪影。
AI.conclusion: 该研究得出结论：(1) DD方法的性能与评估流程深度耦合，需要在标准化协议下评估；(2) DD方法在内在上并不优于CS方法，特别是在硬标签评估下；(3) CS方法在准确率、分布覆盖和计算效率方面均优于或持平于DD方法；(4) 未来DD研究必须将强CS基线作为必要对比，并采用硬标签和至少一种软标签协议进行标准化评估；(5) 核心集选择仍是一种更具计算效率和可扩展性的数据为中心学习方法。论文局限：仅关注图像分类任务，且主要限于ImageNet系列数据集。

title: Sign-Rank, Index, and List Replicability: Connections and Separations
summary: In learning theory, the sign rank of a binary concept class captures the smallest dimension in which it can be represented by points and halfspaces. Despite tremendous interest, lower bounds on sign rank are notoriously difficult to come by. Two recent approaches to the problem establish lower bounds on sign rank by measures that are easier to analyze: the $\mathbb{Z}_2$-index and the list replicability number. We order these measures, showing that the $\mathbb{Z}_2$-index is upper-bounded by a linear function of the list replicability number. As a main consequence, we obtain a strong separation between sign rank and $\mathbb{Z}_2$-index, thereby resolving a question of Frick, Hosseini, and Vasileuski. This motivates a thorough study of list replicability, the stronger of the two lower-bounding measures. We establish upper bounds on the list replicability number by two combinatorial measures: height and minimum star number. We also prove a fundamental composition result, showing that the product of two concept classes has list replicability number bounded by the sum of the list replicability numbers of the two classes.

AI.tldr: 本文系统地研究了二元概念类的三种复杂度度量——符号秩（sign rank，几何度量）、ℤ₂-指标（Z₂-index，拓扑度量）和列表可复制数（list replicability number，算法学习论度量）——之间的定量关系与分离性。核心结论包括：ℤ₂-指标可被列表可复制数的线性函数上界控制、列表可复制数可被高度和最小星数上界控制、以及列表可复制数在概念类拼接下满足可加性。
AI.motivation: 符号秩是学习理论中刻画二元分类问题线性可表示性的基本参数，但其下界证明极其困难。近期两个研究方向分别通过ℤ₂-指标（Frick-Hosseini-Vasileuski）和列表可复制数（Chase-Moran-Yehudayoff等）来建立符号秩的下界，但这些度量之间的定量关系尚不清晰。Frick等人曾提出疑问：ℤ₂-指标是否函数性地控制了符号秩？本文旨在系统地排序这些度量、解决这一开放问题，并深入研究列表可复制数作为更强的下界工具的性质。
AI.method: 研究方法综合了三个领域的工具：(1) 拓扑方法——利用ℤ₂-等变映射、Borsuk-Ulam定理、剖分定理（Illman定理）将概念类的ℤ₂-指标与可实现分布空间 Δ_{C^±} 上的等变映射联系起来；(2) 学习论方法——通过开/闭覆盖的重叠度刻画列表可复制数（定理2.11），并通过构造具体的PAC学习算法来建立上界；(3) 组合方法——利用高度（junction closure中的最长链）、诱导维数（eluder dimension）和星数等组合参数建立列表可复制数的上界。在分离性方面，采用有限射影平面 PG(2,q) 的关联矩阵作为关键构造工具，并通过分位数耦合（quantile coupling）证明拼接的加法上界。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) **定理1.1**：Ind_{ℤ₂}(C) ≤ 2·lr(C) − 1，从而建立不等式链 coInd_{ℤ₂}/2 ≤ Ind_{ℤ₂}/2 < lr(C) ≤ signrk(C)；(2) **定理1.2**：利用射影平面关联矩阵 B_q 证明符号秩可多项式增长（≥ N^{1/4}）而ℤ₂-指标有界（≤ 5），从而否定地回答了Frick等人的问题；(3) **定理1.3**：lr(C) ≤ Opt(C)（高度控制列表可复制数），结合定理1.4证明高度 = eluder维数 + 1；(4) **定理1.7**：lr(C) ≤ 11·s_min(C) + 1（通过嵌入到极值类）；(5) **定理1.9**：否定Li-Kamath-Foster-Srebro的猜想，证明 signrk(A) ≤ 2f(d)² ≤ 2(2d²)^{2(2d²)^{4d}}（s_max控制符号秩）；(6) **定理1.12**：lr(C₁ * C₂) ≤ lr(C₁) + lr(C₂)（拼接的加法上界，紧的）；(7) **推论1.11**：通过实射影空间 ℝP^{2N−1} 的实现，证明部分概念类中coindex可常数而列表可复制数无界。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了符号秩、ℤ₂-指标和列表可复制数之间精确的层次关系，证明了ℤ₂-指标并非符号秩的函数性上界（通过射影平面的构造），并系统发展了列表可复制数的理论：包括通过高度、诱导维数和最小星数的上界控制、加法性的拼接性质以及与极值类之间的联系。论文还提出了若干重要开放问题：是否lr(C)或Ind_{ℤ₂}(C)能被VC维数函数性控制（问题1.16），以及关于N×N符号矩阵列表可复制数的最优上界猜想 lr(A) = O(log N log M)（猜想1.15）。这些结果深化了对学习论中基础复杂度度量的理解，并为利用拓扑与组合工具研究学习问题提供了新视角。

title: On the Memorization Behavior of LLMs in Generative Recommendation: Observations, Implications, and Training Strategies
summary: Generative recommendation (GR) has emerged as a promising direction for recommender systems. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly adopted for GR, as their rich pretrained knowledge is expected to help them generalize beyond common user behavior patterns that traditional memorization-oriented baselines can capture. However, existing LLM-based GR works largely ignore LLMs' well-known tendency to memorize, which, if present in LLMs fine-tuned for GR, would restrict their utilization of pretrained knowledge. In this work, we investigate this concern by examining one-hop memorization, where a model recommends items that are direct successors of items in the training data. We show that LLMs do this more than non-LLM-based GR models-in fact, the vast majority of their gains over GR baselines are actually on users whose target items can be predicted through one-hop memorization. We intuit that improving performance on the remaining users requires LLMs to learn richer item-item relations beyond one-hop transitions. To achieve this, we propose IIRG, a novel training strategy that teaches LLMs to capture: (1) collaborative relations derived from item co-occurrences across multiple hops in user sequences, and (2) semantic relations among items with similar themes, both of which can serve as useful recommendation signals. We show that IIRG significantly improves over LLMs trained solely with standard next-item prediction, with especially large gains for users whose test items are not covered by train-time one-hop transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了LLM在生成式推荐(GR)中的"一跳记忆"现象：LLM倾向于记忆训练数据中相邻物品的一跳转移关系，且其相对于非LLM基线的性能提升主要来自受益于一跳记忆的用户群体。为此，作者提出IIRG（Item-Item Relation Generation）训练策略，通过额外的协作邻居生成（基于多跳共现）和语义邻居生成（基于文本相似度）两项辅助任务，让LLM学习超越一跳转移的更丰富物品间关系。在三个Amazon数据集上，IIRG相比仅使用下一项预测训练的LLM平均提升21%的Recall@5，对非一跳记忆受益用户提升高达50%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的生成式推荐工作忽视了LLM的固有记忆倾向。作者质疑：LLM在GR微调后是否主要依赖记忆训练数据中的一跳物品转移，而非真正利用其预训练的世界知识？如果是，这将限制LLM相对于传统非LLM推荐模型的泛化优势。
AI.method:
方法分为分析和训练策略两部分：

**分析部分（§3）**：
1. 形式化生成式推荐问题
2. 量化"一跳记忆"：计算模型Top-5推荐中属于用户输入序列物品的相邻后继（一跳候选集）的比例
3. 将用户分为"一跳记忆受益组"和"非受益组"，比较LLM与非LLM基线（TIGER）在两组上的性能差异

**IIRG训练策略（§4）**：
1. **协作邻居生成任务**：对每个物品，在用户序列中定义时间窗口W（设为5）内的多跳共现物品作为候选，按共现频率排序取Top-N₁个作为协作邻居
2. **语义邻居生成任务**：用预训练语言嵌入模型（如Qwen-3-8B）对物品文本描述编码，按余弦相似度取Top-N₂个作为语义邻居
3. **联合训练**：在标准下一项预测损失之外，加入两个邻居生成任务，通过超参数λ₁和λ₂加权
4. 损失函数：L = Σ L_u/B + λ₁·Σ L_k^(C)/B + λ₂·Σ L_t^(S)/B

**技术细节**：
- 使用Qwen-3.5-4B作为骨干LLM
- 同时支持TID（基于关键词）和SID（基于RQ-VAE）两种物品标识符
- 批大小128，训练3个epoch
- 排除目标物品在用户序列中的影响以防止数据泄露
AI.result:
**核心发现**：
1. LLM的一跳记忆比率（Top-5推荐中一跳候选占比）显著高于非LLM基线TIGER
2. 在6个设置中的5个里，LLM相对TIGER的提升主要集中在一跳记忆受益用户组
3. 这一现象在LLM正则化或TIGER扩大至LLM规模后仍然存在，说明模型规模和过拟合不能解释该现象

**IIRG性能**（表1）：
- Sports：R@5从0.0337提升至0.0406（+20.5%），N@5从0.0226提升至0.0283（+25.2%）
- Toys：R@5从0.0634提升至0.0780（+23.0%），N@5从0.0438提升至0.0541（+23.5%）
- Beauty：R@5从0.0606提升至0.0726（+19.8%），N@5从0.0429提升至0.0513（+19.6%）
- 在所有数据集上均超越17个基线方法
- 对非一跳记忆受益用户的平均增益达40%，远高于对受益用户的16%增益

**其他验证**：
- 消融实验（表2）：协作和语义邻居生成任务缺一不可
- 通用性（图5）：在SID下同样有效
- 冷启动物品（图17）：对冷启动物品的提升更显著
- 邻居信息量分析（图13）：两类邻居与一跳邻居的Jaccard相似度<0.5，提供非冗余信号
- 输出有效性（表6）：99%的beam能正确映射到物品空间
- 在Yelp数据集（表9）和其他SID设计（图18）上同样有效
- 现有正则化方法（LoRA、权重衰减、早停）无法有效减少一跳记忆
AI.conclusion: 本文系统性地揭示了LLM在生成式推荐中的一跳记忆现象，并证明这是LLM相对非LLM基线性能提升的主要驱动力，但同时也是其在更广泛用户群体上性能提升受限的根本原因。提出的IIRG策略通过联合优化下一项预测、协作邻居生成和语义邻居生成三个任务，有效引导LLM学习超越一跳转移的丰富物品关系。该方法在多个数据集、多种物品ID方案下均取得一致提升，尤其对非一跳记忆受益用户和冷启动物品效果显著，为解决LLM记忆倾向问题提供了新思路。未来工作应探索：（1）一跳记忆产生的根本原因；（2）该现象在其他LLM家族中的普遍性；（3）是否存在更好的物品关系监督信号。

title: An expressivity analysis of hierarchical modelling in deep transformers via bounded-depth grammars
summary: Deep neural networks are widely believed to derive their expressive power from their ability to form \textbf{hierarchical representations}, capturing progressively more abstract and compositional features across layers. In language modeling, \textbf{transformers} have emerged as the dominant architecture, with early layers capturing local syntactic patterns and later layers encoding more complex clause-level dependencies. While this intuition has shaped model design, there remains a lack of rigorous theoretical work demonstrating \textbf{how} deep transformers represent such hierarchical structures. In this work, we analyze the expressiveness of deep transformer models through the formal lens of bounded-depth, non-recursive context-free grammars. For this class of grammars, we explicitly construct transformers with positional attention whose depth grows linearly with grammar depth, while the neuron count scales with the number of derivation-tree shapes and quadratically with the number of production rules. Our theoretical results support the linear representation hypothesis by demonstrating that these architectures possess the structural capacity to encode abstract grammatical states into low-dimensional, linearly separable subspaces within the residual stream.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上分析了深度Transformer通过有界深度非递归上下文无关文法（CFG）建模层次结构的能力。作者显式构造了一个具有位置注意力机制的Transformer架构，其深度随文法深度线性增长，神经元数量随推导树形状数线性增长、随产生式规则数二次增长，从而形式化地证明了Transformer具有将抽象文法状态编码为残差流中低维线性可分子空间的结构能力，为线性表征假说提供了理论支撑。
AI.motivation: 尽管深度神经网络被认为通过层次表示获得强大表达能力，且实证研究表明Transformer能编码复杂的句法和语义结构（包括线性表征假说的实证支持），但目前缺乏严格的理论工作解释深度Transformer如何以及为何能够表示这些层次结构。特别是现有理论分析多集中于受限设置（如Dyck语言和有限状态自动机），未能覆盖真实文法中的复杂分支结构，也未从理论上说明Transformer为何具备在低维线性子空间中显式编码抽象文法状态的结构能力。
AI.method: 作者采用长度一致（uniform）、固定深度、非递归的上下文无关文法作为形式化分析框架。对于此类CFG，显式构造了带有简化位置注意力机制（relative positional attention，省略softmax并使用确定性位置掩码）的Transformer语言模型：1）利用稀疏注意力头按CFG推导树形状，自底向上逐步聚合局部子节点的句法上下文，模拟CKY/inside-outside风格的动态规划；2）利用前馈网络充当离散查找表，通过记忆化（memorization）将聚合的子结构匹配到产生式规则并编码父非终结符；3）通过层间的残差连接保留低层句法状态；4）最后使用5d+7层前馈网络归纳地计算有效后续词的集合。证明方法基于对推导树形状的归纳、Zhang等人的FFN记忆化引理，以及分段线性"三角帽"函数的构造。
AI.result: 主要定理（定理4.1）证明：对于深度为d、最大规则数为M、最大分支因子为B、推导树形状数为c的均匀CFG，存在由d个Transformer块后接5d+7个前馈层组成的语言模型，能以任意小误差ϵ进行预测性建模。其中每个Transformer块隐藏维度为cd，含c个注意力头（每个值维度为1，每行至多B个非零位置权重），FFN含M个神经元；每个前馈层至多4cBM²个神经元。相比Zhao等人（2023）的工作，本构造中Transformer深度随文法深度（而非句子长度）线性增长，且针对decoder-only Transformer；而相比基于有限状态自动机的表示（状态空间随深度指数增长O(|N|^d)），本构造通过逐层处理层次规约避免了指数爆炸。理论上证明每个非终结符可被编码到残差流相应深度的低维线性子空间中，通过简单仿射变换即可实现线性可分分离，为线性表征假说提供了基于正交基的简化模型下的存在性证明。
AI.conclusion: 本文为理解深度Transformer语言模型如何建模层次结构提供了严格的理论框架，证明了Transformer具有在低维线性子空间中显式编码CFG非终结符的结构能力，每层对应文法层次中的一级。构造展示了稀疏注意力电路如何实现自底向上的动态规划解析，与Allen-Zhu & Li（2025）实证观察到的注意力头行为高度一致。本文支持线性表征假说（在不含叠加的正交基简化模型下），但承认实际训练中通过叠加（superposition）实现密集压缩的机制仍是开放问题。局限包括：依赖简化的位置注意力机制、依赖正交基而非叠加、界限依赖于推导树形状数c对复杂语料可能不够紧致。未来方向包括：扩展到同步CFG（机器翻译）、属性文法（问答）以及更丰富的程序语言文法；利用机制可解释性方法（如ACDC、EAP）弥合理论存在性与训练涌现之间的差距；分析不同稀疏注意力模式下的归纳偏置。

title: Intermittent Strategic Cooperation of Two Selfish Agents on Graphs
summary: We study strategic space- and time-constrained cooperation between two self-interested agents through the Intermittent Strategic Cooperation-Based Two-Agent Path Planning (IC2PP) problem, a shortest-path game on graphs in which agents navigate toward individual targets while optionally cooperating at specific nodes to reduce their own travel times. Although such cooperation can strictly benefit both agents, it is strategically fragile: agents may deviate at any point along their paths. Modeled as a 2-player game, we characterize the structure of Pure Nash Equilibrium (PNE) joint strategies in IC2PP, and show that stable cooperation must follow a highly constrained form. We further prove that at least one PNE exists in every instance of IC2PP, and present a polynomial-time algorithm for enumerating all relevant PNEs. When multiple equilibria arise, we study coordination mechanisms based on bargaining-theoretic selection concepts and empirically compare equilibrium outcomes in terms of individual travel times and social welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了IC2PP（Intermittent Strategic Cooperation-Based Two-Agent Path Planning）问题，研究两个自利智能体在图上路径规划中进行间歇性策略合作的最短路径博弈。作者将节点分为普通节点和合作节点（在合作节点上两个智能体同时通过可减少延迟），证明了纯纳什均衡（PNE）具有严格的"加入-合作-分离"三段式结构，证明了PNE的必然存在性，并提出了多项式时间算法来枚举所有非支配的PNE。当存在多个均衡时，作者利用议价理论（纳什解、Kalai-Smorodinsky解、平均主义解和功利主义解）进行协调机制选择。
AI.motivation: 现实中存在这样的场景：两个自利个体（如同向不同公司通勤的人）可以协调路径获益，例如共同通过某些交叉口可获得优先权以更快到达。然而这种合作本质上是脆弱的——只有当双方在时间相关（cooperation-relevant time）上同时到达合作节点时才能形成合作，并且任何一方都可能在路径的任何节点偏离以追求自身利益。因此合作虽然在原则上能改善双方结果，但必须精确定时且在策略上稳定。这一时空受限的合作问题在现有研究中尚未被系统地作为博弈论问题进行分析，填补该理论空白并为多智能体交互提供分析基础是本文的核心动机。
AI.method: 方法论主要包括以下几个层面：(1) 问题形式化：将IC2PP建模为图上的双玩家最短路径博弈，定义合作节点上的单人延迟τ¹和合作延迟τ²，定义等待时间、出发时间等关键概念；(2) PNE结构分析：通过Early Cooperation引理证明智能体倾向于尽早开始合作，通过Cooperation Continuity引理证明合作是连续的一段而非间歇的，由此得出三段式结构（加入段、合作段、分离段）；(3) 均衡条件刻画：定义Equilibrium Cooperation Joint Strategy (ECJS)的五个必要充分条件，包括稳定合作路径（Stable Cooperation Partial Path）和互鲁棒非合作部分路径（Mutually-Robust Non-Cooperative Partial Paths）；(4) 算法设计：基于修改的Dijkstra算法（Algorithm 1：最短非合作部分路径，Algorithm 2：最短稳定路径）以及Algorithm 3（针对给定合作结束节点的最优稳定联合策略）和Algorithm 4（枚举所有非支配ECJS），时间复杂度为O(m·(|E|+|V|log|V|))；(5) 协调机制：在多均衡情形下建立议价博弈模型，通过四种议价解概念在Pareto前沿上选择策略分布。
AI.result: 主要理论结果包括：(1) Theorem 2证明合作型联合策略是PNE当且仅当它是ECJS；(2) Theorem 3证明IC2PP总是存在PNE；(3) Theorem 4证明Algorithm 4返回所有非支配ECJS且每个返回的策略都是PNE。实验结果（在MAPF Benchmark Set的网格地图上测试）显示：合作密度、合作强度和路径长度的增加会提高PNE数量和合作收益；社会福利方面，Min-Sum和Utilitarian方法在最小化总路径时间上表现最优，而Min-Max和Egalitarian方法更注重公平性；不同选择方法产生的个体路径时间相近，因此智能体可选择共享社会目标而不会显著损害个体性能；当路径发散度（SPD）较高时，PNE数量趋于1，路径分离导致合作难以维持。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了分析两个自利智能体时空受限合作的新框架IC2PP，完整刻画了PNE的结构特征，证明了PNE的必然存在性，并提供了高效的多项式时间算法枚举所有相关均衡。研究成果为理解自动驾驶交叉口管理、共乘系统、临时联盟等现实场景中的理性合作提供了理论基础。该工作为未来的研究方向铺平了道路，包括推广到k>2个智能体、在线规划以及有限信息场景等。总体而言，本文在多智能体路径规划与博弈论的交叉领域做出了重要贡献，所提出的结构化均衡刻画和高效算法具有理论深度和实际应用价值。

title: Intelligence Entropy Principle and the ADE Stability Engineering Framework
summary: As LLM-driven multi-agent systems (MAS) transition from lab to production, system behavior exhibits nonlinear degradation. We introduce the Intelligence Entropy Principle: probability-driven systems spontaneously drift toward disorder, formalized as S(t) = S0 * exp(alpha*t/Cm), where Cm is a model capability coefficient we propose. Lyapunov analysis yields the stabilization condition lambda > alpha/Cm. We construct the ADE (Agent Delivery Engineering) four-layer framework (L1 Physical Laws through L4 User Adaptation) with 23 core components. Validation spans 100K-scale experiments and 33.6 days of production monitoring. We propose a Five-Layer Disorder Taxonomy unifying failures under structural collapse, and present Elastic Organization as an original MAS morphology. Results: channel fracture reduced from 69-98% to near 0%; system death probability below 0.02%.
